male_text: Help help!  I'm being repressed!
Company.. HALT!  ... Fall IN!
Forward.. MARCH!
Come, let us engage in fisticuffs, like civilized folk.
Thank you very much!
Follow me, $n. I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better protect me or I am as good as dead.
The entrance is hidden here in Moonbrook.  Keep your eyes peeled for thieves.  They want me dead.
You can go tell Stoutmantle this is where the Defias Gang is holed up, $n.
Work scum!
Grrrr! Idiots!
Good for nothing Kobolds!
All right people, look alive!
All right, you guys! Time to get up
Hey, follow me!
Another herd brought in successfully!
Well I'm here.  And I'm ready to rejoin...
You're not joining anyone, Thorsen..
$n, my wounds are grave.  Forgive my slow pace but my injuries won't allow me to walk any faster.
Ah, fresh air at last! I need a moment to rest, $N.
The Blackrock infestation is thick in these parts.  I will do my best to keep the pace, $N.  Let's go!
So close to blessed Lakeshire.  By the Light, let my legs carry me a bit further!
Marshal Marris, sir.  Corporal Keeshan of the 12th Sabre Regiment returned from battle and reporting for duty!
Brave $c, thank you for rescuing me! I am sure Marshal Marris will reward your kind deed, $N.
Antonio Perelli's miracle elixirs for sale!
Come one! Come all! Perelli's elixirs will dazzle!
Stonemasons. . .errr. . Defias be warned:  The rusty anchor sinks tonight.
The boss wants all hands on high alert.  The rusty anchor sinks tonight.
I'm here for the gold.
Everywhere I look I see thieves.  We, The People's Miltia, must return this land to the farmers.
The farms must be liberated.  Stormwind may have deserted these people, but I'll be damned if I will.

female_text: Defias activity reported on the costal horizon.  All clear on Sentinel Hill.

male_text: Lots of gnoll activity reported in the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.
All clear on Sentinel Hill, Lord Stoutmantle.  Heavy Defias movement reported in Moonbrook, however.
Stormwind's desertion shall not be forgiven by the people of Westfall.
Nothing biting. . . .
Here fishy fishy. . . come to papa.
Pull up a stool and have a drink!
The bottles are dusty but the liquor goes down clean!

female_text: Hopefully the reinforcements from Stormwind show up soon. . . .

male_text: Come on boys, we've got to get this bridge rebuilt.
Where are those reinforcements from Stormwind?  Heavy Blackrock activity has been reported in the East.
Still no sign of the 2nd Battalion from Stormwind.  Reports are coming in of Shadowhide movement in the Northeast.
Marshal Marris expects the reserve from Stormwind any time now. . . .

female_text: Don't worry, Old Blanchy, we'll get you something to eat soon. . .
I never thought the day would come that I'd leave my homeland of Westfall. . . .

male_text: Can't believe the forsaken wagon broke down.  Ain't no luck to be had in this land. . . .
We'll be out of here just as soon as I get this wagon fixed. . . .
Now how am I supposed to get those mechanical wretches out of my fields?
A bunch of thugs and thieves aren't going to get me to leave my land!
They might have run all the other farmers off, but the Saldean's will never leave Westfall.

female_text: Stay on the roads.  The forest is overrun with undead.
Fear not.  The Night Watch will rid the land of this foul taint soon enough.

male_text: Undead are crawling all over the land.  Where is the Stormwind Army?
The Night Watch alone cannot protect us forever.  We need the backing of the Stormwind Army.
We must not give into the evil which has darkened our land.  The Night Watch must prevail!
The forest is crawling with worgen and ghouls.  Something must be done!
We need better representation from Stormwind.  Our homes are falling to the undead.
The Council of Duskwood must take action.  Evil lingers in the air.
The people of Darkshire expect more from the Council.  We cannot let them suffer from this unholy wrath which plagues us.
Constant bickering will get us nowhere.  We need to take action.
The news from Stormwind does not bode well. . . .
Our cause falls on deaf ears beyond the thick, stone walls of Stormwind.

female_text: I sense evil brewing. . . .
The stars speak to me.  They whisper of the horrors waiting in the night.
The future holds much death and uncertainty, not unlike the past.
The spirits whisper in my ear.  They are restless and full of angst.

male_text: The stars will be in perfect form tonight!
There is something greater than magic at work in the night sky.  One day they'll listen to me. . . .
Psssst.  We just got some Moonshine in. . . .
Step right up and wet your whistle.
This dark taint is downright bad for business.
Welcome to the Scarlet Raven.  It's best to stay indoors these days.
If your glass is full may it be again!
Welcome to the Lion's Pride Inn.  Make yourself at home!
So much to do, so much to do!  Where does the time go?
Now where was that book on Night Elf customs I was looking for...
Oh my!  Look at the state of these books!  Who put them back without alphabetizing them??
Rouse and to arms, citizens of Darkshire! An abomination of the undead approaches along the road!
The abomination has overrun the Night Watch camp! Quickly, we must intercept it before it reaches town!
It isn't enough! Defenders, gather in the center of town. Together we will stand against the undead monster!
The abomination has come! Forward!
The beast is slain! All's well in Darkshire!
I didn't know he was getting married! I didn't even know he was dating! That's terrible! He can't work nights anymore!
Fine! You've outreasoned me, you masters of Engineering! Put the door wherever you want!
That's right, we're stupid. Stupid like a Fox!
Where's My Bacon?
You've ruined your own lands, you'll not ruin mine.
Thanks for saving me!
Now you die!
Time for my patrol.  I'll be back shortly.
Now that the coast is clear...
Who goes there?
I've been gone a long time...I better get back.
Private Thorsen returning from patrol.  Nothing new to report - it's pretty quiet out there...

female_text: It'll take more than a rotting corpse to stop us!
Very good.  You are relieved, private.  Rest, but don't get too comfortable.  Kurzen won't leave us alone forever.

male_text: What is going on here?  Leave that powder alone!
Aber?  Is that you...?  Oh...I'm so hungry, Aber!  SO HUNGRY!!
Wait...you are not my husband.  But he must have sent you.  And you...look..delicious!
Let's see if I can hit that bullseye this time.
Looks like I need more practice!
'Bout time fer me to make mah rounds.
Ah I am too busy for a drink now lad.
Ach! Toss me a cold frosty, Belm!
Bagh! Back to work for me! Thank you kindly Belm.
Aye there you go lad, your favorite brew.
Aye, tell your friend there Tongus if he dont take care of his tab here, i'll be making an appearance with old Steelhead!
Belm says pay your bill or he'll break your face.
Hoha! I'd welcome the challenge from old weakbelly!
I'll take whatever ya got cookin'! And throw in a bottle to wash it down!
Hey there, Belm!  Give me a mug of Thunder Ale, and one for my good friend $n.
How goes the barrel watching...?
Ah, that sure does hit the spot!  I think I'll get myself a couple more...can you watch these barrels for me, $n?
Well, back to business for me.  But it sure was nice taking that short break, and it's always nice drinking Thunder Ale!
I'm back where I started.
I'm now far enough away...so I can't see the barrel.  Poison away!.
Think there are any fish in here?
female_text: Think there are any fish in here?

male_text: I caught a big one last week, it had three eyes!
female_text: I caught a big one last week, it had three eyes!

female_text: My daddy says that in the ocean, there are fish so big they could swallow a whole ship.

male_text: My daddy can catch more fish than your daddy!
female_text: My daddy can catch more fish than your daddy!

female_text: Look! Look! I caught something! Aww....it's just a stinky ol' boot.

male_text: Nuh uh.
female_text: Nuh uh.

male_text: Liar!
female_text: Liar!

female_text: I heard that there are these huge fish that can walk on land to hunt, and eat people!

female_text: And one time, at camp, I caught a fish that was bigger than I am!!

female_text: I heard a story about this golden fish, and if you caught it you would get three wishes!

female_text: If you fished as well as you talked the ocean wouldn't have any fish left.

female_text: Shhh! You're scaring the fish away.

female_text: You're making that up.

male_text: If you could catch a fish big enough for your mouth we'd never be hungry again.
female_text: If you could catch a fish big enough for your mouth we'd never be hungry again.

female_text: Maybe we should go to the bridge and fish.

female_text: Really?

male_text: And that's how Lothar killed thirty six orcs with his bare hands!
female_text: And that's how Lothar killed thirty six orcs with his bare hands!

female_text: And so the knights stood before the charging Horde and held their ground as a thousand berserk orcs came through the valley.

male_text: They say he can turn into a raven sometimes.
female_text: They say he can turn into a raven sometimes.

male_text: You know why orc eyes glow red? It's because they drink blood!
female_text: You know why orc eyes glow red? It's because they drink blood!

male_text: There is no spoon.
female_text: There is no spoon.

male_text: I swear, people have actually seen them. Pandaren really do exist!
female_text: I swear, people have actually seen them. Pandaren really do exist!

male_text: And then the rabbit just bit his head off... I swear.
female_text: And then the rabbit just bit his head off... I swear.

female_text: You know there are crocilisks in the Canals. They were brought from the swamp as pets, but got thrown in the canals.

male_text: Wow.
female_text: Wow.

male_text: Oh yeah, I heard about that.
female_text: Oh yeah, I heard about that.
Come back Fluffy!
Why do you run from me Fluffy!
C'mon Fluffy! I just want to give you a bath!
Fluffy! Fluffy stop running!
Carrots every day for a year if you stop!
Don't make me get my pappy to catch you! He likes to catch bunnies using his rifle!

male_text: Oh c'mon, that's not true.
female_text: Oh c'mon, that's not true.

male_text: That's neat.
female_text: That's neat.

male_text: My father says that's just a story.
female_text: My father says that's just a story.

female_text: Can you imagine?

female_text: Sounds kinda like one of Billy's fish stories to me.

female_text: I thought I heard something.

female_text: I think I see something.

male_text: Eww... that's not a fish!
female_text: Eww... that's not a fish!

male_text: I got worm guts on my shoes.
female_text: I got worm guts on my shoes.

male_text: Something smells funny.
female_text: Something smells funny.

male_text: I hope that was a fish!
female_text: I hope that was a fish!

male_text: I don't think there's any fish in these canals.
female_text: I don't think there's any fish in these canals.

male_text: Worm goes on the hook, hook goes in the water. Fish is in the water, our fish.
female_text: Worm goes on the hook, hook goes in the water. Fish is in the water, our fish.

male_text: Could ye spare some coin?
Alms for the poor?
I will gladly pay you Tuesday for a hamburger today.
Help a poor bloke out?
Spare some change for a poor blind man? ...What do you mean I'm not blind? ...I'M NOT BLIND! I CAN SEE!! It's a miracle!
Shine yer armor for a copper.
It's all their fault, stupid Alliance army. Just had to build their towers right behind my farm.
It's all their fault, stupid orcs. Had to burn my farm to the ground.
You hear that? I think they're getting closer...
Guard duty, I hate guard duty.
I heard all the kobolds that were down there are dead.
Sorry, Huldar... But it seems I've misled you.
Dark Iron activity. Even that some of the shipments have been hijacked--
I'm sure it's just incompetence or oversight by some of the workers.
All hail, $n! Defender of The People!
The People of Westfall salute $n, a brave and valiant defender of freedom.
Three cheers for $n!  This land shall be ours once again!
Thanks for the cask of booze, $n.  I think I'll open up a bottle right now!

female_text: If we reverse the Essence flows perhaps we can alter the polarity.
So then the array of magics would cascade into a chain reaction of positively charged energies.
The portal will shift slightly, at this point if you cast a binding cantrip you will solidify it in place.
When the positively aligned energies collide with the negatively charged energies, they don't negate one another.
Maginor says that twisting alternating flows of positive energy actually creates a much more stable flow.
The magical wards at that point should be supported enough by the energy flux to contain the entity.
Why can't we just shift the array to compensate for the variance in the flux?
Putting in twelve centers of focus might allow the magical energies to form more solidly, adding the necessary stability.
But what if the resulting frequency shift were to send magical feedback up the flows?
Wouldn't that cause the weave to unravel if not properly anchored before starting the casting?
But wouldn't that mean crossing the streams? Isn't that really bad?
The resultant energies could collapse though, and that could cause an energy flux that would give you a migraine for weeks.
But isn't that what caused the initial problems with Adept Syleria's magical formulae?
I think not, I don't need to be blown up again.
That will unbalance the magical focus, though, and cause a reverse vibration in the ether.
I suppose that could work, if we had twenty people to cast it with.
What if we used three focuses in Tyrean pattern? That should solve it.
But if we stabilize it with an anchor thread at the appropriate energy crux then it should work.
Always so negative. The chances of that happening are between zero and none.
If we use the appropriate sequence we should be ok. Will just take some serious studying before we start.
Wow, all of this for a love potion. Hope he's worth it.

At least we wouldn't be around to have to clean it up.

male_text: I suppose you're right.

female_text: Here's my list, Keldric. The usual stuff.
Thank you, Keldric. See you later.

male_text: Curse you, $n!  One day, vengeance will be mine!
Alright, we've just gotten word that a caravan is leaving from Thelsamar. It's time to move! Go go go!
Alright, we're getting close to the excavation site, so we have to proceed carefully. Engage underwater breathing apparatus...
Hey Stone, did you hear about the new steam engine old Tonkrend has been runnin on?
Ah yes. I've heard all about those new flarged things. Armor was removed from the casing to decrease weight. Bargh! Nonsense!
Do you ever think about anything other than fighting? I could circle you down on the stretch course!
Bah! By the time you got in range of old Trollplow you would be in reduced to rubble!
Argh! You're hopeless!
Hey Fizzer, I ever tell you the time I was riding through the canals and some goblins in shredder suits tried to ambush me?
Ah, let me see. Yes probably nearing a hundred times now I'd wager!
Brahaha! Tha look on their faces as old Trollplow's gun came swiveling around to meet them! Their saws couldn't even touch me!
I would have just dropped some Evershine in my tank and been back home before they realized I'd gone!
Bah! That's no fun!
Hey Stone, let's hit the circuit some time. We could run a few laps and see who wins?
Aye sure, just as long as we get to hit the arena right after!
Nothing you can say will ever get me in the arena against that monstrosity of a machine you call a steam tank!
Har! You scared I'll hurt your little dainty racer?
Ha! I'm more afraid that those old holes and gashes would burst that thing and I would be showered by the shrapnel!
Haha! Sturdy old Trollplow has just a few meager battle scars!
Nothing beats the sound of a twin-carb, fork-ring steam engine burning pure firestone!
Ha! I'd take the sound of a Crater Cannon XT blasting off a shell over that any day!
Bah! You wouldn't know a great steam engine if it smacked you upside the head!
Maybe, but if it did hit me upside the head I'd know exactly which cannon to use to blow it into the smallest bits!

female_text: Corbett, dear.  Harlan needs a load of knitted shirts and pants as soon as we can manage.
Corbett, you there?  Harlan needs another load of knitted goods.  Can you take it to him?

male_text: My pleasure, sugar drop.  I'll be back soon...
Business must be good down at the bazaar.  I'll get him resupplied right away!
Hm...after dropping this off, I think I'll head to that cheese shop for a snack.
I should have a few extra coins from this sale.  Maybe I'll buy myself some lunch...
Hey, Harlan.  Here's a load of knitted cloth for you.
Oomph!  Here's another load of supplies, Harlan.  It must be selling fast!
Ah, much appreciated, Corbett.  We'll get these on the racks immediately.
Ah yes, and promptly delivered.  As always, it's a pleasure doing business with you, Corbett.
Well, I'm off then.  Take care, Harlan.
Glad to see you're doing so well, Harlan.  And I hope to see you again soon...
Lord Mayor!  Our scouts report strange activity to the west.
Mayor Ello!  Our graveyard scouts return with ominous reports...
Hideous bellows and growls are heard coming from that old hermit's shack!
Wolves head this way, as if fleeing from...something.
Yes, Lord Mayor.
This is grim news, and I fear it is linked to the dealings $n had with the Embalmer.
Watcher, inform Althea that a dire threat is marshalling against our town.  We must prepare!
Althea, there are reports of strange happenings at the graveyard.  Ello believes it portends an attack on Darkshire.

female_text: This doesn't bode well.  Send scouts to gather more intelligence, and stay on alert.

male_text: Yes, commander!
Beware!  Beware!  A threat lurks in the wild!  Night Watchers, be on the alert!
DARKSHIRE...I HUNGER!!
ROARRRRR!!

female_text: ...Nine...Ten...Ready or not.  Here I come!
Hey! You better not have gone too far!
Mom said not to climb up there any more.  I'm gonna tell!

male_text: Thank you, $n.  May the Light bless you, $Gbrother:sister;, and guide your path.
Now for that snack...
Good day, Elling!  Hullo Elaine!  Let me have a wheel of bleu cheese, eh?
Hullo, Trias clan!  A ball of your smoked mozzarella, if you please!

female_text: Good day, Corbett.  Here's your cheese, fresh made this morning!  And how are things at your shop?
Hi Corbett!  Here, you go!  I trust business is faring well at your clothier shop...?

male_text: See you later, Corbett, and tell the missus hello!
Take care, and send our regards to your family.
Thank you kindly!
Thanks for the cheese!
I should get back before Rema starts to worry...
Time to get back to the shop...
I'm back!
Yes ma'am, business is brisk!
Testing 1
Testing 2
Testing 3
I'm out of the building again.  Now I'll move one more waypoint...
I'm moving within the building
I made it to the last waypoint.  Yay!

female_text: Mom, Jesse climbed the wind tower again.

male_text: You'd better not tattle on me!
I can't come down.  I am scared.
Whoa...Whoa..Aaaaahhh!
Work you dogs! Put your back into it!

female_text: You get down from there right now!  I don't want you climbing that thing.  It's not safe.
See what I mean?  Get inside right now.

male_text: This will take a while to heat up, so its time for a drink! What do you say Tongus?
PICK ME!!!!!
Attack!!
Get in position lads! The beasties are upon us. Wait for my signal!
These lands shall be cleansed!
These undead atrocities will be destroyed!
The Scarlet Crusade shall not fail in its mission!
Stormy seas out there.  The sea spirits must be restless....hic!
I saw a Sea Giant once.  It's not something I would care to see again.  Burp!
I'd go out and clear out some of those gnolls, but this leg has seen better days and I am afraid I'd just wind up dead.
Watch your step out there.  Many an adventure seeker has not returned from the marsh.  hic!
It's time for my meditation, leave me.
There you are. What news from Westfall?
VanCleef sends word that the plans are underway. But he's heard rumors about someone snooping about.
Very well. I will return then.
Hmm, it could be that meddler Shaw. I will see what I can discover. Be off with you. I'll contact you again soon.
*sigh* It's about time to check on the cemetery again-- I'll be back in a few minutes.
We really should fix this fence soon.
Vrok said the sights are off on Grumlar's gun. I suppose I should check it.
Hmph! I didn't even hit the blasted target! That thick skulled dwarf was probably using the gun as a mace again.
Hmmmm... That one clipped it's shoulder. Grumlar was right, the sights are slightly off. Easy enough for me to fix though.
Almost perfect shot! It's a bit off but I can see where Grumlar would miss with it. He couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.
Bullseye! That blasted dwarf doesn't know what he is talking about. Only thing wrong with Grumlar's gun is Grumlar's aim.
Only $3658E shopping minutes before Christmas!  But wait, is it Christmas?  Well then, there are only $3659E minutes left to party!  TEST TEST DO NOT LOCALIZE
Warg, are you about ready to eat? I am gonna get it started.

female_text: Khara hums an old dwarven tune while she cooks.

male_text: Hon, food is ready. Come wash up and eat.
Mmmm, that was good. However, time to get back to work!
Ahhh, just in time! My stomach was rumblin' loud.
MMmmMMmmm. Smells delicious Khara.
Burp! Hon, that was really good. Not only do you know how to catch a fish but you sure do know how to cook one.
Whew! I think I ate too much. Need to loosen my belt a few notches.
Thanks for the great meal darlin' but I need to get back out front.
Another glorious day of fishin' is ahead of me, Khara. I best get movin'.
What a day for fishin'. They are sure to be bitin' today!
Warg looks over the water appraising what his luck might be today.
Welp the fish ain't bitin' no more so I might as start gutting and cleaning what I did catch today.
Best be on my way. Khara will be expecting me soon. See ya tomorrow X.
Look at all those ripples. Lots of activity in the water so I should catch a mess of fish today.
Hmmmm, only a little bit of activity on the surface but the sun is in the right place. Might turn out to be a fine day.
Not looking too good today. Sun is high and bright early and no activity on the water.
Hmph! What a sorry day for fishin' this is going to be. Ah well, a bad day fishin' is better then a good day workin'.
Berte! Evalyn! It's getting dark. Come inside.
You can play more tomorrow. Now come on inside.
Alright, alright. You two can go play just stay in town. No sneaking off to bug Warg and Khara down by the water.
Hah! Daryl, you should have seen the look on your face! You half jumped out of your skin!
They have you good on that one, lad!
Oh, shut up.
Awww Mom! It's hardly dark yet! Can we play for a bit longer please?
Ok...
We must be vigilant to eradicate this plague!
Keep up the good work.  This scourge will be cleansed!
The Scarlet Crusade will scour these lands!
Let none with the foul taint of plague live!
Mom! Can we go play please please please? Can we huh? Can we?
The kids jump up and down with youthful energy. (PH emote)
Wheeee! Thanks Mom!
Thanks Mrs. Brightbeard!
Gettin' a bit nippy out here. Think I will go warm myself by the fire and grab a pint or twelve.
Nothing like a roaring fire on a cool night with good friends and dwarven ale.
Brock. Torren. I am going inside for an ale and to warm myself by the fire.
Mmmmm, an ale by the fire does sound good. Sure, I will join ya Jern.
Here! Here! I'll drink to that!
What? Did someone say ale? Don't start pouring the pints without ol' Torren!
I'll drink to anything!
Noma should have dinner ready soon. Might as well head in.
My, that Black Claw stout packs quite a punch!
I feel... dizzy.  It's so hot... in... here...
Where's the rest of the guys?
Every bodies coming...
He really couldn't help it...
No one lives forever...

female_text: Gimlok!  Gimlok! Get in here this instant!
Where has the boy gotten to now?
Gimlok, don't you go and get your clothes all dirty.

male_text: Huuup...Huuup...Bleeeeehh!
I'll be a guard someday!
Remember when Danath gathered all the mercenaries of Stormwind together and we marched to fight at Nethergarde?
I tell ye, I don't miss the Great War at all. I remember when we fought at Darrowmere. All night in the fog, lying in a muddy trench.
I miss the dwarven ale we used to get at that inn in Lordaeron. Remember that fight we started there?
Less than a hundred of us, and over a thousand orcs. Only a handful of us managed to walk away from that one.
The best had to have been the look on Perenolde's face when our army comes marchin' right up to his front door. What a battle!
Battling that band of Twilight Hammer in the Morass, I could think of better places for a war.
Ahh yes, now I remember, your wedding night wasn't it?
Ahh the Glustewelt twins!
I still have the scars from that night.
Broke both me legs that night. How could I forget?
I woke up in a bed in Northshire three weeks later. Don't remember a damn thing.
Wasn't that the night we had to pick up my thumb and carry it in your smoke pouch?
I have a piece of iron in my back that will remind me of that night for the rest of my days.
Course I remember that night. Two inches to the left and you'd be drinking with that elf, Morris. That was my best shirt, too.
Was that the third or fourth time you nearly got me gutted trying one of your crazy stunts?
Aye and thanks for letting me carry my own hand back to the priests that night.
Hehe, wimp.
You screamed like a little girl, funniest thing I ever saw.
It all worked out in the end.
Let's not even begin comparing battle scars, my friend.
Never seen anyone move so fast in my whole life.
You are constantly surprising me with what a person can live through.
Well, you're still here. I'd say that is something worth drinking to.
You can thank me anytime for making your life more interesting.
I. . .I. . .don't. . .feel. . .right. . .
%s waves to $n
You have disturbed my rest, $c.  Now face my wrath!
My mind. . .my flesh. . .I'm. . .rotting. . . .!
Let me have another one, Langston.
Best ale in Stormwind, Langston. Thanks.
Hey Reese, give me an' Christoph another round.
A warm tavern and a cold ale. What more could we ask for?
%s raises the gun to his shoulder, aims it carefully then fires a shot at the target.
Die in the name of Ragnaros!
The Thandol Span fell to Ragnaros.  So shall the Stonewrought Dam!

female_text: If you're here, then it means you are prepared to begin the study of summoning demonic cohorts to do your bidding. We will start with the lowliest creatures you will be able to call and continue from there. Let us begin.
The easiest creature for you to summon is the imp. You should already be able to bring forth this minion but for completeness' sake I will start with him.
This foul little beast is the imp. It is small and weak, making it almost useless as a meatshield, and its damage output is mediocre at best. This creature is best used for support of a larger group.
Now that you have had a chance to study the imp, let us move on to the next minion you will be able to summon, the voidwalker.

This demonic entity is known as the Voidwalker. Its strength and endurance are significant, making it ideal for defense. Send it to attack your enemy, then use it as a shield while you use your spells and abilities to drain away your opponent's life.

If you've never seen one, it is a sight to behold. A very impressive creature both on and off the field of battle. Next, let us take a look at what I am sure all you male students have been waiting for. The succubus.

All right now. Aside from the obvious distractions a minion like this will provide against your more masculine foes, she is also capable of dealing out impressive amounts of damage. However, her fragile endurance makes her almost useless as a shield.
Study hard and you might one day be able to summon one on your own, but for now it's time to move on to the felhunter.
What you see before you is a felhunter. This creature's natural talents include spell lock and other abilities which make it unequalled when facing a magically attuned opponent.

When facing a spellcaster of any kind, this feral beast will be your best friend. Now, let us take a look at something a bit different. This next creature will aid your travels and make your future journeys much easier. Let's take a look at a felsteed.

I doubt you have had much occasion to see such a creature. These demonic equines will make your travels much faster by acting as your mount as long as you control them. However, they are difficult to control, so be sure you are ready before attempting it.
There you have it. Our lesson on summoning has come to an end. A new class will begin shortly, so if you wish to brush up, feel free to stay around.

Salutations.  My function is to offer access to and, when permissible, insight into information regarding the Creators' synthesis of the Earthen on the world designated as Azeroth.  I am ready to share this information with you now at your leisure.

The Earthen are a synthesized race engineered by the Creators, functioning as one of the seed races in the initial population of the world designated as Azeroth.  The Earthen were created to aid the Creators' efforts in shaping the deep regions of this world.$B$BThey are a modification of the standard subterranean being matrix used on other worlds that the Creators have seeded.  The construction of this prototype race created various anomalies that were observed after initial synthesis.

It is one of the synthesis matrices the Creators use when seeding a world.  Each synthesis matrix is used to achieve the Creators' goals.  For Azeroth, a subterranean being matrix was modified to create a being with increased durability with an affinity for deep region shaping; the Earthen are the product of this modification.$B$BAfter the Earthen had been put into service for the Creators, unforeseen anomalies were discovered that affected their synthesis matrix due to high-stress environments.

Additional background information on the Earthen must be given to you before this question may be answered properly.$B$BProcessing.$B$BTo understand the anomalies of the Earthen, it is first important to understand what the Earthen represent in their design intent.  The Earthen represent the Creators' attempt at improving the survivability paradigm of the standard subterranean being matrix.  This was done by incorporating a resilient foundation of construction inherent to the world into said matrix.

It is the baseline material used in race synthesis.  A cross-section of Azeroth's crust was used as the foundation for the Earthen's synthesis rather than the typical biomass construction foundation used by the Creators.$B$BResearch on the world's composition led the Creators to theorize that an enhanced being could be synthesized that would epitomize the resiliency of this world's essence.  This was accomplished by choosing to use a blend of Azeroth's various stone core compounds as the foundation.

Simply stated, this is correct.$B$BThe Earthen's physical features are that of a smaller stature humanoid, though their composition is that of Azeroth's various stone core compounds.  Their design maximizes strength and stamina without sacrificing cognitive processing power.  Their skin and musculature are nearly impervious to physical damage, and with very minor modifications the Earthen display a remarkable resiliency to unwanted magical forces.

It is integral to the assimilation of this data that it is understood that the Creators wanted to synthesize a race that would long be an integral part of this world's development cycle after they had departed.  This race would be instrumental in fulfilling the Creators' long-term development objectives for Azeroth.  $B$BAs an ancillary note, the nomenclature "Earthen" was deemed apropos for the new race by the Creators, based on the Earthen's composition.

The Earthen's only anomaly in synthesis is the tendency for matrix destabilization while being utilized in high-stress environments.$B$BAddendum: deep earth sculpting was naturally suited to the new matrix design and thus never met the qualifications of duplicating a high-stress environment.$B$BDestabilization was not discovered until well into the Earthen's primary service cycle for the Creators.  The Creators began work on post-synthesis modification, rather than recall and re-synthesis.

[There is a noticeable pause after you ask this question.]$B$BThe information you request is not currently available in this repository's data cycling.  I sincerely apologize for this omission.$B$BPlease request this information after a data cycling update has been performed on this information repository.  You may also request this information from another information repository located on Azeroth.

There are two potential results when the Earthen's synthesis matrix destabilizes.  Initiating visual aid representation number one.$B$BThe first variant matrix is a degenerative product of synthesis, hereby designated with the common nomenclature of "Trogg".  This variant maintains strength and stamina comparable to the Earthen, but its cognitive processing power has been almost completely compromised.  Force of will and a strong sense of cunning are the only driving factors in the psyche of the trogg.

I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThe trogg retains some composition of Azeroth's various stone core compounds, but the loss of cognitive power makes this variant unacceptable to the Creators.$B$BThe trogg procreates as per a standard biomass.  By default it consumes stone and anything else it can acquire, including other troggs.  Cannibalism is considered unacceptable by the Creators.

Initiating visual aid representation number two.$B$BThe second resultant variance of the Earthen matrix retains many desired elements when compared to the standard subterranean matrix.  The common nomenclature for this variant is "Dwarf".$B$BThis variant retains strength and stamina inherent to the Earthen.  In some cases, the dwarf even exceeds the cognitive powers of the Earthen's matrix.  The dwarf, however, retains none of the physical composition of Azeroth's various stone core compounds.

The data stored in this repository does indeed correlate with your astute proclamation.$B$BThe dwarf maintains an affinity for the stone composition of Azeroth, but due to the high-stress environmental anomaly within the Earthen's synthesis matrix, the dwarf reverts to a default biomass composition as seen in the standard subterranean matrix.$B$BErgo, the dwarf variant does synthesize from the degeneration of the Earthen creation matrix, as you inferred with your query.

I am unable to process your chronological reference in comparison to the recording of this data, my apologies.$B$BThough the dwarf maintains most of the Earthen's mental attunement to Azeroth's stone composition, the reversion back into living biomass remains the main degeneration of the matrix.  Dwarves eat and procreate through means typical to other standard biomasses.$B$BThe Creators view the dwarf as an acceptable variant, worthy of genesis in its own right.

The Creators are... the Creators.$B$BThey are the beings that seeded and shaped this world by their own design.  They are the reason for this world's existence, as well as many other worlds.  They are the wellspring from which Azeroth flows.

The Creators are cognizant of the magnitude of the information housed in this repository.  Subsequently, a portable copy of the data stored here will be made available to you once you are attuned with the Discs of Norgannon.$B$BPlease consider your cursory requirements for the assimilation of this knowledge to be complete.  At your leisure, access the Discs of Norgannon to begin synthesis of your discs.

I have heard orcs proclaim the odor of humans to be sickening and I have heard humans proclaim the odor of orcs to be wretched; yet, to me, all of the races of these lands give off the same odor: The foul, dizzying scent of greed.$B$BDo you doubt the validity of my claim? Do you not see these things that run your life as merely runoff from the greed which dictates your every decision?$B$BSo be it. As it was greed that displaced me from my home, it shall be greed that takes me back.

So you have returned to help Kum'isha, $r? Do not worry, the pang that you feel in the pit of your stomach is merely your willpower collapsing.$B$BThankfully, you will not need willpower for this collection. I am certain that you will enjoy the trinkets I will have waiting for you upon your return with the item.
Success, the rift is open!! My brethren, rise and return home! The Outland awaits!
Hurry brothers! You must go now! I do not know how much longer the rift will remain open!
And now you know why I live in a crater.

Weeks passed without word from the warchief; the men grew restless.$B$BIt was a judgment call, $n. I was young and ambitious, afraid of nothing. The battalion would set forth into the Blasted Lands under my command.$B$BA decision I would later regret.

Face my champion, mortals!
Prepare yourselves for an eternity of anguish and torture - vengeance shall be mine...

Would you believe that in my darkest hour, at the apex of my being, I failed.$B$BAs I fled from the wanton destruction of the forces that overwhelmed us, the only sounds I could hear were the screams of my soldiers and the rapid beat of my own heart.$B$BA short while later, I returned to the Blasted Lands in hopes of rescuing my men and restoring my honor. Instead I was captured and beaten until dead.$B$BWhat I found out during my inquisition and subsequent torture was horrifying.
Please continue, Hero...
female_text: Please continue, Hero...

male_text: My captors were cruel beyond measure, $n. They would alternate between Lieutenant Kirith and I, torturing one while the other watched. During a lull in the activity of an especially brutal day, Kirith told me what had happened to my men and a plan he had been formulating to free them from their masters.$B$BThey suffered a fate far worse than death, or even the pain Kirith and I  endured.
What could be worse than death?
female_text: What could be worse than death?

male_text: Neither you nor I could possibly imagine the pain an individual suffers when their soul is ripped from their body. They are not dead and by no means are they alive. Instead, they walk the land, servants of those that bind them to this world.$B$BLord Razelikh, demonic overlord of these lands, enslaved them all. Nine he took for his own, placing stones of binding near the Dark Portal. The remaining nine were divided up between his subordinates.
Subordinates?
female_text: Subordinates?

male_text: The archmage Allistarj of the Shadowsworn was granted three. Lady Sevine, warlock of the Shadowsworn was also granted three. The remaining three were given to Grol the Destroyer, lord of the Dreadmaul ogres of these blasted lands.$B$BYou see, $n, without a soul, the body cannot be killed. The remnants of my men are now indestructible fighting units. Thankfully, they are bound in how far they can travel by the stones of binding.
What are the stones of binding?
female_text: What are the stones of binding?

male_text: They are exactly what you need to destroy in order to free the regiment! As I had told you earlier, Kirith had a plan.$B$BEach of the servants does have a weakness. Punish their physical form in proximity of their stones until they are near the state of disintegration. It is at that point, and that point alone, that the stones of binding are vulnerable to attack. You must hurry to destroy the stones, however, as once the enslaved regain their composure, they will be invulnerable to harm once more.
You can count on me, Hero.
female_text: You can count on me, Hero.

male_text: I wish it were true, $n, but it will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.$B$BGather a suitable group of adventurers and would-be heroes and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.$B$BFight hard and die with honor, $n.
You must hear my story before we may continue, $n. It will be of great use to you in the future.
%s prepares to sting its victim as a last desperate move!
%s waits for the guards to be out of sight.
%s points to the west.
In need of some alchemy supplies, are we?  Or do you have other business with me?
Your discs are now ready!  Engage the Discs of Norgannon once again to retrieve them!
Oh no!  Here they come!
Let's move forward!
Wait here, $n. Spybot will make Lescovar come out as soon as possible. Be ready! Attack only after you've overheard their conversation.
female_text: Wait here, $n. Spybot will make Lescovar come out as soon as possible. Be ready! Attack only after you've overheard their conversation.

female_text: Milord, your guest has arrived. He awaits your presence.

female_text: Hero, I have urgent business with Corporal Splithoof.

Good day to you both. I would speak to Lord Lescovar.
female_text: Good day to you both. I would speak to Lord Lescovar.

female_text: Thank you. The Light be with you both.

male_text: Of course. He awaits you in the library.
female_text: Of course. He awaits you in the library.

male_text: Ah, thank you kindly. I will leave you to the library while I tend to this small matter.
Ok, here I go!
Get out of my sight, mortal. Your presence alone is enough to drive me to violence.
Rin'ji is free!
Under the cover of darkness.
female_text: Under the cover of darkness.

male_text: On the wings of death, I ride.
Rin'ji can see the road now, $n. Rin'ji knows the way home.
I shall use the time wisely, milord. Thank you.
female_text: I shall use the time wisely, milord. Thank you.

male_text: Living out here in the desert is rough! I get so thirsty standing outside in this heat.
Yes! I want more of that fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!
female_text: Yes! I want more of that fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!

Stop! Omosh time!
Don't listen to that old fool, kid. He's like that with everyone. I've been watching you, though; you got real talent. Come have a talk with me.
Help!$B$BIf you get me out of here, I can blow up the door that leads to the chief of Zul'Farrak!
Zul'Farrak - Weegli Blastfuse - Greeting default.
We have to kill more trolls!  Kill enough and I'll blow the door to the troll chief!
Thanks, $n.  If you hadn't shown up I'm sure we would have been dead meat!  Now the only thing between us and the chief troll is that door yonder...
Will you blow up that door now?
female_text: Will you blow up that door now?

male_text: Help!  My band and I have been captured by trolls, and they're going to sacrifice us!$B$BGet us out of here and I'll give you anything you want.
We don't have time to talk!  We have to think about those trolls!
Thanks a lot, $n.  We couldn't have made it without you.  Oh, and if I had mentioned before something about repaying you for saving us, well... you can forget it!
Hey Bly!  Bilgewizzle wants his divino-matic rod back!
female_text: Hey Bly!  Bilgewizzle wants his divino-matic rod back!

male_text: Zul'Farrak - Sergeant Bly - Greeting default.
I'm out of here!
No one challenges the Wastewander nomads -- not even robotic chickens!  ATTACK!
female_text: No one challenges the Wastewander nomads -- not even robotic chickens!  ATTACK!

Hi there! I have a proposition for an adventure-seeker such as you, if you are up to the challenge!$B$BAlong with my invention, the Super Egg-O-Matic, I am hard at work aiding the druids with their campaign to save the hippogryphs. The birds are being affected by the evil effects of the Gordunni ogres inhabiting the ruins of Feralas, and their numbers are dwindling.$B$BI collect many different types of eggs.  Will you help and find some for me?

male_text: Please tell me more about the hippogryphs.
female_text: Please tell me more about the hippogryphs.

In a place called Feralas to the west of here, the hippogryphs, long-time companions of the night elves, are in danger.$B$BI need you to rescue an egg from the ruins of Isildien, to the south, there. The Super Egg-O-Matic can analyze any egg brought to it and judge if it is likely to hatch. I then send the eggs along to the druids, safe from the Gordunni ogres' dark magics.$B$BPlease know, $n, some of the rescued eggs are bad eggs, and will never hatch.

male_text: Cloaking systems online!  CLUCK!  Engaging cloak for transport to Booty Bay!
Rin'ji will tell you secret now... $n should go to the Overlook Cliffs. Rin'ji hid something on island there.
You find it, you keep it! Don't tell no one that Rin'ji talked to you!

female_text: Tragic...

female_text: I shall.

Rin'ji needs help!
Get me out of here!
What?  How dare you say that to me?!?
Greetings, $n. Are you ready to train?
After all we've been through?  Well, I didn't like you anyway!!
Good day to you Nogg! I require training.
female_text: Good day to you Nogg! I require training.

male_text: Hello, $n! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!
Hello Sovik, I wish to browse your goods.
female_text: Hello Sovik, I wish to browse your goods.

male_text: Come and have a talk with me if you're going to go to Gnomeregan, $n!
Give me a moment while I calibrate the transponder to your height and weight specifications, $n.

female_text: Oh, there you are!
Oh, what a beautiful flower over there...
These trees are quite glorious, aren't they?
Are you sure this is the right way? Maybe we should go this way instead...
Hmmm, I wonder what's over this way?
Are we taking the scenic route?
Oh, I wandered off again.  I'm sorry.
This is quite an adventure!
I can't help it, really. This is just such a beautiful place.
The bell again, such a sweet sound.
Oh, here you are, Rockbiter! I'm sorry, I know I'm not supposed to wander off.
%s begins to wander off.

female_text: Greetings $c, I am the leatherworking trainer for Thunder Bluff.  What may I assist you with?
Don't forget to get my bell out of the chest here. And remember, if do happen to wander off, just ring it and I'll find you again.

male_text: I'm so glad yer back, Shay. Please, don't ever run off like that again! What would I tell yer parents if I lost ya?
Please tell me more about the Gordunni ogres.
female_text: Please tell me more about the Gordunni ogres.

The Gordunni are a large ogre tribe that has control over considerable portions of forests in Feralas. Their dark magic seeps into the elements around them, damaging both the environment and the creatures that inhabit it.$B$BIf you do decide to travel to Feralas, please be mindful of these ogres -- they are quite nasty and many are able to wield powerful dark magic.

%s activates!
Self-destruct sequence activated.
%s cheers!
Thank you for rescuing me! Word of your deed will not go unnoticed.
%s waves goodbye to everyone.
Hey!  Get away from our treasure!

female_text: That's our treasure, you lubber!

male_text: We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!
female_text: We didn't hide this stuff just you could steal it!

male_text: What?! How dare you!
Don't see many Blacksmiths this far from Ironforge. What can I do for ye?
The Defias shall succeed! No meek adventurer will stop us!
I just can't seem to get comfortable without a sturdy ceiling of granite over my head. All these stars up there, enough to give ye the shivers.

Now that's a piece of steel worth wearing. Form and function lad/lass, I am impressed. Only ever seen it's match once, a Master in the Great Forge named Grumnus Steelshaper. I bet he has learned a few things since then, could probably teach some to ye.
Go to the Great Forge at the very center of Ironforge. He works there, alongside the other Masters of our kind.

Well now, I haven't seen blades this fine since I left Lordaron with Proudmore and her people. I can't teach ye much more it seems, but if ye were to find Borgus Steelhand I bet he could show ye some things. Finest weaponsmith I ever met.

Borgus used to work at the Great Forge but I hear he moved down to Stormwind when they finished rebuilding. Rumor holds that he started a shop in the Dwarven District with a man named Kathrum Axehand.
Are you blind youngling? Shayis is standing right outside.
Your steel is strong, your skill stronger. Take your steel and your strength to my mate Shayis Steelfury, her skill with armor crafting is unmatched even by me.
Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.
What is it you seek at my forge? Is it training? Do you perhaps seek the secrets of steel? The mysteries of the forge? Speak up Grunt!
Where is he? Go next door, to the Arms of Legend. He forges special weapons for great heroes there. Honor him and he may show you how to make the stuff of legends.
Good blades, solid axes. I have nothing left to teach you in the making of weapons $n. Take your pride and courage before Kelgruk Bloodaxe, he will forge them into the skills you will need.
I see the exit! Hurry, hurry!
Anti-escape countermeasures activated. Self-destruct in t-minus 20 seconds....
Alarm-a-bomb unit 2600 has failed. Self-destruct override [ACTIVE]. Cooldown [ACTIVE].
Travel to Orgrimmar, to the Valley of Honor. There she lives with her husband and two daughters. All of them are smiths of great skill, but the spirits tell me that she will best guide your learning.

You guide the spirits in the steel to protect and defend with far more skill than I ever could. The student has surpassed the teacher and now I must send you to where your education may continue. $n, you must seek out Shayis Steelfury in Orgrimmar. She is the finest Armorsmith I have ever known, and she can teach you much.
Uh oh....

Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.

You have the look of a $g man : woman; who seeks knowledge. Perhaps you seek the teachings of the forge, and the hammer. Perhaps I can guide you down that path. But only once you have accepted the spirits, and listened to their calling.
Make the journey to Orgrimmar and seek him out in the Valley of Honor. He works in a shop called the Arms of Legend.

That is a fine weapon indeed $n. You guide the spirits like few I have ever known. Listen to them and they will guide you as you have guided them. Go, seek out the Orc known as Kelgruk Bloodaxe. He does not speak with the spirits but he does listen, and his weapons are the finest I have ever laid my eyes upon.
Go to Orgrimmar, you will find her and her brood in the Valley of Honor.

Armor like the kind you make could stop even the sharpest axe. I'm impressed $n, that doesn't happen often. Seek out an Orc named Shayis Steelfury, she makes the best armor outside of that cursed Dwarven stronghold.
How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.
Want to be a smith? Want to forge blades to gut your foe? Hammers to crush his skull? Aye I can help, and gladly too if there is blood to be shed from it.
Go to the Orc city of Orgrimmar, find him in the Valley of Honor at a shop called the Arms of Legend.
These are good blades you make, $n. Cut a stone and still sharp enough to slit a throat. I have seen better though, an orc named Kelgrum Bloodaxe makes them, go and learn all he can teach you.
$n! How have ye been $g lad : lass;? Show me what ye've learned since I saw ye last, we'll see if there's anything new I can teach ye.
Welcome back to the Great Forge, $n. Ye come to visit an old Dwarf or do ye think yer ready for the next step in yer training?
Good steel $n. Grab a hammer and come over here, let me show you the secret to forging a legendary weapon.
Back to learn more, $n? Come over here and show me you are ready.
What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?
What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

female_text: How are your travels, $n? $g Sumi and Tumi missed you, you should say hi after your lesson : I have heard tales of your adventures, sounds like you have been busy;. Now let's see what you've learned while you were away.
Yes? I have a breastplate to finish so this had better be good.
I see potential in you $n. Now grab a hammer and some of those scraps, you need a lot of practice.
I don't train smiths with no skill, come back when you have something decent to show me.

Please, a moment, $n. Kindal is down below in the Grimtotem camp trying to free the faerie dragons from captivity. We were just lucky that help came along when it did. Who knows what those foul tauren would have done to them.
Aw! The captured sprite darters didn't make it. What will we do?

female_text: With your help, I can evaluate these tunnels.
Let's see if we can find out where these Troggs are coming from.... and put a stop to the invasion!
Such devastation... what a horrible mess...

What function do you serve?
female_text: What function do you serve?

male_text: My purpose is to regulate access to the Uldum complex for the Creators.  I allow entry into the compound only when the solicitor exhibits for access the proper sequencing discs.$B$BYour disc set currently does not contain the Plates of Uldum, the primary prerequisite for entry.  Access is not granted unless the Plates of Uldum are present.
What are the Plates of Uldum?
female_text: What are the Plates of Uldum?

male_text: Where are the Plates of Uldum?
female_text: Where are the Plates of Uldum?

male_text: Excuse me?  We've been "rescheduled for visitation"?  What does that mean?!
female_text: Excuse me?  We've been "rescheduled for visitation"?  What does that mean?!

male_text: So... what's inside Uldum?
female_text: So... what's inside Uldum?

male_text: I will return when I have the Plates of Uldum.
female_text: I will return when I have the Plates of Uldum.

male_text: The Plates of Uldum are discs synthesized by the Creators that allow access into the Uldum compound.  These discs house and store specific data related to the Creators' activities here.$B$BPhysically, they are nearly identical in circumference to the disc set you currently possess.  Their markings, however, are directly related to information on Uldum as opposed to the Uldaman complex.

Several sets of the Plates of Uldum have been synthesized by the Creators for their expressed use.  The Creators control the distribution of said discs for all complexes on this world.  As such, Azeroth has been rescheduled for visitation, and therefore future discs may enter circulation at that time.$B$BExisting discs have been fully distributed to those parties with appropriate security clearance.

The Creators use visitation as a means to reestablish control over seeded worlds when forces, both external and internal, upset the matrix dynamics associated with it.  Such tactics are not to be taken lightly when executed by the Creators.$B$BFor additional information on this world's scheduled visitation, please consult the appropriate data repository that fields all Creator-related scheduling considerations.

Uldum is a research facility for the Creators in their continuing efforts to enhance the biosphere of Azeroth.  Specific information regarding their work as it relates to Uldum is restricted to those individuals who possess the Plates of Uldum in their disc sets.$B$BData repositories inside the Uldum complex have been programmed to address specific experiments and data compilations; please refer to them for detailed information.
Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal.

female_text: I'm ready when you are, $n. Lead the way!
We've done it! Meet me back by Jer'kai above the Grim Totem camp.
No! The faerie dragons aren't making it, $n! I must return to Jer'kai to make sure she hasn't been found. Elune be with you.

Thank the light you are here! I'd accept help from a two-headed ogre at this point.

The city has been overrun by troggs! The attempts to wipe them out resulted in mass contamination. But there is still hope.

Our scientists who evacuated to Ironforge are working on a cure for the fallout sickness. Meanwhile, if you can help me stop the trogg invasion, perhaps the city can be retaken.

male_text: I am ready to begin.
female_text: I am ready to begin.

male_text: Give me a couple minutes, $n. There was some excitement in here a moment ago, and I just want to make sure things have died back down. I'll talk to you soon enough.

female_text: Quickly! $n attacks!
Die, $n. Elune will not have you harm her creatures any longer!
Death to you, $n. How dare you come within a bow's shot of me!
You dare touch me?!

male_text: Make no sound during the ritual.  One misstep could spell our doom...
Now, watch...
There.  It is done.

female_text: It's quiet here....
...too quiet.
Look! Over there at the tunnel wall!
Trogg incursion! Defend me while I blast the hole closed!
I don't think one charge is going to cut it. Keep fending them off!
The charges are set. Get back before they blow!
Incoming blast in 10 seconds!
Incoming blast in 5 seconds. Clear the tunnel! Stay back!
FIRE IN THE HOLE!

Warning! Warning! Intruder alert! Intruder alert!
Sir?

female_text: Stand guard -- intruders are near.

female_text: That's it!  I'm tired of helping you out.  It's time we settled things on the battlefield!

female_text: Access: Discombobulator Ray
