Rise and defend your master!
The children of Sul will protect their master. Rise once more Sul'lithuz!

Incredible power can be found in the spirits or "muisek" of the creatures that we battle against.$B$BLook inside yourself; learn to harness the power of your own spirit, and you will be more powerful than you ever imagined.
The muisek vessels are now ready, $n.
%s begins the ritual.

Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.$B$BMany will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, $r, it exists.$B$B<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>
Tell me more, Trenton.
female_text: Tell me more, Trenton.

male_text: Split in two to form the one. The twin blades are bound to Zul'Farrak.$B$BSul'thraze reborn when the twins are found.
Skulls you will give and skulls I will take.
Be healed, my pets!

female_text: Well done! Without your help I would have never been able to thwart that wave of troggs.
Did you hear something?
I heard something over there.
More troggs! Ward them off as I prepare the explosives!

male_text: Never shall you find the twin blades of Sul.
There is no escape!
Succumb to the gaze, mortals!
You will pay for that...
The servants of sul will feast on your remains.
Death is merely a doorway to rebirth. The brood shall rise again.
The guards of Theramore are the finest group of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor. It is our duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance even so far away from our homes.

We don't know much about the burning of the Shady Rest Inn, except that James Hyal's wife and child were unable to escape.$b$bWe managed to drag James out, but he hasn't been the same since.$b$bWe have many leads but not much evidence. It is our hope that through the efforts of the guard and the vigilant help of the people of Theramore, we will unravel this terrible crime.$b$bIf you would like to lend assistance to the investigation, what remains of the inn can be found at the border to the Barrens.
What have you heard of the Shady Rest Inn?
female_text: What have you heard of the Shady Rest Inn?

male_text: You freed Kirith from his suffering? Inconceivable -- and now Trebor has sent you here to learn of demons and their minions?$B$B<Loramus laughs.>$B$BBe thankful the arcane pangs have finally dissipated, $r.
Can you see them, mortal? No... I did not think you could. Sighted but sightless - it is your gift and your curse.
Hail, Loramus. I bring word from the Blasted Lands.
female_text: Hail, Loramus. I bring word from the Blasted Lands.

male_text: Will you help?
female_text: Will you help?

male_text: In the age of war, Razelikh the Defiler served as the most fearsome of Lord Kazzak's lieutenants. When the Legion was defeated and Kazzak forced back into the Tainted Scar, Razelikh was tasked by his master to secure the Blasted Lands.$B$BWhile the Alliance fought petty battles with the Horde over territory outside of the Blasted Lands, Razelikh was uniting the differing Shadow Council sects and the brutish Dreadmaul ogres of the land.
Please continue.
female_text: Please continue.

male_text: Tragically, it was Thrall's wisdom that finally sealed the bond between the demon lord and his minions. It was Trebor's regiment that served as the catalyst to unite the demon lord, the shadowsworn sects and the ogres. The lure of nearly unlimited power and the granting of immortal shock troops to each respective leader sealed the deal in blood.
I do not understand.
female_text: I do not understand.

male_text: What Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol did not realize was that just as their servants were bound to the land, so would they be... You see, the price for their own immortality was also imprisonment and eternal servitude under the command of Razelikh. The cruel cunning of Razelikh had emerged the victor once again.
Indeed.
female_text: Indeed.

male_text: Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means

Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means.
I will do this with or without your help, Loramus.
female_text: I will do this with or without your help, Loramus.

male_text: Then let us pretend that you undergo the long and arduous task of creating the bane necessary to break through the demonic wards placed upon the triad. What would be your next course of action? To face the Defiler in his lair?$B$B<Loramus laughs.>
Yes.
female_text: Yes.

male_text: I wish to hear your story.
female_text: I wish to hear your story.

male_text: The humans claimed much of the Dustwallow Marsh for themselves, but the Stonemaul clan, with our help, has been able to push them back.
The Burning Inn.
female_text: The Burning Inn.

male_text: The humans built an inn on the edge of the Barrens. The Shady Rest, they called it. Weeks ago, it was burned down.$b$bThe Warchief told us to leave the humans alone, so long as they didn't cross our borders, but it appears someone violated his wishes.$b$bHe has put me in charge of getting to the bottom of it. If you wish to provide assistance, go to the remains of the Shady Rest Inn and return any clues you find to me.
Finding Reethe.
female_text: Finding Reethe.

male_text: If Reethe is somehow involved with the burning of the Shady Rest Inn, you'll have to find him and get some answers out of him.$b$bI sent Ogron to track him down. He was headed off to the southeast. Meet up with Ogron and then go find Reethe.

female_text: I don't care to hear it, $n. Nope, no way are you going to be let into the Searing Gorge. Impossible. Not going to happen. How many times do I have to tell you - I can't let you in! Do you not speak common? Are you an orc in disguise? N-O. NO!$B$BIf I let you in, then I have to let everybody in. Pretty soon your close friends will want in, then their distant relatives, then their friends, and so on and so forth. The last time that happened... well, we won't talk about the last time it happened.

male_text: What's the worst that could happen?
female_text: What's the worst that could happen?

Are you mad? Do you know what manner of beast inhabit that place? The worst that can happen is that we'll have to scoop up your remains with a shovel. We've lost some good dwarves to those awful monsters.$B$BSo the answer is no. If you're bent on getting to the Searing Gorge, you'll have to find another way.

male_text: Another way? Do tell...
female_text: Another way? Do tell...

I shouldn't even be telling you this but if you can make it past all the critters and beasties in Badlands, you might be able to make it to Searing Gorge.$B$BYes, the Badlands. There's some type of back road the orcs paved near Kargath. Just goes to show you what kind of fools we're dealing with here! A backdoor to hell? What were they thinking?

male_text: Orcs? Badlands? I'm invulnerable!
female_text: Orcs? Badlands? I'm invulnerable!
Invulnerable?

male_text: Absolutely!
female_text: Absolutely!
You're a fool that should heed my warnings. No one is invulnerable. You would be wise to remember that bit of advice.

male_text: My apologies, Pebblebitty.
female_text: My apologies, Pebblebitty.

I'll tell you what. Since you fancy yourself the hero type, if you can make your way through the Badlands to the Searing Gorge and bring me back something to prove your heroics, I'll see what I can do about getting you a key.$B$BIn the southeasternmost corner of Searing Gorge is a lady almost as tough as me, Margol the Rager. Maybe you should investigate.

male_text: Done, done, and done.
female_text: Done, done, and done.

male_text: %s dusts the base of the artifact.
%s meticulously examines the large vase.
Poor Dorius. If I ever get my hands on those Dark Irons, so help me...
I have just the spot for this horn!
I've been saving this spot for something special. I don't think it gets any more special than this, $n.
There we go. All done!
What can I do at an inn?
female_text: What can I do at an inn?

male_text: What can you do at an inn?$B$BWell when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.$B$BYou may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.
female_text: What can you do at an inn?$B$BWell when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.$B$BYou may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.
The final charge is set. Stand back!
10 seconds to blast! Stand back!!!
5 seconds until detonation!!!!!

male_text: We come from below! You can never stop us!

female_text: Nice work! I'll set off the charges to prevent any more troggs from making it to the surface.

male_text: Stop... need to catch.... my breath.
The secrets of Suntara will not leave these lands.
Ragnaros sees all, mortal.
Where does my path now lead, Jorn?
female_text: Where does my path now lead, Jorn?

male_text: You are well on your way, $n.  But you still have much to learn.  The southern Barrens may be where your next lesson is found.
Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.
I'm about to open a can on this $n.
Are you going to let an injured dwarf do all the work for you?
It's on! $n, meet my fists. Fists, say hello to $n.
This is the place, $r: The Cauldron! Mark it on a map or do something so that you don't forget. If anything ever happened to me, my team would be stuck in that mine forever.
Onward! And be on guard this time! I'm not going to carry anymore fights.
I've got to quit smoking! Give me a minute to catch my breath.
We're almost to safety. From here, we run. Try not to get too far behind! GO!
He's mine...
ARRRRRGH! He got me!
%s sniffs the air...
%s feasts!
%s disappears in a cloud of dust.
The gate is in sight! We're going to make it! But first, I need to take a breather.
You know not what you do!  We must destroy you for your own good.
Hear ye, denizens of Tanaris! Let it be known that $n is an exalted member of the Mithril Order. A blacksmith of honor, dedication, and infinite patience. Three cheers for $n!
It's in the hole!  It's in the hole!
He shoots, he scores!
From way downtown!
It's up and....it's good!
He puts the rock into the hole!
Swish!  We are on fire today boys.
GOOOOOOOAAAAAAAALLLLLLLLLLL!
In the pipe, 5 by 5!
Aye, it's a cold one today, but ne'er too cold to offer you my fine wares!
I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!
There's nothing like some scalding mornbrew on a chilly Dun Morogh day to get things started right!
Oooooo hot hot hot!  If that won't put spring in your step, I don't know what will!
I've been here long enough, $n. I'm sure we'll meet again. Good luck!

female_text: Infidels!
You dare interrupt our prayer? Execute them!
You will make a fitting sacrifice to Ragnaros.
Excellent, fresh blood has arrived.

male_text: Tell me about the Glowing Shard.
female_text: Tell me about the Glowing Shard.
You've come further than many, $n. Respect the elements around you and you shall fare far greater than most.

male_text: You have returned to finish the job? <Lathoric laughs.> Obsidion rise and annihilate them!
Your task is complete. Prepare to meet your doom.
Obsidion rise and serve your master!
Bravo! Bravo! Good show. What? You thought I was dead?
Fools, I knew that if I played upon my brother's feeble emotions, he would send 'rescuers.'
How easy it was to manipulate you into recovering the last Suntara stone from those imbeciles of the Twilight's Hammer.
When I stumbled upon the Suntara stones at the Grimesilt Digsite, the power of Ragnaros surged through my being. It was Ragnaros that gave me a purpose.
It was the will of Ragnaros that Obsidion be built. Obsidion will destroy the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire, uniting us with our bretheren in the fiery depths.
And ultimately, it was Ragnaros that named me when I was reborn as an acolyte of fire: Lathoric... Lathoric the Black.
%s's laughter trails off...
The altar seems to beckon to you as if it were alive.
Touch the Suntara stone and call forth Lathoric the Black and his guardian, Obsidion.
female_text: Touch the Suntara stone and call forth Lathoric the Black and his guardian, Obsidion.
I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns,$n. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

male_text: Guards! Help me!
female_text: Guards! Help me!
Greetings, $n. May Elune's wisdom guide your hand and heart. How may I help you today?

male_text: Salutations, Astarii. I require training.
female_text: Salutations, Astarii. I require training.

male_text: Been waitin' for ya, $n. Glad to see you've come through. Do you have the shipment?
Praise Elune! It has been many years since I have had visitors.
I wish to hear your tale.
female_text: I wish to hear your tale.

male_text: As a young night elf in Darkshore, I crossed paths with a group of unsavory individuals known as the Twilight's Hammer. A group of them befriended me and shamefully, I ended up eschewing my faith in Elune and embracing the vitriol of the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIt was not until a vision came to me from Elune, that I woke up from the malaise that I had fallen into as a follower of the old gods.$B$BIn repentance, I began work on my prayer to Elune.
Please continue, Zamael.
female_text: Please continue, Zamael.

male_text: Etched into a tablet of pure gold was the embodiment of my remorse, shame, regret, and sorrow. Unfortunately, the Twilight's Hammer found the tablet and branded me a blasphemer. I was summarily executed, my prayer to Elune incomplete. I am now bound to this world as a spirit, unable to transcend to the Nether; held in this cage as a warning to all that would betray the faith of the Twilight's Hammer.
Let me think about it, Zamael.
female_text: Let me think about it, Zamael.

male_text: Raze need go home now. Bye, bye, $r.

female_text: Use this Staff of Command on Raze when you are near Shadowsilk Poachers and he will make them rue the day they decided to poach in these lands.

male_text: Bye, bye, tiny little $r. Raze go now.

The ancient Altar of Hakkar stands silently near the entrance to the room.$B$BLooking to the balconies above it, you notice a large serpent-like statue rests on each. The statues look very much like the ones on the altar before you. They must be related in some way...
female_text: The ancient Altar of Hakkar stands silently near the entrance to the room.$B$BLooking to the balconies above it, you notice a large serpent-like statue rests on each. The statues look very much like the ones on the altar before you. They must be related in some way...

male_text: How could the altar and the statues be related?
female_text: How could the altar and the statues be related?

male_text: I want to begin the statue puzzle.
female_text: I want to begin the statue puzzle.

male_text: Tell me more about muisek.
female_text: Tell me more about muisek.

male_text: Existing in this area are many creatures considered allies of the night elves. The elves have had access to the power within each of these creatures; it is time that the horde be allowed this same satisfaction. I have devised a way that this power can be captured and used for our benefit.$B$BDo not doubt what I tell you, $n. Help me, and you shall see that I speak truth.
There'll be a new trade risin' up round your carcass, $n. We'll call it 'flesh-craftin.'
All they be doin' is a little huntin' and gatherin'. Where's the harm in that??
If tailoring is your thing, Vizzklick will most definitely have your supplies. Take a look around, $n, and let me know if you wish to purchase something!
I wish to browse your wares.
female_text: I wish to browse your wares.

male_text: Grab your things, $n! I've just gotten word from Nilith Lokrav in the Searing Gorge that the Undermarket has set up operations in the heart of the Cauldron. Find Nilith Lokrav in the Searing Gorge and get the low down!
One bright light appears accross the room, then disppears. Then you notice another beam... and then another.$B$BThey seem to be showing you a pattern.
female_text: One bright light appears accross the room, then disppears. Then you notice another beam... and then another.$B$BThey seem to be showing you a pattern.

male_text: The statues are all in place, and you may begin the puzzle.
female_text: The statues are all in place, and you may begin the puzzle.

male_text: %s goes into a berserker rage!
female_text: %s goes into a berserker rage!

male_text: Vengeance shall be mine.
Tell me what drives this vengeance?
female_text: Tell me what drives this vengeance?

male_text: My father was slain by the filth that inhabits the cauldron. My pleas for assistance to the Stormwind magistrate fell on deaf ears. Nay, they want not to admit that this part of the world even exists, let alone send their precious military in to administer justice.$B$BI seek vengeance, $r, plain and simple. Is there a more passionate cause in this world?
Continue please.
female_text: Continue please.

male_text: As you can see, I am but one man with a lumbering oaf of a squire. The might of the Dark Iron dwarves and the beasts held in the grip of Ragnaros would surely overwhelm me alone, but I have the utmost confidence that such a brave and ambitious adventurer such as you would have no problem handling the denizens of the cauldron. Should you choose to assist me, I shall reward you with riches and wealth beyond your wildest dreams.
Let me confer with my colleagues.
female_text: Let me confer with my colleagues.

male_text: We will enslave the quilboar!
We will spread across this barren land!
Soon, the Scourge will rule the world!
My eyes!  It burns... it burns...
Torture me no more!  Release me, mortal!  The Swamp of Sorrows... mortal... please...
Foolish mortal, I will rend your soul in two once I am released!
You are an agent of their wicked god, fool.  I will see you destroyed!
My soul is not a trinket!  Mortal, you must release me from these chains!
It hurts so much... Itharius, my old friend... please help me...
Will the nightmare ever end?!  I cannot force myself awake!
My charge to watch the temple has failed... my corrupted soul knows no peace...

female_text: Superb! Because of your help, my people stand a chance of re-taking our beloved city. Three cheers to you!

male_text: %s chants in an unknown tongue.
Be patient, $n. The torch is almost complete.
%s falls to one knee. He looks exhausted.
It is done...
Oh, $n, wait a minute! There's one more thing! Come back!
Conjure the Torch of Retribution, Kalaran.
female_text: Conjure the Torch of Retribution, Kalaran.

male_text: %s is released and now bound to you, $n.
%s engulfs the sentry tower. The tower is ablaze!

I give unto you cordial salutations, $r.  You've come far off the beaten path merely to speak to someone dwelling inside a cave.  I trust there is a reason for your strange, yet not unforeseen visit here.  Yes?
Glorious, indeed, Maltrake. It looks as if my plan worked perfectly. Wouldn't you say so, mortal?
You would not have helped the legion of Blackrock had we just asked for your assistance, now would you?
%s lets loose a reptilian laugh... at least you think it's a laugh.
What will we do with them, master? They are of no use to us anymore.
SILENCE FOOL!
They will live, if only to see the fruits of their labor: the destruction and chaos that will surely ensue as the legion of Blackrock invade the gorge.
I leave you now, mortals. Alive and with these trinkets. Maltrake! Present them with the trinkets!
Oh yes, the molt - do not lose it. There are those of my kin in the Burning Steppes that would craft items that only the molt of the black Dragonflight could fortify.
%s begins to flap his massive wings faster. He is preparing for flight.
The legion of Blackrock comes, dwarflings! We shall scorch the earth and set fire to the heavens. None shall survive...
Reset all of the statues in this room.
female_text: Reset all of the statues in this room.

male_text: The statues all move back into their original positions.$B$BThe sequence must be started again now, from the beginning.
female_text: The statues all move back into their original positions.$B$BThe sequence must be started again now, from the beginning.

male_text: Right away, master!

Greetings, $Gsir:miss;. I am Master Xylem's apprentice Nyrill. If you have any concerns, please feel free to bring them up with the master.$B$BI will be here to serve you when you're ready to return down to the base of the mountain.

I know who you are, $n.  Fate and forces beyond that have brought you to me for a reason, and it is one I take no pleasure in being a part of.  There are many decisions you will make in the coming times, and I hope you are wise enough to make the correct ones.$B$BBelieve me, $r, when I tell you this - there are correct choices.
What's an elf like you doing inside a cave like this?
female_text: What's an elf like you doing inside a cave like this?

male_text: You are quite inquisitive, though such inquisitiveness belies a general lack of understanding.  I say this because were you to have a definite purpose in being here, the question you ask would seem pointless. $B$BWith that, I bid you good day.
Do you know someone... or something, rather, by the name of Eranikus?
female_text: Do you know someone... or something, rather, by the name of Eranikus?

male_text: You know I do, mortal; I am abandoning a fair number of pretenses here, and I recommend you do the same.$B$BYou have come here clearly because you know that what you possess, garnered from your actions within the Sunken Temple of the Atal'al, has brought you to me for a purpose.  This purpose is to put my associate... my brother, to rest.  He is trapped within a nightmare within the Dream itself.  He cannot break free alone.
What happened to him in the first place?  When I... encountered him, he was rather malicious.
female_text: What happened to him in the first place?  When I... encountered him, he was rather malicious.

male_text: The god that the Atal'ai trolls had brought forth is to blame for this.  We destroyed the god's physical manifestation and sunk the temple, but the god was much stronger than even we had anticipated.  Its seed of corruption ran deep, twisting everything in its path.$B$BEranikus was charged to watch over the sunken temple to ensure that neither the simple Atal'ai nor their god would rise again.  He was an unwitting victim of this corruption, and we in underestimating its potency.
I possess part of Eranikus' essence.  What do you want with it... or with me?
female_text: I possess part of Eranikus' essence.  What do you want with it... or with me?

male_text: The fact that you are here is a first step... a correct choice if you will, in aiding Ysera's Dragonflight.$B$BYou may be here for purely the lure of personal gain, or you may be here because you are morally compelled.  Neither reason is important on its own, but both are in fact critical to this end: The agony that Eranikus endures is what rousted me from my Dream, and it is now my charge to see his torment ended.  I now ask you to aid me in this quest.
I will consider what you have told me.
female_text: I will consider what you have told me.

male_text: I have given you an oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight, $n.  When you are ready and able to aid us, use it, and then we may begin.
Good luck. Sorry I can't take you with me!
%s begins to summon wraiths out of the freezing cold air!
Intruders! Attack the intruders!
female_text: Intruders! Attack the intruders!

male_text: My banishment is ended! Let the blood flow!

Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $n. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.$B$BNow, I must get back to work!
%s staggers.
The shield be down! Rise up Atal'ai! Rise up!
Mistress!! They seek to destroy your work!!
Ha! Now your death is ensured!
All right, stay close.  These fiends will jump right out of the shadows at you if you let your guard down.

female_text: You dare! Now feel my wrath, $r.

male_text: The days we've spent here in Azshara are not among our best and most glorious, but we are still young and blood still courses through our veins--we shall find victory here. It is only a matter of time.

Belgrom sent us here from Orgrimmar to aid him in an unwise Alliance, but if his gamble pays off, then it will be to the great benefit of all the Horde.$B$BToo many orcs have already perished because of his desire to please women, but he still commands us, and our honor dictates we make the best of this situation.

female_text: I am not here because of honor, $n. I am here because of one orc's pride.$B$BIf I had not rejected Belgrom's offers, then I'm sure I'd still be in Orgrimmar taking care of real business.$B$BHis desire for women is not unknown to many of the female warriors in Durotar, but that doesn't stop him from being his charming self.$B$BHe's lucky he didn't pursue his desire for me much longer though--he'd be short more than just the digits on his hands.

Greetings, $n. I see you've come from Orgrimmar to aid us. I'm glad. I want to be out of this forsaken forest as quickly as possible. I'd much rather be spending my time in Orgrimmar with a good ale.$B$BAlthough I cannot wait to hear how Belgrom talked you into coming out here.

male_text: You've done it, $n! <The strangely familiar voice seems to be coming from the phial!> Hurry back! The fallout will only remain stable for thirty minutes.
Okay, here we go.  It's going to take about five minutes to shut this thing down through the ritual.  Once I start, keep the vermin off of me or it will be the end of us all!
Who dares?! I will destroy you!
DUMMY SPELL TEST MESSAGE
Three minutes left -- I can feel the energy starting to build!  Keep up the solid defense!
Just two minutes to go!  We're half way there, but don't let your guard down!
One more minute!  Hold on now, the ritual is about to take hold!
That's it -- we made it!  The ritual is set in motion, and idol fires are about to go out for good!  You truly are the heroes I thought you would be!
%s lashes at your collection phial. The green glow encases you. You don't look so hot, pal.
What brings you to the Cenarion Circle, $n?
I am here for training.
female_text: I am here for training.

male_text: I know, I know, I'm out here in the middle of nowhere!$B$BMy home is actually in Ratchet, but after crashing my zeppelin here, I thought I might as well start the research I came here to do!
This spirit hovers over its fallen body.  Its ghostly eyes pierce through you as it gazes beyond...
Feralas - Screecher Spirit - On Quest Default Greeting
%s is getting really hungry!
%s is VERY HUNGRY!

female_text: The land of Feralas has been through much, $r. The earth, the trees, the creatures; they are all changing what Feralas is and will be.$B$BThe Twin Colossals above us remain as a constant, though, throughout all that has happened here...

male_text: To get down safely, I provide wings to those in need.
Can you help me get down?
female_text: Can you help me get down?

male_text: Well, now that you mention it, yeah, I did see something I thought was a little strange yesterday afternoon!$B$BI was running past some old troll ruins southeast of here; well, I wasn't really running, more like hopping... The sand's so hot!$B$BAnyway, so I was hopping past the ruins, when I noticed a camp set up there. Seems like a funny place to set up camp, if you ask me... I would have poked around a little more but one of those crazy big vultures chased me off.
Raze follow $n! Raze SMASH poachers! SMASH SMASH SMASH! Tell Raze to SMASH by playing with stick! SMASH!
There! Job's done.
Don't worry, I'll find a good home for ya.
Can anyone give my adorable, extra little kitty a home?
I can't believe dad won't let me keep your sister.
Kitten for sale, looking for a good home.
What does allergic mean anyway? And what does it have to do with either of my kitties?
Will someone please give my little kitten a good home?

female_text: No!  We cannot allow you to summon Hakkar!
You must not summon our god!
No!  You must not do this!
Stop!  Infidels!
Wha... what's happening?

male_text: Thank you for saving me!$B$BI'm a cook and an alchemist from Stormwind.  I was here looking for local herbs and recipes for my uncle Angus when these quilboar captured me.  If you hadn't come around, I'm sure I'd have ended up in their stew pot!
You can cook?  So can I!  Is there a recipe you can teach me?
female_text: You can cook?  So can I!  Is there a recipe you can teach me?

male_text: Hm... yes, I do have a recipe you might find useful.  Let me teach you!
You're an alchemist?  So am I.  Perhaps you can teach me what you know...
female_text: You're an alchemist?  So am I.  Perhaps you can teach me what you know...

male_text: Well yes, I do know a rare alchemical recipe.  Let me teach you!
%s is noticeably weakened. The Felcurse is working!

female_text: %s is substantially more susceptible to your attacks. The Felcurse is working!

male_text: %s seems to no longer be able to cast spells. The Felcurse is working!
Your fel weapon is ready, $n.
I DRAW CLOSER TO THIS WORLD!
NOOOO!!
I AM HERE!
DIE, MORTALS!

female_text: %s begins casting a counterspell...

male_text: I'm going to carefully mix this - oops! ...Well, I spilled a little, but it's ready!
Who dares summon me?
Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.
Access secret goblin engineering schemata!
female_text: Access secret goblin engineering schemata!

male_text: Greetings!  If you are here to access gnome engineering schemata, please have your gnome engineer membership card ready for verification.
Access secret gnome engineering schemata!
female_text: Access secret gnome engineering schemata!

male_text: Hello there $glad:lass;... the name's Oglethorpe and I may be responsible for one of the amazing gnomish devices you might possess!  If it blew up, then it wasn't me; if it made you rich though, we can discuss royalties!$B$BOh, and if you're from Gnomeregan, you can just take two ninety degree angles, smash them together, and start marching.  I have nothing to say to you.
Well, if it isn't $n!  It's good to see you again; I cannot express my gratitude enough at the help that you've given me and my invention work to date.$B$BWhat can I do for you today?

I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!$B$BAlso, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...
Let me break down a little math for you: "goblin" plus "engineering" equals KNOW HOW, baby.  Anyone who tells you otherwise simply doesn't know how to add.
Grunts! Attack!
female_text: Grunts! Attack!

male_text: Guardians! Defend Sen'jin!
female_text: Guardians! Defend Sen'jin!

male_text: You will not defile our sacred land!
female_text: You will not defile our sacred land!

male_text: Guards!
female_text: Guards!

male_text: Sentinels, come to my defense!
female_text: Sentinels, come to my defense!

male_text: Through my studies, I see that defeating the god Hakkar's avatar has weakened him.  But the bulk of his strength remains, lurking at the far end of the Nether.$B$BYou have defeated his avatar once, $n.  Perhaps if you defeat it again you can further weaken the god so that, one day, we might face his true self.$B$BI have prepared a spell that you may use to again summon an avatar of Hakkar within the Sanctum of the Fallen God.  Do you want to confront it once again?
Sentinels, come to my defense!
female_text: Sentinels, come to my defense!

male_text: Greetings, $c.  Though time and drink have dulled my outer senses, my inner eyes remain strong.
Guards! Help me!
female_text: Guards! Help me!

male_text: Yes.  Give me the spell to summon the avatar.
female_text: Yes.  Give me the spell to summon the avatar.

male_text: Guards!
female_text: Guards!

male_text: Intruders! Attack the intruders!
female_text: Intruders! Attack the intruders!

male_text: %s searches for a source of arcane energy.
%s growls.
Hello, $n. I train and care for young hippogryphs here; feel free to have a look around.
Tell me more about these hippogryphs.
female_text: Tell me more about these hippogryphs.

male_text: Druids are very sensitive to the plight of all creatures of the world. When it was found that these birds were in danger, we set up a system of rescuing them from the corruption of Feralas.$B$BA gnome named Curgle Cranklehop leads the affair; she collects the eggs and has them sent here, where I care for them.$B$BWe could always use more help for our cause, $n. Maybe you should head over to Gadgetzan and look for Curgle.
Thank again, $n.  Now I'll just wait here until it's safe to leave.
You will need to open the Felhound Tracker Kit and read the instruction manual. Summon the beast when you are near the peninsula of cliff giants, south of here.
Thank you, little $r!
Your talents in cooking are a little too low.  Maybe with some practice I can teach you what I know.
Your skills in alchemy aren't yet high enough to benefit from my teachings.  Perhaps if you speak with me later...
Captain, here they come! The naga are coming!
female_text: Captain, here they come! The naga are coming!
The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Even if you do not follow the path of the warlock, you would do well to remember that.

male_text: A pleasure, $n. What can I do for you?
Guards!
female_text: Guards!

male_text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.
female_text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

male_text: Thank you.
female_text: Thank you.

male_text: I am bound eternally to this cursed world. What is it you desire, mortal?
I wish to face the Defiler.
female_text: I wish to face the Defiler.

male_text: By your command!
female_text: By your command!

male_text: Leave this place. <The relic emits a white hot arc of flame. A memory has been gained: A lone Dark Iron dwarf is surrounded by seven corpses, kneeling before a monolith of flame.>
You will perish here. <Your mind fills with visions of chaos and destruction.>
Do not taint these ruins, mortal. <You are engulfed in a blinding flash of light. A creature composed entirely of flame is the only thing you can remember seeing.>
Help us, outsider. <The relic crumbles to dust. A vision of eight Dark Iron dwarves performing some sort of ritual fills your head.>
He cannot be defeated. <The relic burns to nothing. The memories it held are now your own. This city was destroyed by a being not of this world.>
Your existence is acknowledged. <The relic turns to dust. Your head throbs with newfound wisdom. Something evil lurks in the heart of the mountain.>
Defiler... you will be punished for this incursion. <A symbol of flame radiates from the relic before it crumbles to the earth.>

female_text: Greetings, $n. Have you come to learn of the history of Ironforge?
Notify me when you are ready to listen to the story.

male_text: I am ready, Historian Archesonus.
female_text: I am ready, Historian Archesonus.

Hundreds of years ago, the great city of Thaurissan stood proudly in a lush expanse of land that is now the dilapidated Burning Steppes.$B$BThaurissan was home to the nation of Dark Iron dwarves and at the time, in the midst of a civil war among the dwarven nation at large.$B$BYou see, that area of the world was at one point in time part of the Redridge Mountains - until the day that Thaurissan was consumed by a gigantic explosion. The city lay in ruin, the surrounding areas reduced to an ashy wasteland.

male_text: That is tragic. How did this happen?
female_text: That is tragic. How did this happen?

We do not know.$B$BThe Dark Irons that did survive made their way into the mountain and began rebuilding their city.$B$BFrom the ashes of Thaurissan then rose Blackrock Spire and the new Dark Iron nation. Additional fortifications were made within the Searing Gorge, in the area known as the Cauldron.$B$BStories of an ancient evil that controlled the kingdom of Dark Irons began to circulate.

male_text: Interesting, continue please.
female_text: Interesting, continue please.

Recently, the Dark Irons have been seen on the surface world with greater regularity. Fortresses have been built in the Badlands. Massive exploratory forces have been sent into the depths of Uldaman in search of ancient lore. They have even invaded our own homeland, striking at our dam near the loch.

male_text: Unbelievable! How dare they??
female_text: Unbelievable! How dare they??
We need adventurers to assist us, $n. Will you help?

male_text: Of course I will help!
female_text: Of course I will help!

male_text: You did a great job, Spybot! Glad to have you back here with me!
female_text: You did a great job, Spybot! Glad to have you back here with me!

male_text: That's it! That's what you were waiting for! KILL THEM!
female_text: That's it! That's what you were waiting for! KILL THEM!

male_text: Um, hello!  If you are here about fee collection and/or a summons, then you must have me mistaken for someone else.  Terribly sorry!

female_text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.
Thank you $g mister : miss; for finding my necklace!  You're the best!

male_text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
female_text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

male_text: Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?
I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
female_text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

male_text: Thank you again for helping Hilary, $g mister : miss;!  When I grow up, I wanna be a hero just like you!
Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
female_text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

male_text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.
female_text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

male_text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.
female_text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

male_text: I live only to serve the master.
Present the trinkets, Maltrake.
female_text: Present the trinkets, Maltrake.

male_text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.
female_text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

male_text: Meow!

female_text: I know how to speak kitty, and Effsee said thank you.

male_text: Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?
female_text: Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?

male_text: Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?
female_text: Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?

male_text: Yes, I offer training. But it's not cheap.
female_text: Yes, I offer training. But it's not cheap.

male_text: Hello, $n! I am master engineer, Scooty.
Of course I offer lessons to other Enchanters, provided you are ready.
female_text: Of course I offer lessons to other Enchanters, provided you are ready.

male_text: I lost my transponder and need another one, Scooty.
female_text: I lost my transponder and need another one, Scooty.

male_text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.
If you are here to waste my time, then you are wasting the time of the Cenarion Circle as a whole.  For your sake, let us hope that you are not foolish enough to be doing just that.

I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!$B$BWith thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

Hello, $c.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!$B$BAnd if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.
Hello, $n.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!$B$BThelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

female_text: Ahoy, $n! Not a pretty picture, is it?$B$BThe Horizon Scout at the bottom of the sea, my crew in shambles, and our cargo and passengers strewn about like so much debris that you'd think this was one of Stormwind's canals after a festival.$B$BAnd that's not where the trouble ends...

male_text: %s bellows a challenging roar!
Conspiracies abound, I say.  There are those who lack vision in understanding what I do, and would seek to keep me shackled to obscurity!$B$BDon't step in the dirt.
What are you doing out here?
female_text: What are you doing out here?

male_text: What am I doing?  Do you lack vision?  I am a dreamer, good $g sir : lady;, and I dream of a better future for us all.  Clearly, I am a visionary.$B$BThere are those, however, who seek to keep us mired in banality.  I told him that I was a dreamer, and Arch Druid Staghelm replied, "Well, the world needs ditch diggers too."$B$BUntil such time as the shackles of banality are ripped from us, I will help the Cenarion Circle by shuffling these piles of dirt around.
Greetings, $r. I am Franclorn Forgewright. Are you here to learn of the Spire and of Dark Iron?
Amazing! I've never spoken to a ghost. I wish to learn!
female_text: Amazing! I've never spoken to a ghost. I wish to learn!

male_text: I had no choice, or so I thought. I would endure the destruction of Thaurissan and stand by the side of my king and his people.$B$BUnder the control of Ragnaros, King Dagran Thaurissan tore out the heart of this mountain and erected Blackrock Spire. We worked tirelessly to build a dwarven city mightier than any city or fortress that came before... or would come after.
Continue please.
female_text: Continue please.

male_text: I stood by and watched the corruption of Ragnaros seep through the hearts and minds of the Dark Iron nation. This once honorable race, driven to madness... to evil.$B$BWhen the construction of the Spire was complete, my will to live amongst my people gave way. I passed as a hero of the new nation of Dark Iron. This tomb was placed here - at the entrance to the city I planned and built - in honor of my efforts.
Fascinating. Please, tell me more.
female_text: Fascinating. Please, tell me more.

male_text: My great hammer, Ironfel, was handed down to the new chief architect, Fineous Darkvire: A man of despicable motive and little talent.$B$BThis is where you come in, $n. I want him stopped. He is too inept to harness the true power of Ironfel, but should one come after him with the aptitude to use Ironfel to its full potential, the destruction they could cause with their creations would be disastrous to this world.
Just show me the way, Franclorn.
female_text: Just show me the way, Franclorn.

male_text: You will find Fineous Darkvire beyond the Ring of Law, in the Hall of Crafting. Kill the miserable cur and recover Ironfel.$B$BTake Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place the hammer in its rightful place: In the hands of the statue erected in my honor.$B$BWhen this is done, the compartment in which I stored the master key will open. More importantly, Ironfel will remain forever in my grasp. Should they make an attempt to remove the hammer; both the statue and hammer will shatter, lost forever.

Yes, but you'll find it more rewarding if you have skill in herbalism!  You will be required to nurture and cultivate special seeds -- not to swing an axe blindly or gesticulate wildly at passing shadows.  While the Evergreen Pouch you'll receive allows even the simplest brute to grow something, those who show some aptitude will have more bountiful results.
I'm not a journeyman herbalist -- am I able to still assist you in your work?
female_text: I'm not a journeyman herbalist -- am I able to still assist you in your work?
Stand prepared! The naga won't wait long to press their advantage once they know we're alive.

male_text: Be advised, $g Jackson : Princess; - I am in no mood for any comment that you think is cute or funny.  I am here to make sure that the Arch Druid's research proceeds as planned, and my orders are to weed out all non-hackers who do not pack the gear to serve in my beloved Cenarion Circle.

female_text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

male_text: Amakkar, where do you think Warlord Goretooth is going to send us? I don't think I can handle another tour in the Steppes.
Hrmmm...
Quit being such a baby, Razal'blade. It's time to start acting like you're part of one of the Warchief's elite forces. You don't want to end up like Gargal, do you?
%s seems oblivious to the nearby commentary.
Proudtusk!
No, Gargal. Just no.
But...
NO! Shhhh! Just shut up. Goretooth is coming!
%s laughs.
Watch where you're stepping, $c, because I have a polymorph spell with your name on it...
All present and accounted for, SIR!
FALL IN, MAGGOTS!
I love pie.
female_text: I love pie.

male_text: Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.
female_text: Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.
So what's this new plague all about?

male_text: This pie is so good, would you like some?
female_text: This pie is so good, would you like some?

male_text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.
female_text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.
Oh, it's just terribly, terribly, awful! You will just DIE when you see it, Vivian.

male_text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.
female_text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.

male_text: Try some of this cherry pie, it will put a smile on your face, ten miles wide.
female_text: Try some of this cherry pie, it will put a smile on your face, ten miles wide.

male_text: Fresh cherry pie for sale, looks so good it will bring a tear to your eye.
female_text: Fresh cherry pie for sale, looks so good it will bring a tear to your eye.
Oh, do tell! The suspense alone is enough to make a girl scream!

male_text: Cherry pie is my favoritist food in all of Azeroth.
female_text: Cherry pie is my favoritist food in all of Azeroth.
Well, from what I hear, the new plague has ALL of the old plague flavor but none of the old plague calories or carbohydrates!
Oh, how positively delightful!
%s claps excitedly.

male_text: Very well, Proudtusk, you may begin your march. Carry on!
Well hello there ladies. Heard about the new plague?
SIR, YES SIR!
You heard the Warlord, maggots! MARCH!
Well done, soldiers! At ease!

female_text: %s blushes.
Ewwwww... not if you were the last orc on Kalimdor, Lunk.

male_text: %s laughs.
Ah, look at the time! I must return to my post... up over there.
If you'll excuse me, I must take my leave. Good day, ladies.
Great dangers lie beyond those walls, $n. turn back until you are more seasoned in the ways of combat.
Your reign of terror ends now!  Face your doom mortals!
You must be hard up to be wandering these Badlands, $c.  Hard up like me.$B$BOr maybe you're here because you're crazy.  Crazy, like me.
%s runs for their life!
%s reaches out towards Captain Beltis as he falls.
female_text: %s reaches out towards Captain Beltis as she falls.

male_text: This evil cannot be allowed to enter this world!  Come my children!
Get away from there!
female_text: Get away from there!

male_text: Oh, if I only had a tree branch to hold up in front of me. The guards would never see me then.

You'll have to be patient with me, $n. I've got my Spybot inside working on a very delicate matter. I'll be with ya in a second.$B$BOh, and do me a favor, try not to let Lescovar see you... we're about to ambush him.
GOR'TESH DEAD?!?!
RUN! RUN FOR HILLS!
WHO KILL GOR'TESH!?!? WHO DO THIS?!
Rough times, huh, $n? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.
$n KILL! $G He:She; kill you now! RUN! RUN!
Run for hills! Wait! We already in hills!
I'd like to see what you have to sell.
female_text: I'd like to see what you have to sell.

male_text: %s looks up at you quizzically. Maybe you should inspect it?
Launch me!
female_text: Launch me!

male_text: Greetings!

female_text: You are indeed powerful, $n. Come to me if it is more work that you seek.

male_text: My eyes never deceive me, $r. I see great power in you - enough power, perhaps, to further our cause. Find me at the top of the tower.
Hi there! The name's Gregan. What can I do for ya?
Buy somethin', will ya?
female_text: Buy somethin', will ya?

male_text: Can you tell me how I can get a Videre Elixir?
female_text: Can you tell me how I can get a Videre Elixir?

male_text: Sure thing, $n. You look like you can be trusted... Trustworthy! I can spot that a mile away...$B$BAnyway, back to what I was sayin'. Takes one Evoroot plant to make the Videre Elixir. The rest 'a the ingredients are trivial really, but the Evoroot, well, that can be a bit tricky to get.
Key... get the key... Gerstahn has... key.
Try and make yourself useful, $r. GET ME OUT OF HERE! The High Interrogator has the key.
HEY! HEY YOU! $R! Get me out of here!
%s groans.
Ok, let's take a look at this thing...
Oh, darn...

female_text: Ok!  Let's get started!
... oops.

male_text: Get it over with you filthy $r.$B$B<Kharan lowers his head, exposing his stubby neck.>
I am not here to harm you, Kharan. Gor'shak sent me. He told me that you would speak to me about the Princess.
female_text: I am not here to harm you, Kharan. Gor'shak sent me. He told me that you would speak to me about the Princess.

male_text: All is lost...
All is not lost, Kharan!
female_text: All is not lost, Kharan!

male_text: Do I look stupid to you, $r? I may as well sign her death warrant myself! Why should I trust you?
Because you are still alive and my hands aren't gripped firmly around your stubby little neck.
female_text: Because you are still alive and my hands aren't gripped firmly around your stubby little neck.

male_text: <Kharan sighs.>$B$BI suppose... I suppose you are right.$B$BGor'shak told me that your Warchief has big plans. Plans that may change the way the Alliance and Horde interact. What do you know about this?
Nothing. My orders were to speak with you and then speak with Thrall. All I know is that Thrall is interested in saving your princess.
female_text: Nothing. My orders were to speak with you and then speak with Thrall. All I know is that Thrall is interested in saving your princess.

male_text: Then listen well, $r.$B$BSeveral months ago, the Magistrate of Lakeshire sent envoys to Ironforge, pleading with the King for assistance with the Blackrock incursions coming from Redridge and the Burning Steppes.$B$BPrincess Moira volunteered to help, against my pleadings. I was assigned twenty elite guardsmen to protect the Princess through the perilous journey from the Loch to Lakeshire.
Which would explain why you're sitting in a jail cell at the bottom of a mountain, right, dwarf?
female_text: Which would explain why you're sitting in a jail cell at the bottom of a mountain, right, dwarf?

male_text: <Kharan clears his throat.>$B$BWe made our way through the Searing Gorge tunnel and into the ravaged wasteland comprising the gorge. In retrospect, things were eerily quiet. The only dangers we ran across were the wildlife of the region: Creatures that my men easily dispatched.$B$BWe reached Blackrock Mountain with relative ease and made our way through the stonewrought construction without so much as a hiccup.
So what happened?
female_text: So what happened?

male_text: As we were making our way across the Burning Steppes, we were ambushed. It must have been a hundred of them... Dark Iron dwarves! They were shifting out of the walls, from the rocks in the Steppes; out of every crevice, nook, and cranny in sight. They swarmed us, overwhelming the guards and the few brave heroes that had agreed to assist us on this mission.$B$BOne thing was clear: This was a highly orchestrated ambush. It was as if they knew every move we would make before we made them...
So you suspect that someone on the inside was involved? They were tipped off?
female_text: So you suspect that someone on the inside was involved? They were tipped off?

male_text: How else could this have happened? Someone must have tipped the Dark Irons off.$B$B<Kharan shakes his fist at you.>$B$BSo help me, if I ever get out of here, I will spend the rest of my days finding the traitor.
Continue with your story please.
female_text: Continue with your story please.

male_text: Where was I? Oh yes, so we were captured. My elite guardsmen were executed on the spot. They spared me and took the princess away by way of ram. I was taken to the detention halls of the Slag Pit and then transferred to this prison.$B$BI can only assume I am still alive because they wish to extract a ransom for my pitiful life. Or maybe out of cruelty, as a way to let me forever play back the events that transpired in my mind. Regret is the cruelest jailor of all, $r.
Indeed.
female_text: Indeed.

male_text: She now resides at the side of Emperor Thaurissan. He has her under some sort of powerful thought altering spell... and here I sit, completely helpless.
If it's any consolation, I'll be leaving the cell door open. How you get out is your problem. Good bye, Kharan.
female_text: If it's any consolation, I'll be leaving the cell door open. How you get out is your problem. Good bye, Kharan.
%s holds the Rune of Escape in front of her.

male_text: I am here!
Only a fool would dare disturb me in my lair.
I present you with proof of my deeds, Cyrus.
female_text: I present you with proof of my deeds, Cyrus.

male_text: I do not possess any proof, Cyrus.
female_text: I do not possess any proof, Cyrus.

male_text: <Cyrus's eyes glow brightly>$B$BDo I devour you whole or do I allow you to live?$B$BPerhaps you could still be of some use...$B$BChallenge my minion, $r. Survive and return proof of your victory to me.
A defender has fallen!
Be alert, you lazy mules!
I am ready!
female_text: I am ready!

male_text: Grumble, grumble...
Look for Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.  Find it in the middle of The Drag, west of the huge tree.
female_text: Look for Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.  Find it in the middle of The Drag, west of the huge tree.

male_text: Potions and oils, these are things that Yelmak will teach you of if you are worthy.  Look for his shop in the middle of The Drag.
female_text: Potions and oils, these are things that Yelmak will teach you of if you are worthy.  Look for his shop in the middle of The Drag.

male_text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.
female_text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

male_text: Maybe Saru Steelfury will teach you to make an axe as good as mine some day.  Find him at The Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor down the path to the right past Red Canyon Mining.
female_text: Maybe Saru Steelfury will teach you to make an axe as good as mine some day.  Find him at The Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor down the path to the right past Red Canyon Mining.

male_text: You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.
female_text: You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.

male_text: Grumble...
You'll want to learn from Zamja.  Head to Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag by taking the stairs on the left as you enter from the Valley of Strength.
female_text: You'll want to learn from Zamja.  Head to Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag by taking the stairs on the left as you enter from the Valley of Strength.

male_text: %s sniffs the bait.
Godan's Runeworks is where you'll go.  Look for it on the west end of The Drag, right next to the Valley of Wisdom.
female_text: Godan's Runeworks is where you'll go.  Look for it on the west end of The Drag, right next to the Valley of Wisdom.

male_text: Can you enchant my axe?  I'll want a permanent.  Maybe later then.  Find Godan's Runeworks on the west end of The Drag near the Valley of Wisdom.
female_text: Can you enchant my axe?  I'll want a permanent.  Maybe later then.  Find Godan's Runeworks on the west end of The Drag near the Valley of Wisdom.

male_text: %s gnaws at the bait ravenously.
Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

male_text: So where was I? Oh yea, so the orcs rushed Windsor and Windsor, well, he didn't move an inch. He stood tall as they charged him, ten at a time. All I could see was the glow from Ironfoe and a lot of blood. This went on for hours, maybe days. I don't remember. Anyhow, FINALLY, it stopped.

male_text: Slow down! I was getting to that!$B$BSo there he was, standing tall with all the blood and guts dripping off him when who shows up?$B$BThe Dark Irons! The Northern Pylon accepts yellow, red, and green crystals.$B$BThe focus is the energy that can be created using yellow crystals as the main source of power. The Western Pylon accepts red, green, and blue crystals.$B$BThe Pylon focuses on the energy that can be created using red crystals as the main source of power. There are two possible effects: one that increases your protection from damage, and one that weakens an enemy's defenses.$B$BCrystal Ward requires red and green crystals. male_text: What plants are in Felwood that might be corrupted?
female_text: What plants are in Felwood that might be corrupted?

I have observed four different kinds of plants that have been affected by the corruption: the songflower, the windblossom, the whipper root, and the night dragon plant.  The songflower and windblossom are common plants in Felwood, while the whipper root and night dragon are seen less frequently.  All are a vital part of Felwood's ecosystem.

My brother and I, along with our companions, travel Azeroth exploring the wild and untamed majesty.  It is exciting... but, um... male_text: Hello stranger, and welcome to the untamed majesty of Un'Goro Crater!$B$BMy name is Williden Marshal.  My sister, our companions, and I make up Marshal Expeditions - scientists and explorers of Azeroth's wild and great unknown.$B$BWe've hit a bit of a rough patch here, and we're looking for some help if you have the time!

female_text: This is where things get interesting.  My plan is to follow the mountail wall, keeping it to our left.  That way, we won't get lost in the jungle and we'll cut down on the hostiles.  You ready?
Here's the eastern mountain wall!  I'm cutting towards the south now; try and keep up.  We're not out of the thick of it yet!
Here's the path out of Un'Goro!  We made it!  All we have to worry about is the Tanaris desert now.
Here it is -- the Tanaris desert.  Funny how an inhospitable place like this looks better than a lush jungle once you've been trapped in it forever.

male_text: You have been sentenced to death for crimes against the Dark Iron nation!
The Sons of Thaurissan shall watch you perish in the Ring of the Law!
Unleash the fury and let it be done!

But your real punishment lies ahead.
Good riddance!
Incredible! Amazing! I don't even know what this means!

Look at these samples! What does it mean? What does it mean? I'm going to need time, time to look at all this information. And I'll need more information. Information I can't get... damn! Think, Laris, think!$B$BWhat are you going to do? What?!$B$BThere has to be a solution!
There must be someplace on Azeroth that we can find oozes uncorrupted by the Scourge or anything else. But where?!

female_text: Is there a difference between ooze and slime?

male_text: No, not that I can tell. It seems to be mostly based on region. Some races have labled them slimes, some oozes. It seems to be preference mostly.$B$BEvery time I've encountered ooze, sludge, or slime they have basically been the same creatures. The differences seem to be based on their environment, which is why we need a pure sample.
What do you mean by "pure?"
female_text: What do you mean by "pure?"

male_text: A pure sample would be one that's uncorrupted by unintentional influences. We need to find the creatures in the most basic, normal environment we can.$B$BThat means somewhere devoid of civilization or the effects of the dominant races of Azeroth. Someplace... untouched.

male_text: It'll definitely not be anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms, that's for sure.$B$BIt'll have to be somwhere on Kalimdor, but still far enough away from the Horde and other races. Someplace unaffected by the Sundering--that means no where near the Night elves' civilization either.$B$BI would guess it'd be someplace protected also... like a valley, or a crater. I don't know. I'm just guessing now. I'm sorry I couldn't help you more.

I bid you welcome, $c. Rare do we have visitors down to these levels of the Apothecarium... unless of course there's something someone wants... or needs.$B$B<Chemist Coely laughs.>$B$BHow can I help you today, hmm?
