Hello, $n. Welcome to Refuge Pointe.
Don't mind Skuerto, $n. He doesn't mean to be rude, he's just terribly busy. While we wait for him to finish scouting, why don't we work on something more productive?

female_text: Hi $n!$B$BI have to work on my devices, but eventually... I'm going to need someone to get me dragon eggs!
The Burning Steppes is a dangerous place, but scholars like me will do almost anything to advance our knowledge.

male_text: I'm going back to the Rookery, Tinkee.  I need an Eggscilliscope!
female_text: I'm going back to the Rookery, Tinkee.  I need an Eggscilliscope!

male_text: May your skills in smelting dark iron serve you well, $n.  But do not let your knowledge corrupt you... as it corrupted us.
At last - one among you is worthy of my knowledge. Worry not - I have probed your thoughts, no harm will come to you.
Listen carefully, for the lord of Blackrock will surely destroy you, should you not be prepared.

female_text: Kar Aman, $n. You look to be a strong $c--you would do well to mind yourself in this area. Touching things you know nothing about, or showing disrespect to your elders is just cause for punishment.$B$BYou may not respect me or my companions, but you will learn to respect our power if you prove foolish enough.$B$BNow, enough with the pleasantries, was there something I can do for you?

Ah, a fellow warlock who has proven $ghis:her; worth to some degree.$B$BI am pleased to meet your acquaintance. My name is Menara Voidrender... and not without just cause.$B$BYou seem powerful and well-learned enough that other tools... more powerful tools... would be welcome and not foolishly imparted. If this is true, then speak to me further. If not, well then, you know your way  back to the docks and off into the ocean.

male_text: Humans are usually vunerable on their left side between the 4th and 5th rib. Let's practice striking at this area like so...
female_text: Humans are usually vunerable on their left side between the 4th and 5th rib. Let's practice striking at this area like so...

male_text: Now, you try.
female_text: Now, you try.

male_text: Night Elves like to stand off on one leg while casting. Strike at that leg like so...
female_text: Night Elves like to stand off on one leg while casting. Strike at that leg like so...

male_text: Dwarves will spin around leaving their backs open for attack at times. Take this opportunity to strike like this...
female_text: Dwarves will spin around leaving their backs open for attack at times. Take this opportunity to strike like this...

male_text: Gnomes can be hard to hit due to their size. However, they have a pinchant for dancing around and thrusting their hips. When they do this, strike at them like so...
female_text: Gnomes can be hard to hit due to their size. However, they have a pinchant for dancing around and thrusting their hips. When they do this, strike at them like so...

male_text: Good. You are showing promise to join the elite ranks. Now, more practice.
female_text: Good. You are showing promise to join the elite ranks. Now, more practice.

male_text: %s begins to regain its strength!
%s is nearly at full strength!
%s regains its power and breaks free of its bonds!

In decades past - of now ancient wars and conflicts - our kind was driven to the brink of extinction. Much we have endured, $r.$B$BThe onslaught of the Burning Legion. The Demon Soul. The Aspects divided. The ascension of Deathwing. The enslavement of our Queen, Alexstrasza, by the Dragonmaw.$B$BThrough it all, we have been the unshakable will of the dragons - the undaunted force that has fought to represent our waning existence in this world.
Your kind?
female_text: Your kind?

male_text: Indeed. I stand before you in a form that you can comprehend, mortal. Surely, you could not bear to stand in the presence of the dragon known as Vaelastrasz.$B$B<Vaelan laughs.>$B$BShall I continue?
Please.
female_text: Please.

male_text: Perhaps I should tell you why I am here.$B$BDo you know of the Aspect, Deathwing? Or of his progeny, Nefarian and Onyxia?
No, Vaelan, I do not.
female_text: No, Vaelan, I do not.

male_text: Deathwing, or Neltharion as he was once known, was the Aspect that embodied the strength of the world - granted almost limitless power over this mortal realm by the Titan shaper known as Khaz'goroth: Forger of the world.$B$BThrough treachery and deceit, the foul one convinced the four other Aspects to imbue an item, known as the Demon Soul, with their powers - greatly weakening them, forcing a division among the once great Aspects.
Demon Soul?
female_text: Demon Soul?

male_text: Indeed. The item was ultimately destroyed and Deathwing nearly slain by the combined and renewed power of the four remaining Aspects. Where Deathwing is now is unknown. What we do know, however, is that one of his progeny, Nefarian, rules this citadel and wishes to continue where his father left off.
Where he left off?
female_text: Where he left off?

male_text: Before his banishment, Deathwing was attempting to create impure offspring. Half breeds that would not only be immune to the innate natural powers and abilities of their Aspects but also under the complete control of Deathwing.$B$BIt seems that where his father failed, Nefarian may have succeeded - at least partially.$B$BIt was Ysera, Aspect of Dreams, who saw the abominations and forced us to act. If these 'Chromatic' dragonkin exist, they must be destroyed.
Why not destroy them with the combined might of the Aspects?
female_text: Why not destroy them with the combined might of the Aspects?

male_text: It is not our way, nor would it be possible. Nefarian is guarded by ancient wards, as old as the Aspects themselves. It is what prevents me from entering the inner sanctum of this citadel. The dark magic prevents any of the other flight to enter without being ordained... unless.
Unless?
female_text: Unless?

male_text: It is possible for one, not of dragon kind, to obtain the Adorned Seal of Ascension and pass through the protected barrier. While possession of such an item would surely destroy me, perhaps you could utilize it and lower the barrier.
I am willing to try but I will require instruction.
female_text: I am willing to try but I will require instruction.

male_text: You must find one amongst the wretch in the lower portion of this citadel that has attained an Unadorned Seal of Ascension. It is a great honor for one of the lesser beings to obtain this item, as it is the first step in gaining access to the upper citadel and becoming one of Nefarian's elite guardsmen - the Blackhand legion. Find such an item and return it to me so that I may examine its properties. I will know how to proceed once my inspection of the seal is complete.
I will do my best, Vaelan.
female_text: I will do my best, Vaelan.

male_text: Be warned, mortal, it is exceptionally rare that one of the lesser clans in this citadel would hold such an item. Your search could take decades. I recommend you destroy these beasts without impunity.
It will be done.
female_text: It will be done.

male_text: Do not bring it any closer, mortal. I can sense the evil coursing through the seal from where I stand.$B$BGive me a moment to inspect the item - hold it firmly.
As you wish, Vaelan.
female_text: As you wish, Vaelan.

male_text: %s is surrounded by a barrier of anti-magic.
I have discerned the path that you must take. Are you prepared?
Begone, mortal. You are not worthy of my knowledge.
Ah, $r, you have returned!
%s's will falters.
At last, I have caught up with you, Nefarian. Surely you did not think you would escape the might of the other Aspects?
Enough! Playtime is over!
I would like to train.
female_text: I would like to train.

male_text: What do you mean you don't know how to use an axe?
It's small but it does it's job if you know what you are doing. Let me show you just the right places to hit.
Take tha blade like dis, den throw. Just flip joo wrist mon, one twirl and joo got jooself lunch.

female_text: We have used bows since before even my father's time. They are solid and sure and take down our foes swiftly. I see no reason to use the guns that the goblins and tauren seem so fond of.
Come to learn have ya, mon?
The fists of an Orc are already a powerful weapon, so why not add blades or studs of solid steel. Now the fists I use to tame the wolves of the plains I can also use to shatter the armor of my foes.

male_text: Joo may tink this ma walkin stick mon. Dat's jus wat I want joo to tink.
A bow is a great ting ma friend. Joo jus have to take care of it, and it will take care of joo.
Dis ain't no game mon. Joo want to use da axe, joo got to say da line. Say it wif me... "Say hello, to ma little friend."
Never had much use for a bow, but these rifles the goblins make are very handy when hunting. Still can't get used to the smell though.

$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.$B$BIt is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.
It may look simple, a large stick with a huge weight on the end. But when swung with the might of a tauren behind it, this stick can break stone walls.
Just a stick? Want me to show you what 'just a stick' can do?

female_text: %s begins to summon in a Blackhand Dreadweaver!
%s summons a Blackhand Dreadweaver to his aid!
%s begins to summon in a Blackhand Veteran!
%s summons a Blackhand Veteran to his aid!

male_text: I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!
female_text: I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!

male_text: What the... nobody cleanses a furbolg in MY camp!  Face the wrath of Xabraxxis!
%s is lured out by the sweet scent of the purified food.
%s begins to greedily devour the food.
VanCleef pay big for you heads!
Nuttin' be 'fraid of. Come.
female_text: Nuttin' be 'fraid of. Come.

male_text: We're doomed!
female_text: We're doomed!

male_text: The only weapon I know of that has no use other than killing someone. Not something, but someone. These blades were invented to end the lives of men. Beautiful aren't they?

female_text: Keep your foes at bay and carve them into cutlets at the same time. The only problem is that the long shaft keeps me from getting blood on my hands.
Swift and sure. Cut a tendon here, slit an artery there. I can show you how to turn any knife into a perfect killing machine.

male_text: The long reload takes some getting used to, but nothing else is better for starting off a fight.
Welcome to my shop, $c. What is it the Goodstitch brothers can do for you?

Ah, one of my favorite customers. You look to be of a warlock of some power, $n. I am pleased to meet you. If there is anything I can do for you, please, just ask.$B$BMy brother and I feel that it will be your kind who lead us into the next great era. One with such power... such control... it's only a matter of time before the Legion itself bends to your will.$B$BI am but a little envious.
What of the Alliance, Rend?
They have freed the human, Windsor, sire. It will not be long until Onyxia is uncovered.
Then we must not waste anymore time. Are the chromatic dragonflight ready?
The next clutch is due to hatch soon, sire. We will be ready to launch the attacks by week's end.

female_text: I can teach you both the finesse of a short blade and the bone shattering cleaving power of a two handed behemoth. Or we can get crazy and I can teach you both, could come in handy for when the situation changes on ya.
Sure I can teach you the fine art of wielding a polearm, but it's gonna cost you.

male_text: Excellent... it would appear as if the meddlesome insects have arrived just in time to feed my legion. Welcome, mortals!
Sure it takes longer to reload but this baby will punch a hole the size of my fist through any set of armor.

female_text: I've seen farmers with staves hold off trained soldiers. Do not ever underestimate the power and skill it takes to wield one of these properly.
If you think I'm good, you should see my husband fight.

male_text: %s turns to face you.
Let not even a drop of their blood remain upon the arena floor, my children. Feast on their souls!
A good hammer in yer hands makes the world feel safer. Like ye can face even the mightiest of foes with a large hunk of solid metal gripped in yer fists.
I'll teach ye to chop down yer foes like saplings in the forest.

female_text: Hound on the horizon moving at thirty feet per second. The only question is, right or left eye. That's right $g lad : lass;, I'm that good.

See this? This is my boom stick! Dwarven top of the line. That's right, this sweet baby was made in Ironforge, Khaz Modan. Retails for about one hundred and nine gold, ninety five copper. It's got a walnut stock, thorium steel, and a hair trigger.

male_text: Och I love a good brawl, but sometimes yer foe has a skull thicker than a Thorium heat shield. Times like that ye need a wee bit o assistance.
The chromatic flight shall deal with these intruders. Let us talk of more pressing matters.
Modernization is the key. With a crank and a lever you can fire this baby with the power of an ogre pulling a normal bow.
Lets go, $n. I am ready to reach Whitereach Post.

female_text: Zoom, zing, and BAM! He may have had a huge two handed cleaver made from a boat anchor but after a few well placed slices from my dinner knife, he was the one going crash!
A hidden blade up the sleeve can mean the difference between you laying dead in the alley, and your opponent laying face down in his own blood.

male_text: The slow blade penetrates the shield.
The secret to the knife is to keep it hidden until the moment you strike.

female_text: So, you wish to learn more about our elven weaponry? Let your first lesson begin.

male_text: Now this looks familiar. If we keep heading east, I think we can... Ahh! Wyvern on the attack!
You want a weapon that acts as an extension of your very fist? Yes, I believe I can show you something.
I do not know this Eye of the Tiger some speak of, but I can show you how to use the claws of the tiger.

female_text: Many think the staff an inferior weapon. I challenge any who think so to prove their strength against my staff.

male_text: The skill of the bow is a great asset to anyone, not just the hunter. You can strike swiftly, silently, and before your prey can blink... they are dead.

female_text: Ah, $r... I possess great knowledge a' da world and how ta create charms a' great power.

male_text: Many times my blades have felled my target before they even drew near. The secret is in the flick of your wrist.

female_text: Mau'ari know why you seek her out...$B$BBring me da E'ko you find in the world, an' I can transform it for you.

male_text: How do I use the Cache of Mau'ari?
female_text: How do I use the Cache of Mau'ari?

male_text: Sssplendid... Then let us watch as my children tear these mortals to pieces.
Use the freezing breath, imbecile!
Foolsss... Kill the one in the dress!
Inconceivable!
Do not force my hand, children! I shall use your hides to line my boots.
Your efforts will prove fruitless. None shall stand in our way!
I promise you an eternity of dung clean up duty for that failure!
Curse you, mortal.
Concentrate your attacks upon the healer!
Sire, let me join the fray! I shall tear their spines out with my bare hands!
Impossible!
Flee while you still have a chance, mortals. You will pray for a swift death should I enter the arena.
You will learn of the sanctuary only death can offer...
It appears as if I will have to step in and take care of you myself.
I will tear off your limbs and use them to beat you into submission!
Defilers!
I can stand no more of this!
Vincent!  You and your pathetic ilk will find no more success in routing my sons and I than those beggardly remnants of the Kirin Tor.
If you will not serve my Master with your sword and knowledge of his enemies...
Your moldering remains will serve ME as a testament to what happens when one is foolish enough to trespass in my domain!
Thanks a bunch... I can find my way back to Whitereach Post from here. Be sure to talk with Motega Firemane; perhaps you can keep him from sending me home.
%s spies you tampering with the camp's fruit stores and attacks you!
%s emerges from the log hovel and catches you tampering with the grain stores!

female_text: More and more of Kalimdor is turning into the twisted landscape to our left, and the critters who dwell within are NOT friendly.  Watch your step.
Blast... ogres.  I forgot about these buffoons.  There's no easy way around them, so expect plenty of fighting.  Look sharp!
Come on Dadanga!  March girl, march!
There it is -- Gadgetzan!  We're in the home stretch now!
We're finally here, thanks to you $n!  Without your help, we would have been some over-grown lizard's lunch!
It was quite a haul, but now I can load up on supplies for the trip back into the Crater.  I should be able to unload some of this exotic cargo as well.
Look out, incoming!
I'm gonna need some help with this $n!

male_text: Yeah yeah, I know Dadanga dislikes smoke.  From the smell of it though, seems like Dadanga also dislikes bathing.
Have you seen Petra or Dadanga around?
female_text: Have you seen Petra or Dadanga around?

male_text: They took off for Gadgetzan a while ago to bring us back some supplies.  Frankly, I would have given at least four of my fingers to have had the chance to crawl inside one of Dadanga's packs in order to leave this forsaken place.
What is E'ko?
female_text: What is E'ko?

Da Cache of Mau'ari holds great secrets... The shards used ta make it are reflective, and you can use its shiny surface ta siphon power from other tings and den reflect it onto yourself.$B$BKeeping da charm in your inventory lets you collect e'ko, da spiritual power from the beasts you fight. Once you find e'ko, you bring it ta Mau'ari.

E'ko is da power dat each creatures possesses. Da charm I made for ya allows you ta capture it in a physical manifestation.$B$BI know an incantation dat can transform da e'ko you find, and turn it into juju.$B$BYou can den take the Cache of Mau'ari, an' use it ta reflect da power of da juju onto yourself.$B$BC'mon, give it a try. Bring da e'ko ta Mau'ari an' we have some fun.
As nice as Gadgetzan is compared to Un'Goro, I have some good folks counting on us to bring them some supplies.  If you're ready to go, then so are Dadanga and I.  Let's mount up!
The Tanaris desert is littered with gigantic bones just like this one to my right.  I'd hate to have ever ran across that thing.
Whoa, whoa, hold up Dadanga girl.

male_text: %s snorts deeply as she comes to a halt.

female_text: This doesn't look... right.  Look at how alien the desert is!  Going through here might be a terrible mistake.
What the... what are those things crawling at us?  We... we have incoming!
That was not what I would call 'escort friendly'.  I will find a way to go around these things.  Let's move to the south, toward that rock.  Maybe we can wedge through it and still avoid the ogres.
This will work -- keep heading through this gap.  The path to Un'Goro is due west of here once we round these infernal bugs.

male_text: THIS CANNOT BE!!! Rend, deal with these insects.
The mortals have fallen! The new age of the Blackrock legion is at hand!
%s is knocked off his drake!
WOOT!
That will surely save me some work.
I want those boots! Nobody touch that corpse!
Consider yourself lucky, mortal. At least your corpse is still somewhat presentable.
Do not consume the entire corpse just yet, children! Save room for dessert!
Served!
You actually believed that you stood a chance?
The Blackhand legion shall wear your skin as fashion accessories!
The Warchief shall make quick work of you, mortals. Prepare yourselves!
%s paces back and forth in anticipation of the battle.
With pleasure...
Good day to ye $g lad : lass;. Can I be of service?
Here for training eh? Just began my training meself, but I would be glad ta teach ye what I can.

Ye learn fast $g lad : lass;, much faster than I can keep up with. If ye want ta continue yer training, I suggest ye see my teacher. His name's Rotgath, Rotgath Stonebeard and ye'll find him in Ironforge at The Great Forge.
Taste in my power!
Eh? I don't have time ta chat, my da' wants me ta finish this order fer him.
Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.
Where should I look for E'ko?
female_text: Where should I look for E'ko?
The creatures in Winterspring are a good place ta start.$B$BHoweva', der may also be other places you can look...

male_text: Of course I can help you with training. I'm just a journeyman myself, but I'm sure there's something I can show you.

I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.
I'm sorry, I'm a bit busy right now making horseshoes for Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
Do I look like I have the time to spend jawin?
You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.
A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.
I hear one comment about waterfowl, and you will be eating through a tube.
Just swinging a hammer at an anvil doesn't make you a smith. Give me that and let me teach you something before you embarrass us all.

Not bad. Go talk with Snarl, he just moved to Orgrimmar to study under Saru. Look for him in the Warrior district near Saru's smithy. Oh and he'll test you, so you better be as ready as you think you are.
Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.

I can show you what you wish to know, but you must be patient. Take your time to work the steel and feel the way it shapes beneath your hammer. When you become one with the steel, then you will understand.

You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.
I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.
All is not lost! Battle these beasts without fear. Your wounds I shall heal, bones I shall mend. Be renewed, heroes!

female_text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.
Ah yes, another who will stoke the fires and forge the weapons of war. Of course I will teach you how.

You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.

male_text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.
You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.
You have learned much, more than I can teach. Go to James Van Brunt, he will teach you what I cannot.
You must continue! Their resolve is weakening. Drink from my power and be renewed once again!
What is Juju?
female_text: What is Juju?

E'ko is da unfocused form of the supernatural power, and Juju is da concentrated essence. By using a stong incantation, I can transform da E'ko into Juju.  Once it becomes Juju, you can den use the Cache of Mau'ari ta reflect da powers onto yourself.

male_text: I lost the Cache of Mau'ari. What can I do?
female_text: I lost the Cache of Mau'ari. What can I do?
Ah am very surprised that one wit such a careless nature has gotten dis far...$B$BYah, you may have another charm, but Mau'ari is very displeased wit your actions!$B$BGo, now.

male_text: You have come too far to fail. Stand back, mortals.
You will suffer in this defeat, Nefarian!
This should do it! At least it better do it!
Holy Krakle! The temperature is 428,000 degrees Kraklenheit!
The temperature is 9280 degrees Kraklenheit! That's HOT!
The temperature is 564 degrees Kraklenheit.
The temperature is 122 degrees Kraklenheit.
The temperature is 12 degrees Kraklenheit. How exciting.
Um, Ozzie... that doesn't look very safe.
OZZIE!!!! OH NO!
Didn't even leave his boots behind...
%s shrugs.
%s collapses but the broken body rises again!
The living are here!
Ow!  OK, I'll get back to work, $n!
When I get all shaken up, hear me shout...
Vaelastrasz, when this world belongs to the black flight, your flight shall know its end.
But for now, your death will have to suffice...
You merely destroy an image, fool. I shall hunt you until the end of days.
Aye, it appears as if ye have learned quite a bit, I'm impressed. But do ye know how many I have that seek to be my apprentice? Tell ye what, do a small task fer me and I'll take ye on.
Ye have some skill about ye with hammer and anvil, but not enough. Go speak to Dane Lindgren, he'll get ye ready to learn what I have to teach ye.

I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

The life of a smith is not an easy one, but it puts steel in yer bones and fire in yer heart. My da' was a smith, my grandfather before him in the forges beneath Grim Batol. And now my son follows in our footsteps, that boy makes me proud.
Sorry $g lad : lass;, ye aren't quite up to the challenge of learning from me. Go see my son Groum, it would make his day to get a new apprentice.
Yer skill is not without merit, but I need to put one last test to ye before I take ye on.
Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.
%s lets out a shrill cry.

female_text: Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.
Ever since the shadows claimed Duskwood I haven't been able to sleep. I am kept awake by the ghostly sounds of screaming on the breeze. It sounds almost like lambs screaming, and they won't stop.

Hmm, your work is allright but it's nowhere near the quality I look for in a student. Go talk with Smith Argus in Goldshire, I'm sure he can teach you some basics. Then when you're done, come on back to me and I'll give you a little test to make sure you are ready.

Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?
You do fine work, but it's a bit rough around the edges. Don't worry about it, it will come with practice. Speaking of which, how about we see what you've been working on?

Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

male_text: If I prove myself to Saru he will have no choice but to let me fight for one of his daughters. Then we will see who is sneering.
Stay away from Sumi and Tumi. They are....spoken for.
Come to me again with such pathetic work and I will send you home in a small iron box that I tempered in goat urine. Now go see that idiot Ug'thok, he is better suited to your needs.

So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.
Hmm? Oh yes, I can teach you something if you desire. But stay away from Sumi and Tumi, they are not for the likes of you. Saru only let's those of great skill approach his daughters.
There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.
The spirits have brought you to me, and so I feel blessed by them.
You need to heed the guidance of the spirits a little better young one. Your path lies with another, Thrag Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Perhaps you can learn something from one another.
Tell me, do your feel prepared to face the challenge I have laid out for you? The spirits tell me that you will pass, but do you have faith in them or in yourself?
Join me, together we will weave the spirits of the forge and find the true shape that the metal seeks.

Our paths through life intersect only briefly and now is the time for ours to part ways. I consider myself blessed to have spent this time teaching you and now send you along to join paths with your next mentor. Seek out Saru Steelfury of Orgrimmar, he will teach what you need to learn.

You have great potential, but you must achieve understanding first, you must accept the spirits and listen to their calling. Only then will you be prepared for the path you must follow. Go speak with Thrag, I think perhaps you can learn a lot from one another.
You are now ready to follow the path that joins your life with my own, if only for a short time. However we must make sure that you understand the things of which the spirits speak.

You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.
You waste my time, go talk with my student Basil.
Perhaps you have what it takes, perhaps not. If you do then I will take you on and teach you what you wish to know. If you do not... well, I'll just leave it at that.

Very fine equipment you make, very fine indeed. Go to the Orc's home of Orgrimmar and seek out a smith named Saru Steelfury. One thing you must give the Orcs, they make beautiful instruments of death.
I'm sorry $g lad : lass; but ye just don't have the foundation to learn what I have to teach. But don't fret, go speak with my student Rotgath, he'll help ye out.
Looks like ye may have the makings of a great smith. But before I teach ye anything I need to know that ye've got what it takes.

I can't say enough about yer work, truly amazing things that ye can do with a hammer and an anvil. Now, don't be tellin anyone that I suggested ye go find a goblin to teach ye but that's exactly what I'm gonna do. Brikk Keencraft is his name, and last I heard he was operating a shop down in Booty Bay.
This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.
Still a bit weak, unbalanced, unsure. Not your work youngling, I am speaking of you! Now, are you ready to be shaped into a real smith or not?

I see you know more of the secret of steel than I do. That is good, for it is meant to be taken. Now you must travel to the jungle south of the human lands, to the goblin city of Booty Bay. There you will find a Goblin named Brikk Keencraft. I do not like Goblins but his knowledge of the secret of steel is unmatched by any I know of.
Yeah? Of course I'm a smith. What, you think Dwarves are the only ones worth their weight in anvils? Fine, be that way. Go get a dwarf to help you!
Are you kidding me? You must be kidding me! Either that or you think I'm a clown here to amuse you. Is that what you think? That I'm a clown? Huh, is it! You think I'm a clown don't you!

You act like this is the best junk I've ever seen. Sure it's ok, but I see stuff this 'OK' every day. Tell you what, you find a way to wow me, and I'll teach you things that make dwarves smile in their sleep.

Imagination is the limit my friend, if you can figure out how to smith it then you can make it, box it, and ship it to retailers all over the world. Of course, then you have to deal with marketing. Tell you what, let's just stick with the smithing part for now, ok?
Your victory shall be short lived. The days of both the Alliance and Horde are coming to an end! The next time we meet shall be the last.

Gryfe do his job! Gryfe go now!!!
Oh, it's on now! Bet you thought I'd be alone too, huh?!
Whoa! This is way more than what I bargained for, you're on your own, Slim!

male_text: I left. I would not remain with the Blackrock. No, the deaths of my children would not be in vain. I would not serve under an inept, power hungry maniac such as Rend.$B$BI took shelter in the woods of Lordaeron, living as a hermit near Hearthglen.

male_text: Oh, I can see Liladris from here... Tell her I'm here, won't you?

female_text: Hello young $g Master:Mistress;. I am Eva Sarkhoff and this is my husband, Lucien. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

male_text: The pleasure is mine, madam. Might I ask what it is that you are doing here?
female_text: The pleasure is mine, madam. Might I ask what it is that you are doing here?

Certainly, $g sir:miss;. We were once servants of the house Barov: What is now known as the Scholomance.$B$BI was the head maid and Lucien was Master Barov's butler.$B$BWe had worked for the Barovs for decades, until...$B$B<Eva weeps.>

male_text: Until what, Eva? I must know.
female_text: Until what, Eva? I must know.

Oh it's just so horrible, $g sir:miss;. The house Barov was once full of life... full of splendor. The manor was the Barov's primary residence amidst their far reaching empire.$B$BLucien and I noticed that as the days progressed, the Barovs became depressed. Despondent. Paranoia and rage often overcame the master and missus. At night, we could hear the Barovs arguing in their chambers. From what we understood, their greed had 'broken the dam,' so to speak.

male_text: What do you mean?
female_text: What do you mean?

We suspect that in order to preserve their fortune and hold of the land - well past their lifespan - the Barovs made a deal with a powerful human mage named Kel'Thuzad.$B$B<Eva shudders.>$B$BFrom this deal sprang the school of necromancy: A place which bore the Cult of the Damned and would become their capital.$B$BAs each week passed, the house Barov became more and more decrepit...$B$BDark beings began to take residence in the various wings of the house. Upkeep became impossible... and disgusting.

male_text: Why didn't you just leave?
female_text: Why didn't you just leave?

And go where? It was all that we knew; all that we had known and all that we would ever know.$B$BEventually, we lost contact with the Barovs and ultimately, were separated from the household. We knew not what happened to the other servants, only that there were screams. Tortured screams.$B$BKnowing that we had nowhere to go, Lucien and I were forced to hide in our quarters. During the day, when the school was relatively quiet, Lucien would sneak out to scrounge up food and drink.

male_text: So what happened?
female_text: So what happened?

We did this for about six months and watched as the house went through horrifying changes. Foul monsters roamed through the manor at will. Dark cultists populated every inch with various paraphernalia relating to rituals and sacrifices. We knew that we could not hide much longer.$B$BAs expected, we were found and captured. They stripped us of all our clothes and laid us out inside a circle of blood. We sat there for days, naked and terrified.

male_text: No restraints? Just in a circle?
female_text: No restraints? Just in a circle?

Restraints? There are things in this world far more restraining than bars and shackles, young $g master:mistress;. The undead surrounded us, constantly tormenting us with horrifying acts of depravity.$B$BFinally, he came. He introduced himself as Doctor Theolen Krastinov. We came to know him as 'The Butcher.'

male_text: Tell me more.
female_text: Tell me more.

We finally understood what the screams were from. The Butcher exposed us to pain that we did not know existed. He used us in countless experiments, attempting to devise a plague.$B$BThe days turned to weeks. We would have died on the first day had it not been for that cruel bastard keeping us alive through magical means.

male_text: This is an atrocity.
female_text: This is an atrocity.

The Butcher would speak of 'the blood of innocents,' and his dark master, 'Kirtonos.' Of how he must appease his master.$B$BFinally, the beast was done with his experiments. We had been drained of all life. Our spirits shattered. The sweet embrace of death was upon us and we welcomed it with open arms. But in his infinite cruelty, the Butcher revived us from death's door.$B$BWe were to be kept alive and thrown to his ravenous ghouls. He laughed as he watched the fiends devour our flesh.

male_text: I feel sick.
female_text: I feel sick.
We feel nothing. Our souls remain here, in limbo. We are unable to leave until our remains are found and spirits laid to rest.

It's said that he completed a remarkable weapon before the Crusade killed him.$B$BI guess their mistrust of the arcane has grown.

I've heard word that before they went crazy, the Scarlet Crusade had a mage working for them who was trying to create powerful bows and guns for their soldiers. I'm not sure if he succeeded or not... the Crusade killed him before any of his finished product made it out. Maybe they killed him to keep it a secret... or maybe they distrust the arcane that much.

He... hello, $n. Sorry, I'm recovering from my wounds.$B$BThose Scarlet Crusaders are tougher than I had given them credit for. They almost did me in.$B$BYou should be careful too. I'd hate to see them get the jump on you.

My family worked  the Northridge Lumber Mill in what's now Western Plaguelands. They were dedicated to the Dumah family, and now the Scarlet Crusade have taken it over along with all of Hearthglen!$B$BI will not rest until those zealots are wiped from Azeroth.

male_text: Long ago, before the last great war, my father ran the Northridge Lumber Mill. It was his life, and he was committed to it. Then the war came, and as much as it pained him, we had to flee to Stormwind.$B$BWe lost a number of friends and family in the those days, and it pains me to know that the Scarlet Crusade has taken the mill for their own ends.$B$BThat's why I've returned.

male_text: Because you have aided me, I will tell you what I know of this land and of the things there are to see. My knowledge is not vast, but perhaps I can point out some things that might interest one such as yourself.

Once a great city of the night elves, the Highborne once ruled there, practicing great and powerful arcane magics. They are cursed now, haunting the lands, and their ruined city has been victimized by the Spitelash naga. I understand that the naga search the ruins for powerful Highborne artifacts.

A powerful human mage is rumored to live to the north; he keeps watch over the land for some unknown reason. I have not traveled there myself, but it is said that visitors are welcome and can even earn favor with him if they are willing to do errands for him.

I've seen terrible things happen to the furbolg over the last few years--they were victims on many fronts. But it's unclear to me what's become of this tribe. Are they corrupted by the same plague that's touched Felwood? Or perhaps they are simply angry at what's happened to their once peaceful people and now seek to defend themselves. Either way, most of them appear hostile to those who come into the area.

The blue dragons themselves aren't here, but followers of Malygos are. I do not know why, but I can tell you this: wherever the blue dragons are, expect to find arcane magic. I wouldn't be surprised if the dragonspawn are here protecting something... perhaps something the Highborne left behind.

After the makrura attack, we could see that the Gallant would not survive another.  So I and the few surviving sailors abandoned my ship.$B$BWe are now ashore and will soon strike out for the town of Nijel's Point, but much danger lies between us and sanctuary, and I fear Desolace will consume us.$B$BI write this now in hopes that someone will know our plight, and some day avenge us against the watery fiends who were our ruin.
