male_text: I wish to unlearn my talents.
female_text: I wish to unlearn my talents.

male_text: Yes. I do.
female_text: Yes. I do.

male_text: I wish to unlearn my talents.

female_text: I wish to unlearn my talents.

male_text: What can I do for ya?
female_text: What can I do for ya?

male_text: I got nothin' more to teach! Not for somebody who knows as much as you do, anyway! You Horde types need to talk to Nogg in Orgrimmar!
Ragers, Fetch!
Ok, let's move out!

female_text: Who dares attack the Silverwing Outpost?!?

male_text: Silverwing is ours!
Go report that the outpost is taken.  We will remain here.
Prepare yourselves.  Silverwing is just around the bend.
For the Horde!
Everyone ready?

female_text: I mean you no harm. I am scouting the quilboar and taking notes of their activities. My people have noticed something odd--an emanation or darkness--coming from this area. I've come to investigate, and what I've found is very disturbing.$B$BThere seems to be an undead diplomat who is powerful in the ways of the arcane. I don't believe he's one of the Forsaken... I think it's worse.
How fortuitous. Usually, I must leave my lair in order to feed.
Learn your place, mortal!
This meaningless exertion bores me. I'll incinerate you all from above!

male_text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.
female_text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.
It seems you'll need another lesson, mortals!

male_text: Your will is not strong enough to manipulate the forces we control $c.
female_text: Your will is not strong enough to manipulate the forces we control $c.

male_text: It is a greater knowledge of the ways of the warlock that I crave.
female_text: It is a greater knowledge of the ways of the warlock that I crave.

male_text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?
female_text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

male_text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.
female_text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.

male_text: I seek further druidic training to have a closer understanding of the Earth Mother's will.
female_text: I seek further druidic training to have a closer understanding of the Earth Mother's will.

male_text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more warlock knowledge.
female_text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more warlock knowledge.

male_text: I have no time to waste on the likes of you $c.
female_text: I have no time to waste on the likes of you $c.

male_text: I submit myself for further training my master.
female_text: I submit myself for further training my master.

male_text: I can tell just by the way you're standing that you're no warrior.  $B$BWhy don't you go do something safe, like read a book.
female_text: I can tell just by the way you're standing that you're no warrior.  $B$BWhy don't you go do something safe, like read a book.

male_text: The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!
female_text: The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!

male_text: I'm afraid your darkness quotient isn't sufficient enough for me to bother talking to you any further.  Move along please.
female_text: I'm afraid your darkness quotient isn't sufficient enough for me to bother talking to you any further.  Move along please.

male_text: Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  $B$BA $c who thinks $ghe's : she's; a warrior.  Ha!
female_text: Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  $B$BA $c who thinks $ghe's : she's; a warrior.  Ha!

male_text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.
female_text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

male_text: %s emerges to protect the Fathom Stone!
Pathetic. You two do not deserve the training you are getting here if that was the best you can do.
Lysta, summon in undead captives.
Lysta, summon forth... the abomination!
Please share your wisdom with me, Warchief.
female_text: Please share your wisdom with me, Warchief.

male_text: The Shattered Hand has been able to place spies throughout the upper citadel of Blackrock. Though the information gathering process has been slow, we have made discoveries that cannot be ignored.
What discoveries?
female_text: What discoveries?

male_text: It would appear as if the influence of the Black Dragonflight had extended beyond the borders of the Burning Steppes and into the kingdom of Stormwind itself! The usurper has since been unmasked and ousted.
Usurper?
female_text: Usurper?

male_text: Indeed. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight had used illusion and trickery to disguise herself as a member of the royal court. Worse yet, she had assumed control of the current Highlord of Stormwind, Bolvar Fordragon.$B$BIt is no wonder that such foolish military decisions had been made. The movement of the Alliance forces as of late had left us scratching our heads. We now understand that the Black Flight was attempting to divide the empire - destroy it from within.
With all due respect, Warchief - why not allow them to be destroyed? Does this not strengthen our position?
female_text: With all due respect, Warchief - why not allow them to be destroyed? Does this not strengthen our position?

male_text: <Thrall laughs.>$B$BSo much to learn still, $r.$B$BYou are too young to remember the wars and bloodshed of ages past. Too young to remember the burden of the curse carried by our people.$B$BOur position with the Alliance right now is a tenuous one. Skirmishes and smaller battles do take place, but there is peace - something our people have not known for millennia. Would you give this up and plunge us into the maw of chaos again but against a new foe? One that will not rest until we are all destroyed?
I... I did not think of it that way, Warchief.
female_text: I... I did not think of it that way, Warchief.

male_text: No, $n, you did not. I do not fault you, however, as yours is a mind much like mine was as a youth: Impetuous, rebellious, and often without a single coherent thought! Traits I can no longer afford to express.$B$BEnough lamenting. $R, I have a task for you; one that you may not survive.
I live only to serve, Warchief! My life is empty and meaningless without your guidance.
female_text: I live only to serve, Warchief! My life is empty and meaningless without your guidance.

male_text: <Thrall laughs.>$B$BNoted... Now pay attention, $n. The Black Dragonflight brood mother, Onyxia, has been flushed out from her position of power in Stormwind. She has escaped, fleeing to her lair in Dustwallow Marsh.$B$BShe cannot be allowed to live in such close proximity to our capital cities. We must strike before being struck!$B$BI want her destroyed, $n.
Of course, Warchief!
female_text: Of course, Warchief!

male_text: %s collapses upon seeing his master die!

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BWe are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.

Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.$B$BWe are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.
Myranda, do you have enough eyeballs to make another amulet? I have lost the old one.
female_text: Myranda, do you have enough eyeballs to make another amulet? I have lost the old one.

male_text: I see some interesting characters come and go here at the port. Watch yourself, $n. It's never clear who to trust, what with all of the shady activity that goes on here...
So you're here for the Warsong axes. Well, it's about time, $n. That crate has been sitting out there for days, now.$B$BFeel free to haul it away whenever you are ready.

female_text: Let's go before they find out I'm free!
Look out! We're under attack!
Thank you for helping me. I know my way back from here.

male_text: Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.$B$B$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.
%s goes into a rage after seeing Misha fall in battle!
female_text: %s goes into a rage after seeing Misha fall in battle!
Please wait while I attempt to bind the shards together so that they will be whole once again.
Ishnu... Oshalan thara dormil... Anu'dorin...

male_text: Fish so delicious. You come learn fish? Eat fish? Mmmmm...
I require training, Lumak.
female_text: I require training, Lumak.

male_text: Yap, I can teach ye to fish.
I require training, Grimnur.
female_text: I require training, Grimnur.
Yes, I was able to reseal the relic, $n.
Please, leave this place, $n. You know nothing of what troubles us...

male_text: Where can I get Enchanted Thorium?
female_text: Where can I get Enchanted Thorium?

male_text: Where can I find Crystal Restore?
female_text: Where can I find Crystal Restore?
Enchanted thorium is a highly sought-after metal. You best chance of finding some of it is to speak with an artisan blacksmith or miner.
Crystal Restore is a difficult item to acquire.$B$BI believe that it comes from Un'Goro Crater, so you'd best head there.

male_text: We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?
I wish to browse your goods, Dirge.
female_text: I wish to browse your goods, Dirge.
Can Zamja help you, $r?

male_text: I require training, Zamja.
female_text: I require training, Zamja.

male_text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.
I require training, Daryl.
female_text: I require training, Daryl.

male_text: You are a little gnat to the Foulweald!  Die!
No!  You cannot be stronger than the Foulweald!  No!!
Heeellp meee... ri... ribss... bro... broken.
Dying... See the light... gloriouss...
I... I think I see Blue...
I'm saved! Thank you, doctor!
My entrails are leaking out! HELP!
I'm not gonna make it... death comes...
Goodbye, cruel world... I'm leavin' you today... goodbye... goodbye... goodbye...
HOORAY! I AM SAVED!
Brain encaved... mortar... bas... hed... leaking... dyin... g...
Sweet, sweet embrace... take me...
The good doctor saves the day! HOORAY!
I regret to inform you that you have failed your examination, doctor.

We ride on your command!

Ram Riders, REGULATE!

Lads and ladies. Today can be your greatest day, for today, you fight for the glory of Stormpike! Ride unto the field and grant your enemies no mercy! Strike the savages down and let their Warchief sort em out!
Patrol the front line, soldiers!
For the King!
female_text: For the King!
The indigenous rams of Alterac are vital to the functionality of our cavalry!
Just a few more and our stables will be overflowing with mounts. Release it into my custody, soldier. I'll take it from here.

I'll perform these with pleasure, $n!
%s emerges from the plant, allowing it to heal.
%s attacks!
Well met, $n. We must be brief because there is much to do.

May Cenarius guide you, $c.$B$BI am here in this corrupt land with my sisters on a mission of great importance to the Cenarian Circle. But only those who are powerful enough I ask speak to me about such matters--to send a lesser being would be folly.

female_text: My sisters and I have come down from the Stonetalon Mountains to put to rest a tragedy from ages past. Unfortunately, we are not powerful enough to accomplish our goals on our own and now seek mortals such as yourself to aid us.$B$BIf you are powerful enough, then we have much to discuss, $c. If you are not, then, for your safety, I will leave the details of my mission out of our conversation.
$n, please take a look at the sample of the Vylestem vine that I took from the caverns, so that you know what to look for...

male_text: I greet you, $r.
Free! Free from my bonds at last!
$n, please take a look at the sample of the Vylestem vine that I took from the caverns, so that you know what to look for...

I need no home to know I still have a place in this world, $c. The tribes will see... all of them. They fight amongst one another, and for what? Scraps left over by vultures... lands infested by the Legion... bah!$B$BThe centaur should be proud of their heritage--it is just as noble as any Night elf's or orc's--it is time we started acting like it!
At last, I am free of the corruption that once bound me to this place...
Thank you for what you have done, $n.$B$BKeep the scepter safe; may it aid you in your toil against the evils that have invaded this place...
How has this come to be, $n? Do you think that an item such as the Scepter of Celebras is trivial?$B$BI can help you this time, but do not be careless with this valuable item again...
Celebras, I lost my Scepter...
female_text: Celebras, I lost my Scepter...

male_text: I carry both parts of the scepter.
female_text: I carry both parts of the scepter.

male_text: My scepter... After so many years... You have recovered it! You shall truly be the savior of this place...$B$BPlease listen to me carefully, $n. The head and the rod of the scepter may only be reunited into one at the Stone of Maraudon.
Please show me the Stone of Maraudon.
female_text: Please show me the Stone of Maraudon.

male_text: Please explain how the scepter works.
female_text: Please explain how the scepter works.

male_text: Between the colors, a path.$B$BBlink across in light.$B$BFrom the water, you emerge.
I don't quite understand...
female_text: I don't quite understand...

male_text: Between the orange and the purple passageways near the doors to Maraudon, you will find a third path.$B$BThe scepter you hold in your hands is the key.
No, really, I still don't understand...
female_text: No, really, I still don't understand...

male_text: I grow weary...$B$BFrom here, you can see the waterfalls, $n...The scepter grants you the power to travel to this very place, should you ever desire to enter through the front gates of Maraudon again.$B$BNear the entrance to Maraudon, you will find a passage that goes down beneath the caverns. Use the scepter at the ancient ritual site to create a portal, and you will find yourself here once more.
Please tell me more about Maraudon.
female_text: Please tell me more about Maraudon.

male_text: Long ago, my dryad sisters and I entered these caves to free the tortured spirit of my uncle, Zaetar. However, the corruption that had already spread through these caverns soon overcame us, and we too fell.$B$BWe were destined to wander these passages; the toxins poisoning our minds...$B$BAlthough my spirit may now be at rest, I know that I have failed in my mission. It is a great sadness I must bear...
Please tell me more about Zaetar.
female_text: Please tell me more about Zaetar.

male_text: Ah, Zaetar... <Celebras looks away.>$B$BMy father, Remulos, tried to stop him...$B$BZaetar was headstrong, and when he fell for an earthen elemental princess, my father knew that their union was cursed, but Zaetar refused to listen.$B$BThe centaur are the result of his mistake. They were born misshapen and hateful; my uncle Zaetar was killed by his own kin...$B$BThe evil princess, Theradras, still guards his remains here in the crystal caverns.
Those goblins should be ashamed of themselves.  Bah!
Spending coin is NOT the reason for the Feast of Winter Veil!
I cannot believe those greedy goblins are allowed to hawk their wares while spoiling the spirit of this season.
Vile goblins... anything for a gold coin.
Could I have a copy of "The Feast of Winter Veil" to read?
female_text: Could I have a copy of "The Feast of Winter Veil" to read?

male_text: Perhaps we can attempt this later. Please speak to me again if you wish to do so.
Together, the two parts shall become one, once again.
Shal myrinan ishnu daldorah...
Read this tome I have placed before you, and speak the words aloud.
%s begins to channel his energy, focusing on the stone.
You wish to learn of the stone? Follow me.
For so long I have drifted in my cursed form. You have freed me... Your hard work shall be repaid.
Please do as I instruct you, $n.
My scepter will once again become whole!
Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.
How can I find the two parts of your scepter?
female_text: How can I find the two parts of your scepter?

male_text: As the toxins lurking within Maraudon seeped into my mind, I began to lose my grip on reality. Worried that it would be used for evil, my dryad sisters secretly took the scepter from me, breaking it into two parts and hiding it within the caverns.$B$BSoon they fell victim to the madness as well, and the two parts of the scepter, left unguarded, came to be in the possession of Vyletongue, himself. The satyr entrusted one part to Noxxion, an evil elemental, and the other he still has to this day.
Why didn't Lord Vyletongue unite both parts of the scepter into one?
female_text: Why didn't Lord Vyletongue unite both parts of the scepter into one?

male_text: Without knowledge of the incantations required to unite the two parts, Lord Vyletongue was unable to use the scepter. However, now that I am free of the curse of Vyletongue's corruption, I will be able to assist you, if you'd like to bring me the two parts -- both the head and the rod of the scepter.
Tell me more about the history of Remulos and Zaetar.
female_text: Tell me more about the history of Remulos and Zaetar.

male_text: You ask of the Sons of Cenarius, Remulos and Zaetar.$B$BMy father, Remulos, was strong and beautiful, and my uncle, Zaetar, very cunning and slight of build. While they were respected quite equally, Zaetar always felt as if he could never quite compare to the glory and attention he thought Remulos had.$B$BAfter my sisters and I were born, Zaetar, blinded by jealousy, set out to outdo his brother... He was the creator of his own end. The sadness it brings me has never lessened, even as time passes...

Long have my spirit and remains been kept captive here within Maraudon, young $c. The time has given me nothing but ample opportunities to reflect on my mistakes and realize that my jealousy of Remulos was foolish. He attempted to warn and persuade me that my relations with Theradras would bear nothing pure--that only destruction would come from chaos. My brother was right.$B$BBut that does not mean since you have freed me, I am free of penance.
Please, go on.
female_text: Please, go on.

male_text: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.$B$BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a temple my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.$B$BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
I will aid you. Give me the instructions.
female_text: I will aid you. Give me the instructions.

male_text: %s bows low before you.
Thank you, good $c.
Greetings, $n. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

It is good to see you again, Doctor $n. I have been following your progress and I dare say that it is time you learned some of the more advanced bandaging techniques.$B$BReturn to me from time to time, as your skill advances, and I shall teach you all that I know.
Teach me how to create and apply a Heavy Mageweave Bandage, Doctor.

Great!  Let's keep those supplies coming, people!
Thanks for the supplies, $n!
Thanks a lot, $n!
We're making progress!  Bring more supplies to repair Dun Baldar!
We have enough supplies!  Our captain has retaken position in the Field of Strife!
Now we're making progress!
Thank you for the armor scraps, $n!
Our cache of equipment grows!
Thank you for the supplies, $n.
Very good.  Our supply cache grows...
Keep them coming!  We need more supplies in order to rebuild...
We can now rebuild!  For the Horde!

female_text: Hail, $n!  It is good you came to see me.  We are prepared to launch a ground assuault through the Field of Strife!  Once Warmaster Garrick gets his orders, he and his reavers will cut a swath through the Alliance!$B$BDo you want to deliver those orders, $n?  Garrick is waiting in the Field of Strife...
Why are you here, $n?  Is there lead in your boots?$B$BYou have the assault orders - Warmaster Garrick needs them in the Field of Strife before he can make his assault!  Go!

It's good to have veterans like you in Alterac Valley, $n.  Our supplies are too low to launch a ground assault through Alterac Valley... speak with our quartermaster - he'll tell you how to increase our supply base.

Hail, $c!  Our supply level is high, and we are ready to launch a ground assault through the Field of Strife.  Perhaps if your renown was greater, I would trust you to deliver the assault orders.$B$BSo get out there and fight the Alliance!  Show me you're a trusted and capable member of the Horde!

You!  $n!  What are you doing wandering around the village like this?  There are Alliance foes in Alterac!  We must drive them out!$B$BOur supplies are too low to launch a large ground assault, so speak with our quatermaster.  He'll tell you how you can increase our supply base.
Even the bravest warrior must be well supplied if he is to face his foes with strength!

I am in charge of recruitment for the Frostwolf Clan. As a soldier of Frostwolf, it is your responsibility to check in with me as your rank among the clan rises.$B$BHonor and respect are earned on this frigid field.

Also, should you ever lose your insignia, I am able to supply a replacement.

Incoming $n - look sharp, friends!
You'll rue the day you crossed me, $n.
Our ancestors teach us that while the individual must be strong, there is safety in numbers.  Do you wish to defend the honor of Thunder Bluff by organizing a guild?
Aye, you look the type to be a leader.  Here to organize a guild to fight for the Alliance?
I will not be lured away!
Shenthul, I have lost my whistle and I have no more flares. Please help!
female_text: Shenthul, I have lost my whistle and I have no more flares. Please help!

I know these forests as if they were a part of me... but know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

male_text: Raene, I lost Dartol's Rod of Transformation.
female_text: Raene, I lost Dartol's Rod of Transformation.

Yes, I expected that you would be back. I sent Korra out earlier and she came across Dartol's Rod, abandoned in the forest.$B$BWe worked so hard to recover it, $n. Please take care to see that you do not handle it so carelessly in the future.
You have completed Teronis' mission, and I appreciate all you have done, $n.

Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.$B$BYou've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...$B$BTanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?$B$B<Liv shakes her head.>$B$BNo, that's not it...

Hi there. No, Marvon sure isn't here, and he won't be back for quite some time. Actually, I am getting a little worried about him...$B$BI hope he gets back soon. A large chest arrived for him and it's too heavy for me to lug it inside here! I had to leave it out by the door...

male_text: You have learned all that I am able to teach you at this time, Doctor $n. Return to me when your practice has expanded and I shall train you in the ways of the more advanced medicinal arts.
Run! They are coming!
female_text: Run! They are coming!

This place... it's cursed.$B$BI barely managed to escape, and I cannot bear to go down through the tunnels again.$B$BMy brother, and sisters though... They were not as fortunate. Trapped inside, they are feverish with the corrupted haze that flows from the evil garden growing there.$B$BPlease, you must help.
Oh, I am so glad you have returned, $n.$B$BMy brother's spirit has now be freed from the corruption, but I choose to remain here, in my mourning.$B$BThank you so much for your help, $n.

male_text: Interlopers! Invaders! The All Seeing Eye has been stolen! The miserable dog, $n, has it in $g his:her; possession!

female_text: Need some supplies?

You have come to learn in the art of warfare, $r? You have come to the wrong place.
You have come to learn of battles won and lost on this field? There are no winners here...
Come, little ones. Face me!
This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate.
Such is the price of curiosity.
Greetings, soldier. Intelligence has reported that the Winterax trolls to the west have taken a master goblin engineer prisoner. Perhaps you should investigate?
My scouts report that the Syndicate has taken up residence in a hidden cave on the eastern plateau. Be cautious when adventuring in that area.

Watch your step, soldier. The Stormpike have littered the ground around their bases with landmines. Speak with our explosives expert in the watch tower to the east if you want information on how to diffuse their mine fields.

Look alive, soldier! Stormpike Intelligence has reported that a master goblin engineer has been taken prisoner by the Winterax trolls. The Frostwolf dogs are actively trying to rescue him so that they may use his engineered gadgets to destroy us! Do not let that happen.
The Syndicate have been reported to be nosing around in a cave on the eastern plateau. Find out what they're up to, soldier! Beware of Frostwolf activity!

Beware of entering Frostwolf territory, soldier. The whole damn place is booby trapped! Landmines galore! Speak with our explosives expert in the first tower on the front lines for more information. I am certain that he could teach you how to diffuse the situation.
Yes I have, Commander.
female_text: Yes I have, Commander.

male_text: Then listen well, $c.$B$BCan you feel the power radiating from me? Does your morale not swell? Aye, it is the same for the other side. To disrupt their defenses and thin out their troops will be no easy task, but it must be done! Victory will be ours!
Who do I kill? Just point me in their direction, Commander.
female_text: Who do I kill? Just point me in their direction, Commander.

male_text: Six Lieutenants control the front line's defenses. They must be destroyed first and fast! We cannot risk one of their priests returning the fallen Lieutenants to life.$B$BShould all of the Lieutenants be killed in quick succession, the morale of the front lines will falter! It will be shattered! Their troops will run in fear, leaving the remaining soldiers without backup.
Is that all? I thought you were going to challenge me.
female_text: Is that all? I thought you were going to challenge me.

male_text: No, $c, that is not all. The elite fighting forces of the opposition are commanded by the four Commanders of the base. Should you be able to strike a fatal and rapid blow to their Commanders, the elite line will falter. Their numbers dwindling to nothing!$B$BBut be warned, soldier; Commanders and Lieutenants are not to be trifled with or taken lightly. They earned those ranks...
Clap your hands everybody, and everybody clap your hands!
Thank you, you're a great audience!  I'll be here all week!
Spare some change?
I had it all!  I had it all and then I lost it.  Lost... all gone... like... my mind.  My mind is like... cheese.  I like cheese.
Show your appreciation for the arts and drop some coins in my hat!
Scanning life forms....target not found
Unknown life forms detected....assessing...
Target lost....resuming search patterns Delta
Explorer reporting!....Excellent!
%s stares hungrily at a Deeprun Rat.
Mmmm... don't you look good enough to eat.
On second thought... I think I'll pass.
Forty-two... forty-two... forty-two what?  It could be anything!  Forty-two... hmmm...
As you wish...
My strength wanes, mortal. I have done as promised, the way is clear. I now return to whence I came.
Helpless... powerless... restore... must restore... Zevrim controls... end this torment...

Thank you, mortal. There is but one service that I may offer to you before I return to the Dream.$B$BThe door to Zevrim's master, Alzzin, blocks your path. I shall act as your instrument of destruction. The door will be opened, I merely await your command.
Thank you, Ironbark. We are ready for you to open the door.
female_text: Thank you, Ironbark. We are ready for you to open the door.

The Shen'dralar were Queen Azshara's most revered arcanists. It was within these very walls that the Queen's most important demands were processed - often in secret.$B$BAfter the destruction of the Well and the subsequent lethargy that overcame the Highborne and lesser night elf sects, the Prince of Eldre'Thalas, Tortheldrin, began construction of the pylons that you see littering the halls of the west wing.

The Prince plotted to imprison a demon of immense power behind a grand force field. The pylons would channel latent energies into the field, keeping it operational.$B$BWhile imprisoned, Immol'thar would serve as a battery to the populace of Eldre'Thalas.

The siphoned energies would sustain the Highborne's magic, allowing those within the walls of Eldre'Thalas to feed their endless and growing magical pangs.$B$BThousands of years passed and the power required to keep Immol'thar imprisoned while sustaining life within Eldre'Thalas, began to shift. The cost to keep Immol'thar bound grew to overshadow the rate at which energy could be siphoned and distributed. The once net gain turned to loss.

The Highborne ghosts that you see wandering through the courtyard and halls of Eldre'Thalas were slain, not by invading Gordok ogres or satyrs, but by the Prince himself!

female_text: We live in a world of endless tragedy.

The people were destroyed in order to preserve the Prince's immortal life and near limitless powers. The power once divided among thousands now funnels into the Prince and the Shen'dralar zealots. Those few remaining survivors are directly feeding power into the pylons in order to keep Immol'thar imprisoned.$B$BShould the demon break free of its bonds, it would surely destroy what little is left of this once great bastion of arcana.

For 10,000 years I have ruled this kingdom. In that time, I have heard many fascinating tales from those that would walk the hallowed grounds of the House of Shen'dralar.$B$BAs I am bound to this place, I often exchange stories with visitors. Do you have a story for me or perhaps you would like to hear a story?
Who dares disrupt the sanctity of Eldre'Thalas? Face me, cowards!
We mustn't anger the Master. His is a wrath that is cruel beyond measure.

The Lorekeeper is an ancient. He has served under our glorious Queen!

Hey, who Fengus callin' a gnoll lover?!  Take da prisoners to da king; you smart to bring them with their weapons and show da king that they a threat.  I'll go see if Fengus talk smack when I give him da beatdown!  HAR!
No one get past me and threaten da king!  Ungh, take it!!
What you doin' wanderin' around here?  Why them small fries not in da shackles?!
You da strong one now!  All hail to da new king of da Gordok!
Um, I'm taking some prisoners we found outside before the king for punishment.

I personally didn't mind him. It was the Prince who took exception to a high elf in his domain. Alas, I am not one to question the Prince. In his defense, he did not incinerate Master Winthalus immediately.

We most definitely do not need anymore attention drawn to us, stranger. Return to those that sent you in search of the lost master and tell them that nothing could be found. When this is done - and I will know when it is so - return and I shall reveal the secrets of the deceased.

So, now that I'm the king... what have you got for me?!

Hail to da new king!

I cause you no trouble, boss.

That's all these bozos understand - power.$B$BIt would seem that the more henchmen you keep alive, the higher your tribute will be.  Not to shabby - makes for an interesting challenge I'd say.  If you leave, I wouldn't expect to remain king.  One of these yokels will no doubt step up and take your place.$B$BOne more thing... you didn't happen to find my key, did you?
The king is dead - OH NOES!  Summon Mizzle da Crafty!  He knows what to do next!
What you must understand is that being able to index 10,000 years of existence has given me a rather unique perspective on life. Your present day trials and tribulations are meaningless.

Oh the drama and fuss the young Master exerted. You would think the fate of the world rested squarely on his shoulders. Only mortals could have such a skewed perspective on our world.$B$BAlas, he left me with his meager magical secrets... Librams or some such nonsense. I have no use for these paultry magics but perhaps you might be interested in their enchantments.
Where is "Garona: A Study in Stealth and Treachery!" These texts must be returned!

Bear witness to the undeniable power of your Warchief! Be lifted by the rallying cry of your dragon slayers!
Gaze upon the enemy, $r. See what the might of the Horde reduces even the most powerful of dragons to! All that oppose us shall meet a similar fate!
I am he that carries out the Warchief's commands without question. I am Horde.
Citizens and allies of Stormwind, on this day, history has been made. $n has laid waste to that which had attempted to usurp the rule of the kingdom. Gather round and join me in honoring our heroes.
Behold the might of the Alliance! The dread lady, Onyxia, hangs from the arches! Let the rallying cry of the dragon slayer lift your spirits!
I live only to serve our King.
Perhaps one day, your contributions to the Alliance will be as great as the heroes you have seen this day. Honor them, $n.

<Lydros reaches into his robe and presents you with a dull, flat elven blade.>$B$BIn ages past, well before even the War of the Ancients, there existed this blade.

female_text: Fascinating, Lorekeeper. Continue please.

male_text: The blade itself had to be crafted in ceremony with the children of the Aspects. A rare occurrence indeed... For not only would a dragon have to willingly heat and mold the enchanted metal with their breath, they would also need to contain the fury of their own enchantment by using their blood as temper.
(Continue.)
female_text: (Continue.)

male_text: Rumors exist of a single, legendary blade of Quel'Serrar crafted for an unknown entity by the combined might of the five Aspects. Before the abominations of Nefarian and Deathwing were thrust into our world, such meetings of the Aspect were represented by the term 'Prismatic.' I could only assume that the Prismatic Blade of Quel'Serrar was a most glorious creation.
(Continue.)
female_text: (Continue.)

male_text: What I offer to you now is one such blade, unfired, unheated, untreated - the most raw and basic form.$B$BNow you merely need to find a dragon that will willingly enchant the blade.$B$BIf you had an eternity to live, this might be a possibility; but since you are mortal and could very likely cease to exist at any moment, might I recommend trying to persuade one of the lesser dragons to do your bidding.

female_text: Have you ever heard of a place called Dire Maul?

Why do you say that this is a coincidence, Rabine?
female_text: Why do you say that this is a coincidence, Rabine?

male_text: Agents of the Cenarion Circle have uncovered disturbing information pertaining to the current situation in Eldre'Thalas.  I am at an impasse as to what to do about it, and I will no doubt soon seek the aid of able bodied beings capable of handling themselves in a fight.$B$BTo properly take action in Eldre'Thalas, however, is to understand the lore of an object known as the Fruit of Fertility.
The Fruit of Fertility?
female_text: The Fruit of Fertility?

male_text: In ages past, Eldre'Thalas was a nexus of magical power, and those who dwelt within its hallowed halls wielded immense power.  One such night elf was Millicent Serene - a naturalist who willed the power of nature itself into potent artifacts she forged.$B$BThe Fruit of Fertility was her crowning achievement... she used a specially prepared moonwell to grow an exotic and vibrant vine that was imbued with an aura of protection and growth.  All of Eldre'Thalas flourished from its existence.
But something went wrong, didn't it?
female_text: But something went wrong, didn't it?

male_text: Alas, it always seems like it does.  I - as did the rest of the Cenarion Circle - had assumed that Milli's creation was destroyed during the War of the Ancients.  This, as I have come to learn, is far from correct.$B$BThe Fruit of Fertility survived... though now it is known as the Felvine.  It is being corrupted by the demonic lord of that section of Eldre'Thalas, Alzzin the Wildshaper.
What would happen if the Fruit of Fertility - or the Felvine - was allowed to be fully corrupted?
female_text: What would happen if the Fruit of Fertility - or the Felvine - was allowed to be fully corrupted?

male_text: I... cannot begin to imagine, $n.  All I know is that I am not going to allow it to happen.  It will be destroyed - if not for our continued safety from demonic taint, then for the memory of Millicent Serene... Milli...$B$BThis, my friend, this is where I hope you will come in.
What would you have me do, Rabine?
female_text: What would you have me do, Rabine?

male_text: Speak with me, $n - if you are willing, the Cenarion Circle would eagerly accept your generous offer of aid.  The threat posed by the Felvine of Eldre'Thalas is indeed dire.
<Demitrian falls to his knees.>$B$BYou have recovered my Master's eternal prison!$B$BOh long have I waited for this day and finally, it is realized.$B$BHe must be released!
What must be done?
female_text: What must be done?

male_text: I hold the vessel of his rebirth. Should you be prepared to take on this task, you will be required to fortify the vessel and ultimately, break the hold of Ragnaros himself!
The Firelord and all who dare stand in my way shall reel from my wrath.
female_text: The Firelord and all who dare stand in my way shall reel from my wrath.

female_text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

female_text: I shall scour the earth for this Earthshaper. What of the essence?

Ah, and the fool who freed me shall be among the first to quell my immense hunger.
My power is discombobulatingly devastating! It is ludicrous that these mortals even attempt to enter my realm!
<Demitrian laughs.>$B$BYour reward is a quick and painful death, fool!
Summon forth your cowardly master, fool! Let him face me!

Are you the Earthshaper capable of creating Elementium?

female_text: What do you know of it, Franzahl?

male_text: A former student of mine by the name of Krixix spent a lifetime attempting to make contact with the chained Gods of the underworld. He pursued that which would spring up from the ravaged earth... That which would form only as a result of the elements clashing in titanic conflict.$B$BElementium as it would be known to mortals.$B$BOne day, nearly a decade ago, Krixix's pursuit lead to a fissure forming in this very gorge.
A fissure?
female_text: A fissure?

male_text: Aye, he had done what was thought to be impossible. Out from the fissure sprung an agent of Therazane!$B$BFrom my vantage point, I could see the goblin holding conversation with the agent of the Old God. What happened after that was terrible...
So what happened?
female_text: So what happened?

male_text: The fissure closed and Krixix was gone! Swallowed whole!$B$BBe warned, $r, what you wish for could very well become that which you do not want. You play with beings and arcana that are older than time itself!$B$BShould Krixix be alive and should he have the information which you seek, you can be certain that he will not give up said information. He has faced terrors far worse than you could ever dream to perpetrate.
There comes a time when the life we know falls short.  We are trapped and look for answers, and we find hope burning in dark places.$B$BOnly then, $n, do we take our first steps to freedom.
Do you have any spiders or beetles, $c?  They scurry fast, but if you're faster then you'll find them quite a treat!
Gorzeeki, I wish to make a purchase.
female_text: Gorzeeki, I wish to make a purchase.

male_text: Did you just come out of a dungeon?  Did you get me anything?
Your armor looks scary.  Are you scary too?
I cannot permit you to enter the Temple!  I must destroy you for your own good!
A sacrifice will be due if I am ever called upon, mortal...
If I fall into the abyss, I'll take all of you mortals with me!
%s flee as the controlling power of the orb is drained.
When I grow up, I wanna be the king of Stormwind!
I've been to Ironforge before.  It smells funny there.
Mushrooms always grow in damp places and so they look like umbrellas.
If overalls are held up by the snaps at the top, then why do they have belt loops?
What happens if your snot freezes in your nose?
Do fish ever get thirsty?
If you try to fail and succeed, what did you just do?
If you're a real hero of the Horde, then I wanna see you fight a dragon!  Yeah!
When lightning strikes the ocean why don't all the fish die?
Would a fly without wings be called a walk?
I have a rock in my nose.
If a turtle doesn't have a shell, is he homeless or naked?
What does "zug zug" mean?
If your glove is too big, does it still fit like a glove?
You are certainly a long way from home, $r.
I have come to learn, Daio.
female_text: I have come to learn, Daio.

male_text: So, you have found me. I suppose that you have come to learn of suppression and control.$B$BI will teach you much more than that... you will also learn of sacrifice.$B$B<Daio grins.>
What would I sacrifice?
female_text: What would I sacrifice?

male_text: That will be the choice of the demon you wish to conjure and enslave. We wield dark powers and we pay grossly for the use of said powers.
How can I conjure a demon?
female_text: How can I conjure a demon?

male_text: We must first craft a prison to confine the beast, if you wish to progress further.
I have regained control! Everyone - back to your posts!
This is it, Impsy. I can feel it! This is the big one!
Brace yourself for the glorious impact, Impsy!
Kick me out, will they!? I'll show those uptight cone heads in Stormwind the true power of Niby! BEHOLD!
%s shakes his fist in frustration.
Niby, you are stupid.
Oh my, what a surprise! Another failure!? But how, oh great one??
Awe inspiring, master. Your ineptitude is awe inspiring.
Why you little!
Ack! Help! Crazed gnome trying to kill me!
Bow in my presence, insect! Surely you can feel the power I hold over you.
I am in search of a great and powerful Warlock.
female_text: I am in search of a great and powerful Warlock.

male_text: So you have come to Niby to learn the secrets of calling down an infernal servant from the Nether.$B$BSilence! Niby knows all!$B$BNiby is not so quick to part with such knowledge. First, you must assist Niby with a very important task.
What task?
female_text: What task?

male_text: There is a powerful infernal named Kroshius northeast of this camp. It is why Niby is here. Kroshius is a greater infernal - an infernal that has lasted longer than expected. You see, nub, an infernal crashes down into the earth with great intensity to serve its master but this intensity fades fast. Once the blazing flames have died down, the infernal crumbles.
This is all very interesting but what is it that you want?
female_text: This is all very interesting but what is it that you want?

male_text: Do not interrupt Niby, fool! I shall rend the flesh from your bones and use your skeletal remains as a coat rack. Now where was I? Oh yes, so, Kroshius lasted nearly ten times longer than any ordinary infernal. I am not sure why but I am confident that with enough study, I could find out.$B$BI need you to recover Kroshius' Infernal Core.
How do I do that?
female_text: How do I do that?

male_text: If I am to teach you the secrets of summoning an infernal servant, you must destroy Kroshius and bring me the infernal core from his burning remains. This, however, is not as easy as it sounds. Kroshius has all but burned out completely. You must reignite his corpse and raise him from the rubble. To do this, however, you must gather some components from other demonic entities.$B$BMy imp, Impsy, shall set you on your way.
Kroshius live? Kroshius crush!
Stand back! Stand clear! The infernal will need to be given a wide berth!
BOW DOWN TO THE ALMIGHTY! BOW DOWN BEFORE MY INFERNAL DESTRO... chicken?
%s rolls on the floor laughing.
Niby, you're an idiot.
Silence, servant! Vengeance will be mine! Death to Stormwind! Death by chicken!

A Sulfuron ingot?!??! Impossible! I must have it! I must! I must!$B$B$R, I am authorized to make you a grand deal for that ingot. Perhaps you would be interested to know the secrets of the Hand of Ragnaros? Sulfuras, idiot! The legendary hammer of the Firelord.
Hrm, I'm listening. What is this offer?
female_text: Hrm, I'm listening. What is this offer?

male_text: In exchange for one Sulfuron Ingot, I am authorized to grant you one copy of the plans to forge a Sulfuron hammer.$B$BNow an adventurer like yourself is probably thinking to $g himself:herself;, "What would I ever need a hammer like that for when what I already own is far superior?"$B$BWell let me tell you something, $g mister:missy;, there ain't nothing more superior than what the Sulfuron hammer can become!
You've got my attention.
female_text: You've got my attention.

male_text: You see, all you gotta do is forge the Sulfuron hammer and find yourself the Eye of Sulfuras. Combine the Eye of Sulfuras with the Sulfuron hammer and it will become Sulfuras! Now I'm not going to bog you down with any technical information as to where or how or when you can get an Eye of Sulfuras. I'm sure you'll figure that stuff out. Just sign this here contract so that our agreement is binding and our business will be done.
Give me the contract.
female_text: Give me the contract.

female_text: PEASANT CROSSES LINE.

female_text: YOU ARE THE WINNER!

female_text: YOU ARE THE LOSER. BOO.

I now return to whence I came, only to find myself here once more to relive the same epic tragedy.

male_text: At last, it ends....
female_text: At last, it ends....

male_text: Thank you, kind stranger. May your heroism never be forgotten.
female_text: Thank you, kind stranger. May your heroism never be forgotten.

female_text: We shall be reunited once more, my love...

female_text: The power of the light is truly great and merciful.
Be healed, $g priest:priestess;.

There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.$B$BOne week out of the year during the Spring, the Horde takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

male_text: Tiny mortals - me HERE! Doom you meet!

male_text: What?!  You no can beat me!  Me will return!
You have not seen the last of me fools!  All shall be consumed in the end!
Hear me, denizens of the Crater!  I come to burn this land of its impurity!
Lady Jaina, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your autograph.
female_text: Lady Jaina, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your autograph.

male_text: This frozen land shall suffice for a start.  Come to me, mortals - and I shall give you a quick and painful death.

Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.$B$BThe spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.
%s dissipates into the ether, his howling winds still ringing in your ears.
%s and his invading forces appear amidst a tumultuous conflagration in the northwest of Silithus.
Chief Bloodhoof, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your hoofprint.
female_text: Chief Bloodhoof, this may sound like an odd request... but I have a young ward who is quite shy.  You are a hero to him, and he asked me to get your hoofprint.

male_text: Ah, a young warrior to be no doubt!  I take it you are participating in Children's Week, yes?  It warms these weary bones to hear that you are setting the example by which others will be sure to follow.$B$BI'd be delighted to oblige you and the young lad.  Hrmm... what advice should I give to him?  Listen to the spirits, yes... maybe something about eating all of his vegetables too...
The Week of the Wardens is not yet over... may I have another Orphan Whistle?
female_text: The Week of the Wardens is not yet over... may I have another Orphan Whistle?

male_text: You be too scared!  Me find you!
If you mortals are all so craven, this will be easier than I thought!
Well what do you know, this is Children's Week!  What can I do to help?
female_text: Well what do you know, this is Children's Week!  What can I do to help?

male_text: Where are the so-called heroes of this world?  Too frightened to come out and play?

female_text: Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  Huzzah!
Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  For the Horde!

I won't make it... go... go on without me...
female_text: I won't make it... go... go on without me...

male_text: The pain is unbearable!
female_text: The pain is unbearable!

female_text: Should I live through this, I shall make it my life's sole ambition to destroy Arthas...

Now children stop that!  I mean it!
All will be well children.  The Light shall see to that!
I believe you children are our future...
You are mine now children.  You will grow up to be a strong part of the horde!
Stop whining!
Clean this place up! We will not live in such squalor.
It's my way or the Gold Road.  Is that understood?

female_text: Only the renowned Doctor Gregory Victor can improve your skill now.  He can be found in Arathi Highlands at Hammerfall.

female_text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

female_text: The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

female_text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

female_text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

male_text: Well duties call, yes?  First, the bell... to give you vigor!
Next, I'll place the wheel... to protect you from harm.
And finally the candle... to burn those who would thwart you!
Ah, freedom!  Although brief, so sweet it is...
$n, my duties are complete and I shall now take my leave.  Luck to you my $gfellow:lady;, and remember to keep the Bell, Wheel and Candle working!

female_text: Praise the Light, one has finally answered the calling.

male_text: But wait...
$n, summon me again when you need to perform the ritual again.
Until then, I shall take my leave...

female_text: Too many have fallen, $g priest:priestess;. You must focus!

male_text: The Scourge are upon us! Run! Run for your lives!
female_text: The Scourge are upon us! Run! Run for your lives!

male_text: Please help us! The Prince has gone mad!
female_text: Please help us! The Prince has gone mad!

male_text: Seek sanctuary in the Hearthglen! It is our only hope!
female_text: Seek sanctuary in the Hearthglen! It is our only hope!

male_text: Stratholme is no more! The city lies in ruins. The Prince consumed by hatred... madness...
female_text: Stratholme is no more! The city lies in ruins. The Prince consumed by hatred... madness...

male_text: The Eye led me here, Eris.
female_text: The Eye led me here, Eris.
<Eris nods.>$B$BThe Eye has seen so many horrors and so many wonders.$B$BIt displays what it feels the one looking into it is most suited to see.

male_text: And I was suited to see this?
female_text: And I was suited to see this?

You were. The Eye is never wrong.$B$BYou are a $g priest:priestess;, after all. A powerful $g priest:priestess;, if the Eye showed you this horrible memory.$B$BYou have come for redemption, yet you yourself do not even realize this... Do you?

male_text: I really did not know what to expect, Eris. I will use my powers to assist you if that is what is asked of me.
female_text: I really did not know what to expect, Eris. I will use my powers to assist you if that is what is asked of me.

I know you will, $n.$B$BI myself am a priestess, though, unlike you I am long since gone from this world. My spirit, however, remains here, as do the spirits of the thousands who were brutally slain by the mad Prince, Arthas Menethil and his legion of undeath.

male_text: Those days are over, Eris.
female_text: Those days are over, Eris.

I never stated that you were here to redeem yourself, $g priest:priestess;. You are here to redeem me and the innocents murdered while trying to escape Stratholme.$B$BMy spirit and the spirit of those lost are bound here, cursed to endlessly relive our own tragic deaths.

male_text: So what can I do to help?
female_text: So what can I do to help?

You must do what I could not: Save the peasants that were cut down while fleeing from Stratholme.$B$BThey will walk towards the light, you must ensure their survival. Should too many fall, our cursed existence shall continue - you will have failed.$B$BEvery ability, prayer, and spell that you have learned will be tested. May the Light protect you, $n.

male_text: You dare interfere with this being's test? The battle must be fought alone! You shall all suffer for this indiscretion.
Who dares steal my precious mount?  You will pay for your insolence, mortal!

female_text: We are saved! The peasants have escaped the Scourge!

male_text: The spirit of the Dreadsteed pulses with rage.
Arrr, Me Hearties!   I be havin' some extra Treasure that I be givin' away at the Gurubashi Arena!  All ye need do to collect it is open the chest I leave on the arena floor!
Let the Bloodletting Begin!
%s recoils in pain as the Judgement of Wisdom washes over it!
The ways of Jaedenar are dark and treacherous.  Watch your moves in this place, $C, or you will find your soul entralled by your rivals...
I wish to purchase from you.
female_text: I wish to purchase from you.

male_text: You dog!  Now I'll trap your soul into a shard and give you to my imp as a plaything!
Be gone!  I hold counsel with Dreadlords, and the matters we discuss are not your concern!
Dreadlords?  Perhaps you mean Lord Banehollow.  He sends his regards, and has a message for you...
female_text: Dreadlords?  Perhaps you mean Lord Banehollow.  He sends his regards, and has a message for you...

male_text: ... A message from Banehollow?  What message is that?  Does he have need of his great advisor and servant, Ulathek?  Does he require my presence?
No, Ulathek.  He knows your secret.  He knows you plot with Lord Hel'nurath of Xoroth.
female_text: No, Ulathek.  He knows your secret.  He knows you plot with Lord Hel'nurath of Xoroth.

male_text: What?  But how?  No!  This is not possible!  I have been so careful... he could not know!$B$BYou lie!  You lie, and now you'll die for your deceit!
It's no lie, traitor.  Banehollow wants your heart, and I'm going to get it for him.
female_text: It's no lie, traitor.  Banehollow wants your heart, and I'm going to get it for him.

male_text: I'm finished.  The parchment is made.  Now, return to Gorzeeki...
You are mine, dreadsteed!  Your spirit is now bound to me!
female_text: You are mine, dreadsteed!  Your spirit is now bound to me!
What a wonderful day to be alive! Look at the beauty that surrounds you, friend. Enjoy what life has to give!

male_text: *GRRRR* *RUFF* *RUFF*
Lava? Pay no mind to all of that, friend. Look around you. Take in the joys that nature has to offer.
I come to Silithus every year around this time. The weather is phenomenal for my bunions.$B$BYou should take a stroll with me, friend. Enjoy the sights and what not.
How wonderful to see another person in this remote region of the world. Come, walk with me. Let our bodies keep each other warm.
The officers' lounge
female_text: The officers' lounge

male_text: Look for it high up on the west side of the Valley of Strength. They'll only let you in if you're an officer! Talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside otherwise.
female_text: Look for it high up on the west side of the Valley of Strength. They'll only let you in if you're an officer! Talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside otherwise.

female_text: I know you as Artorius the Doombringer. Show yourself, demon! Face me!

female_text: You want the Hall of Legends. It's high above the Valley of Strength on the west side. If you're not an officer you can't get in, but you can still talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside.

female_text: A gnome? How pathetic. Face me, demon!

female_text: So you are Klinfran the Crazed? Sad, I was expecting an actual challenge. Do you dare face me in your true form?

female_text: Officers' Lounge

%s laughs at your foolish request.
As you wish, $c.
Do I look like a fool, mortal? Because only a fool would remain here and do battle with you and all of your allies. Perhaps another time... Should you ever find the courage to back up your banter.
%s is silenced by the venomous sting.

male_text: %s breaks free of its spectral bonds with a tremendous crash of thunder!
%s goes into a killing frenzy!
The ritual is already underway!
$n, I shall leave before one of these beasts takes a liking to me!
%s is pulled back to Xoroth!
Ah, here we are!  Well let's get to work, shall we...?
Oh, right!  Over here now...
And now... the final step!
I shall enjoy this, $c.
%s recoils in pain as the Judgement of Light washes over it!
%s recoils in pain as the Judgement of Justice washes over it!
%s recoils in pain as the Judgement of Righteousness washes over it!

%s assembles the runecloth, herbs, and holy water to the barding.
%s smiths the arcanite into place on the barding.
Well, that should do it.  Come now, back to the shop to finish our business!
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!$B$BGrimand Elmore, at your service!
%s emerges from the darkness, drawn out by the divination scryer!
You dare challenge me? Prepare for an eternity of dread.
%s notes your cowardly battle tactics and flees from battle.
ENOUGH - this ends now!  You fools will be added to my bone collection!
%s is immobilized.
%s is stricken by a virulent poison.
Your soul is mine, weakling.

To summon a Dreadsteed, you must first create a Circle of Greater Summoning.  A portal to Xoroth may only be created from within such a circle.$B$BThe Circle of Greater Summoning requires three powerful implements: a Bell of Dethmoora, a Wheel of the Black March and a Doomsday Candle.
Your preparations are complete.  All that now stands before you and your dreadsteed is the ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning, and the binding of the dreadsteed's spirit...

Gorzeeki tells me that you have brought him all that he needs for the Bell of Dethmoora, the Wheel of the Black March and the Doomsday Candle.$B$BWell done, $n!  You are almost ready to perform your ritual and bind a dreadsteed!
Greetings, $n.  How goes your delvings into the demonic and arcane?  Have you uncovered any dark secrets of late?
Merideth, could I have some more manna-enriched horse feed please?
female_text: Merideth, could I have some more manna-enriched horse feed please?

male_text: %s flinches as its skin shimmers.
Ah...the heroes. You are persistent, aren't you? Your ally here attempted to match his power against mine - and paid the price. Now he shall serve me...by slaughtering you.
Arr!   There be nothin I like to see better than folks fightin to the death in the arena.   If you be here at the right time maybe you can be one of them!
Don't interrupt me.
A slippery tile causes you to lose your footing.

Ragefire Chasm consists of a network of volcanic caverns below the orcs' new capital city of Orgrimmar. Recently, rumors have spread that a cult loyal to the demonic Shadow Council has taken up residence within the Chasm's fiery depths. This cult, known as the Burning Blade, threatens the very sovereignty of Durotar. Many believe that the orc Warchief Thrall is aware of the Blade's existence and has chosen not to destroy it in the hopes that its members might lead him straight to the Shadow Council.

Recently, a night elf druid named Naralex discovered a network of underground caverns within the heart of the Barrens. Believing he could use the caverns' springs to restore lushness to the Barrens, the druid began siphoning the energies of the fabled Emerald Dream. Frustrated by the Dalaran wizards' lack of progress against the undead during the Third War, the Archmage Arugal elected to summon the extra-dimensional worgen to bolster his side's diminishing ranks. The wolf-men slaughtered the Scourge, then quickly turned on the wizards themselves and laid siege to the keep of the noble, Baron Silverlaine. The fort quickly fell into shadow and ruin. Driven mad with guilt, Arugal adopted the worgen as his children and retreated to the newly dubbed 'Shadowfang Keep'.

male_text: Located in Dun Morogh, Gnomeregan has been the gnomes' capital city for generations, though it was recently infested by mutant troggs. In a desperate attempt to retaliate, High Tinker Mekkatorque ordered the emergency venting of the city's radioactive waste tanks. Though the troggs became irradiated, their siege continued unabated and the gnomes were forced to seek refuge in the dwarven city of Ironforge, where the High Tinker now enlists brave souls to help his people reclaim their beloved city.

The ruins' three distinct districts have been overrun by all manner of creatures - especially the spectral highborne, foul satyr and brutish ogres.

male_text: The Scholomance is housed in crypts beneath the Caer Darrow keep. Once owned by the noble Barov family, the keep fell to ruin after the Second War. As the wizard Kel'Thuzad enlisted followers for his Cult of the Damned, he often promised immortality for those who served his Lich King. The Barovs fell to his influence and donated their keep, but the cultists killed the family and turned the crypts into a school of necromancy. Though Kel'Thuzad no longer resides there, cultists and instructors still remain.

male_text: Hello, Rutgar. The Commander has sent me here to gather some information about his missing wife.
female_text: Hello, Rutgar. The Commander has sent me here to gather some information about his missing wife.

male_text: You best have a seat then, this is gonna be a long one.$B$BWhen we initially arrived in Silithus, Mistress Mar'alith was the first of the night elves from Cenarion Hold to join the expedition. Our routine was nothing out of the ordinary: Form a party to venture into the various hives and search for lost artifacts.
That sounds dangerous.
female_text: That sounds dangerous.

male_text: It sure is! Those hives were abuzz with various silithid that were none too happy to see us.$B$BEverything was going fine until we came across a glyphed crystal in Hive'Regal. She was drawn to it like a moth to a flame! She put her pretty little cheek up against the crystal and instantly entered a trance-like state. Naturally, this worried my crew. We picked her up and carried her out of there with a quickness!
What happened to her after that?
female_text: What happened to her after that?

male_text: We took her to the Commander with hopes that the druids of the Circle could fix her up. Sure enough, they were able to wake her up. We figured our business with the Circle was done and we could get back to work.$B$BA few weeks passed and everything was going fine. Brann was still around back then so we had a bit of order in our work structure. Then one day, out of the blue, she appeared back at our camp.
Natalia?
female_text: Natalia?

male_text: Are you daft? Who else would I be talking about? Yes, the girl - Mistress Mar'alith. Anyhow, she was back and not in too good of a mood. That's when the demands started flowing.
What demands?
female_text: What demands?

male_text: She demanded that we immediately head back to Hive'Regal! Brann would have none of that sass. He told her that there's no way we would go back into those hives without an army backing us up. It had gotten far too dangerous. The number of those stinking insects seemed to have tripled from when we first ventured into 'em.$B$BThat's when Natalia lost it!
Lost it? What do you mean?
female_text: Lost it? What do you mean?

male_text: What do you mean what do I mean? She went nutso! The girl went straight crazy on us. Now ordinarily I don't hit girls but after I recovered from the blackout, I was pretty damned angry. Brann, Rutgar, me and the monkey went positively orc on her! It's a miracle we were able to fend her off. She seemed almost possessed!
Possessed by what?
female_text: Possessed by what?

male_text: Who knows? Anyhow, that was the last I saw of her. Maybe Frankal can give you better information.$B$BNot to steer off topic here as I'm sure the work you're doing for the Commander is important, but we're onto something huge here. HUGE! Our requests to Ironforge for an army have so far fallen on deaf ears. Apparently we're stretched too thin in protecting the realm or some such nonsense. Once you take your report back to the Commander, come back down here with some friends. We need your help!
I'll be back once I straighten this mess out.
female_text: I'll be back once I straighten this mess out.

male_text: Hello, Frankal. I've heard that you might have some information as to the whereabouts of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
female_text: Hello, Frankal. I've heard that you might have some information as to the whereabouts of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.

male_text: Oh brother, not this again... Have a seat $g sonny:missy;.$B$BI'm sure Rutgar has told you some of this story already so I'll spare you the boring details and get right down to the nitty gritty.
That's what I like to hear.
female_text: That's what I like to hear.

male_text: Right then! So the Mistress had come back for a second go at the hives but Brann was having none of that nonsense! Before the melee began, she started talking to something or someone. Crazier still, she started chanting in a language none of us had ever heard.
That's odd.
female_text: That's odd.

male_text: You're telling me! It's even stranger considering between Brann, Rutgar, me and the monkey, we know 38 different languages including a touch of Titan - both Vanir and Aesir.$B$BSo anyway, whatever she was click clacking about, it definitely wasn't with anyone "present." She then nodded and went on the offensive! Attacked us outright!
You couldn't handle a lone night elf priestess?
female_text: You couldn't handle a lone night elf priestess?

male_text: Listen $g sonny:missy;, I'll have you know that whatever attacked us was no priestess of nothin'! Her eyes were aglow with something evil and she was genuinely frothing at the mouth! She came in, did some kind of crazy scream that sent us all runnin' in separate directions then started flayin' our minds one by one. I'd be hearin' shadowy words in my head, watchin' the other's periodically black out here and there. It was madness! We would have been done for if not for the damned monkey.
I've been meaning to ask you about that monkey.
female_text: I've been meaning to ask you about that monkey.

male_text: What's there to ask? He's a monkey you crazy fool. Anyhow, so yea, the monkey went into a frenzy after seein' ol' Brann flop into the sand face first. Nothin' the night elf could do was stopping Glibb here from poundin' on her noggin.
Then what?
female_text: Then what?

male_text: I'll tell you 'then what.' She went runnin' straight for the hive. And you know what's crazier? Not a single damned bug got in her way or tried to stop her. She ran through them all as if she'd been best friends with 'em for centuries.
What a story! So she went into Hive'Regal and that was the last you saw of her?
female_text: What a story! So she went into Hive'Regal and that was the last you saw of her?

male_text: Yep.
Thanks for the information, Frankal.
female_text: Thanks for the information, Frankal.

female_text: Tell me how to use the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon.

Oh that's simple! You use it like anything else you might activate. Don't worry, I'll take care of lighting the fuse. Once you're up in the air you'll notice that you'll seem to "float," but that won't last forever. What you're aiming for is a target on the lake way over yonder. Make sure that you begin your descent by detaching your "wings" at the right time to land in the water, or, well, I don't sell life insurance.

I've come back to my old home so my knowledge may be passed on.  Unlike the mindless undead around me, I've chosen this unlife for my own reasons.$B$BThe silithid are formidable opponents, $n.  I've learned to respect them as much as I despise them.$B$BMuch of their deadliness comes from the strength and lightness of their chitin, which I've learned to work into armor.  As we seem to have a common enemy I shall teach you my trade.

Hello $c, and welcome to the Darkmoon Faire. There is so much to do here at the faire that it can be a little overwhelming for our first time visitors. That's why I'm here to help. Do you have any questions?

male_text: What can I purchase?
female_text: What can I purchase?

An excellent question! We have many things for sale here at the faire. If you are interested in food and drink, then head over to Stamp and Sylannia's booth. My favorite is the Darkmoon Special Reserve.

If you'd rather purchase something more exotic, then Lhara may have just the thing for you. She specializes in rarities from all over the world.

And then there is Flik running around here somewhere. If you can grab him he sells balls for throwing and frogs to keep as pets.

male_text: What are Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets and how do I get them?
female_text: What are Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets and how do I get them?

Glad you asked. Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets are our way of letting you help with the faire, and in return you can turn in your tickets for special prizes!

To get started you'll want to talk to Chronos, Kerri Hicks, Ringling and Yebb Nebblegear to see who you can best help. They always have something that needs doing to improve and expand our attractions.

Then when you have enough tickets, speak with Gelvas Grimegate and he will give you a list of prizes to choose from.

male_text: What are Darkmoon Cards?
female_text: What are Darkmoon Cards?

No one really knows who made the Darkmoon Cards or what their true purpose is, but I can tell you that they have been found all over Azeroth, usually in the hands of a villain attempting to unlock their mysteries.

There are four types of Darkmoon Cards; Beasts, Elementals, Portals and Warlords, with eight cards, Ace to Eight in each suit. If you collect all eight of one suit then you can turn them into a deck that you can give to our Professor Thaddeus Paleo in exchange for a powerful trinket.

male_text: What other things can I do at the faire?
female_text: What other things can I do at the faire?

I highly recommend that you visit Sayge to get your fortune told. I know, I know... he's a gnoll.  But he's a very special gnoll with the power to divine your future!$B$BAnd we are constantly expanding the faire with all manner of new attractions!

male_text: We have more than one enemy in Silithus, $N.$B$BWhile everyone's attention is focused on the silithid, my big brother and I have been keeping a close eye on the Twilight's Hammer crazies.

female_text: I highly recommend that you visit Sayge to get your fortune told. I know, I know... he's a gnoll.  But he's a very special gnoll with the power to divine your future!$B$BAnd we are constantly expanding the faire with all manner of new attractions!

Greetings, ancient one. I have done all that has been asked of me. I now ask that you grant me Rhok'delar.
female_text: Greetings, ancient one. I have done all that has been asked of me. I now ask that you grant me Rhok'delar.

male_text: Bawk, bawk, bawk!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

female_text: I may have ninety-nine problems, but dancin' ain't one of them!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!
Chugga-chugga, woo-woo!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!
Ooo, so strong!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

Greetings, traveler. It was here, nearly 1,000 years past, that the Qiraji began their march of destruction across Kalimdor.$B$BThousands of lives were lost during the war, most in this cursed desert during the initial invasion.$B$BI am one of only a few that remain, chained to both the past and the present. I know not why I am to remain stationed here but I know that I must.

male_text: How do you know?
female_text: How do you know?
I have been slain a hundred times. I always wake here, alive. Some say I am cursed and others...

male_text: What do they say?
female_text: What do they say?
They say that I am blessed: A herald to harken in a new age.

male_text: And what do you say?
female_text: And what do you say?

Ancient forces stir - forces that have not been seen or felt for thousands of years. The world weeps, $r. Perhaps a new sundering comes. A sickness born from within...$B$BThe foulness has begun to seep into our lands. From the Dream come nightmares. Nightmares to befoul us in our waking hours...
Ooo, so strong!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

male_text: Bawk, bawk, bawk!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!
Chugga-chugga, woo-woo!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

female_text: I may have ninety-nine problems, but dancin' ain't one of them!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

male_text: You will pay the ultimate price for this insolence, little vermin.  Your soul is mine!
This act of defiance will not go unpunished.  You, and your world, will die!
What?  Such a small, frail thing beckons me?  This will not go unpunished!
Imposter!  It is a dishonor without equal to be summoned by a whelp such as you!  DIE!
Your treachery only speeds your doom.  This world will fall to darkness!
You dare!  Outrageous!  I curse you, $c.  I curse you with... death!
What?  Such a small, frail thing beckons me?  I shall add your bones to my throne, $r!!

female_text: Happy Hallow's End!  Do you like my mask?  Very scary!
Happy Hallow's End!  How do you like my mask?  Very scary!

male_text: Killing you and your cohorts, $c, will amuse me.  I shall make it quick.

female_text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

male_text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

female_text: You're the best, $n - thanks for going trick-or-treating for me!

What Hallow's End candy do you have for sale?
female_text: What Hallow's End candy do you have for sale?
