Maybe this is the pity talking but I will offer some advice.$B$BIn the Tanaris desert you'll find a hut that belongs to Narain Soothfancy. In that hut is a magical book that has been known to do wonderous things. Find that book and you may yet learn the gnomish way.

female_text: I didn't mean to drag you into this, $n.  Ever since we took on a job to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook, everyone involved has wound up dead or missing.

male_text: Teach you gnomish engineering? I don't have time for this nonsense. You only get one chance with Oglethorpe and you blew that, didn't you?$B$BYou'll have to head to Tanaris and find Narain Soothfancy's hut. In that hut is a magical book that might be able to jostle whatever is left of your brain and reconnect you with what you've lost.$B$BNow get lost!

female_text: Trying to find out more about my predicament has been nearly impossible.  The smuggler that hired us has vanished and Anthion Harmon, our mercenary company's leader, is dead.
Come to think about it, most everyone involved is dead.  I'll understand if you don't want to be involved in any of this, $n.

male_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn dragonscale leatherworking.
female_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn dragonscale leatherworking.

male_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn elemental leatherworking.
female_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn elemental leatherworking.

male_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn tribal leatherworking.
female_text: I am absolutely certain that I want to learn tribal leatherworking.

male_text: The assortment of images, shapes, and markings come together before your eyes. The book seems to know your skill with leatherworking and offers you a choice - but be warned - you may only select one and once you have done so, may not change your mind!:
Your fate is sealed, Mokvar!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!
female_text: Your fate is sealed, Mokvar!  You will pay for your trespasses against Lord Valthalak!

male_text: I cannot teach you dragonscale leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
Begone foul creatures!  Go back to the void your master shaped you from!
It was not my intention to get you involved in this, $n.  I've spent every waking hour looking over my shoulder ever since I helped an old friend in a daring raid on Blackrock Spire.
Trying to find out more about these creatures hasn't been easy.  My friend and the person who hired his mercenaries to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook have both been feared dead for a while.
One by one, nearly everyone involved in this matter has fallen prey to these spectres.  I'll understand if you decide to walk away from this, $n.

female_text: I cannot teach you elemental leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."

male_text: I cannot teach you elemental leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."

female_text: I cannot teach you tribal leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."

male_text: I cannot teach you tribal leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
Thrall has shown great kindness in granting me sanctuary within his domain.  I do not wish to overstay my welcome, at any rate.  It would be a great dishonor if I brought any trouble to our leader.

female_text: Try not to draw too much attention, I'm waiting for the King to grant me audience.  Not that I mind waiting, I feel pretty safe around all these burly guards.

male_text: Losing my life was a danger I had come to terms with.  Losing Ysida is something I cannot endure, even after my own death.
Greetings, friend!  Can I interest you in some ectoplasmic capacitors?  Or perhaps a nice omni-directional spectral assimilator?
What now?  Can't you see I'm rather busy?
I seem to have misplaced the distiller, Mux.  Did I happen to leave it here?
female_text: I seem to have misplaced the distiller, Mux.  Did I happen to leave it here?

male_text: About that ghost revealer.  Did I happen to leave it here?  I seem to be missing it.
female_text: About that ghost revealer.  Did I happen to leave it here?  I seem to be missing it.

male_text: I believe I misplaced that banner you enchanted for me, Falrin.
female_text: I believe I misplaced that banner you enchanted for me, Falrin.

male_text: Anthion, I seem  to have misplaced the banner you created for me.
female_text: Anthion, I seem to have misplaced the banner you created for me.

male_text: I guess it's all just about over, right $n? I'm going to miss you... it'll be pretty lonely up here without someone to talk to.$B$BBut that doesn't mean that you can't come back to see me in the future!
Hey Vi'el, show me your wares!
female_text: Hey Vi'el, show me your wares!

male_text: Return the amulet! Return to me what was stolen!!
Bodley, tell me what's going on.
female_text: Bodley, tell me what's going on.

male_text: It's quite simple, really, $n. My old merc company, The Veiled Blade, took the wrong mission at the wrong time.$B$BWe were hired by a goblin smuggler out of Booty Bay, one Gremnik Rizzlesprang, who was covetous of Lord Valthalak's spellbook. Or, maybe there was some old rivalry there? I suppose we'll never know now, because Gremnik was killed not too long ago by a group of Valthalak's spectral assassins. They really can be very deadly when a large number of them gather.$B$BWhere was I?
You were telling me about The Veiled Blade and how you took the wrong mission.
female_text: You were telling me about The Veiled Blade and how you took the wrong mission.

male_text: Oh yes, that's right.$B$BSo, here we are invading deep into the upper reaches of Blackrock Spire, against their lord and leader; this was before Drakkisath. Not too smart if you ask me, but our leader, Anthion Harmon, you met him, was always one who loved a challenge.$B$BSurprisingly, everything went according to plan, right up to the point where we were prying Valthalak's spellbook out of his stiff fingers. That's when it all went south.$B$BShould I continue? You look like your eyes are glazing over.
No, no, please continue... it's just that the air up here is so, um, smoky.
female_text: No, no, please continue... it's just that the air up here is so, um, smoky.

male_text: <Bodley looks at you dubiously, but continues...>$B$BThere we are, spellbook in hand, and Kormok, our two-headed ogre necromancer, gets this strange look in all four of his eyes. It was really creepy, because that second set of eyes always kind of looked dead, like a cow's eyes, you know? So, all of a sudden he just reaches out and rips this amulet off that Valthalak was wearing.$B$BThe rest of the company went crazy; some of us telling them to leave it alone, and others who wanted it for themselves.
Please continue, Bodley.
female_text: Please continue, Bodley.

male_text: Sheesh, you don't have to beg! Anyways, I'm almost done with the story.$B$BSo, the whole company is in the middle of that massive chamber fighting over this amulet, and you know how it echoes in there! In the end it was broken into three pieces, and we rolled the dice, with it going to various people or groups.$B$BThe rest is a bit of a blur, though, because it was at about that time that old Valthalak's spirit decided to make an entrance and start summoning forth all of these spectral assassins.
I thought you were almost done?
female_text: I thought you were almost done?

male_text: Cool your heels!$B$B<Bodley grumbles something under his breath about the impatience of the living>$B$BAs I was saying, Lord Valthalak's spirit and spectral assassins, summoned forth through his necromantic dabbling, started to assail us. Let me tell you, at that point we weren't in any condition to fight back, so we ran. I can still remember Mor Grayhoof, one of our druids, slip and fall at one point into the lower reaches of the spire.$B$BThe rest as they say, is history.
What happened to your mercenary company, The Veiled Blade?
female_text: What happened to your mercenary company, The Veiled Blade?

male_text: We broke up afterward, that's what happened. Too much bad blood, I guess...it had been building for a while. And the thing with the amulet was the straw that broke the kodo's back.$B$BEver since then Valthalak's servants have been picking us off one by one. Most of the amulet piece holders are dead, their souls corrupted by the portion of Valthalak's spirit contained within it.$B$BThat's why I'm glad that you're here, $n. With your help we'll be able to recombine the amulet and return it to Lord Valthalak!
Your meddling ends here, $n!  Lord Valthalak shall have his revenge!
female_text: Your meddling ends here, $n!  Lord Valthalak shall have his revenge!

male_text: Friends of yours?
Use your tonk action bar above your standard action bar to attack other tonks.

female_text: I'll be fine for now, don't worry about me.  I'll find a way out of here once I've performed some cleansing rituals in this room.  Foul magic taints this place, $n.
You did it... you've slain Baron Rivendare!  The Argent Dawn shall hear of your valiant deeds!

male_text: Talk about making the wrong investment!$B$BLord Valthalak's dark book of spells fetched a pretty penny in the black market.  It's too bad he didn't take too kindly to getting his possessions stolen.  That stinker got us even after he'd been dead for months!
Ysida lives thanks to your courage, $n.  I am deeply in your debt and shall assist you as much as it is in my power.
What are these Tonk Control Consoles?
female_text: What are these Tonk Control Consoles?

Our newest attraction, and at no cost to you I might add, these miniature tanks, or Tonks as we've cleverly named them, can be controlled from any of the Tonk Control Consoles spread throughout the faire.$B$BAll that you have to do is activate an available control console. Each tonk will come equipped with a stock set of devices, and a random special power to unleash upon your enemy!$B$BHold epic battles with your friends, cruise around, or just cause wild mayhem... the choice is yours!

male_text: Tell me about the cannon.
female_text: Tell me about the cannon.

The Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon is a state-of-the-art single person projectile device. Delivering its payload at near the speed of a dragon, the cannon is the pride and joy of the Blastenheimer family, world renown for their aeronautical and combustible feats!$B$BIf you'd like to be launched through the skies to fly free as a bird, seek out Maxima Blastenheimer on the east end of the faire. I hear that she's placed a target ring way over on Crystal Lake for you to aim for as you sail through the air!

The Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon is a state-of-the-art single person projectile device. Delivering its payload at near the speed of a dragon, the cannon is the pride and joy of the Blastenheimer family, world renown for their aeronautical and combustible feats!$B$BIf you'd like to be launched through the skies to fly free as a bird, seek out Maxima Blastenheimer on the south edge of Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise. She'll aim you at the target far to south on Stonebull Lake!

male_text: %s goes into a rage after seeing $n fall in battle!
female_text: %s goes into a rage after seeing $n fall in battle!
It is said that Kel'Thuzad seeks the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian.$B$BYes, the very staff once held by Medivh.

male_text: Watch your step, $r. We of the Brotherhood of the Light are not as lenient as our brethren when it comes to meting justice to those that would do this world wrong.$B$BWoe unto those that would anger Korfax.$B$BNow if you have no business with me or the other members of the Brotherhood, please leave so that we may continue our meeting.
The Lich King is attempting to make his presence known in our world. This must not be allowed to occur.

What is the Brotherhood of the Light? Well... We are all members of the Argent Dawn at the core - members of the Argent Dawn that aren't held in check by morals, guilt and useless human emotion. Consider us Scarlet Crusade minus the stupidity, lack of leadership, and blind zealotry.$B$BDon't let the Scarlet Commander tell you otherwise.$B$BAnd don't let Tyrosus know I said that... It would be a terrible shame if I had to brutally maim him should a brawl break out.

female_text: The Argent Dawn might be impotent idealists but their delusional leader knows that they are outmatched. I have been sent here as an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade. An ambassador, if you will... It is doubtful that we could even dent the armies of Kel'Thuzad - united or not - but we might be able to contain them long enough for some sort of miracle to happen.$B$BAs for me? I'll die in battle...$B$B<Marjhan shrugs.>
That is wonderous, Rimblat! Even this foul, sundered earth is not beyond healing.

male_text: Watch, druid. The earth still breathes. It yearns to be cleansed.
The title is misleading. I'm really a very nice person once you get to know me.
They almost sent my brother, Loksey, to this gathering. He cannot even take care of his hounds, let alone represent the Scarlet Crusade in a competent manner.
I've been expec...$B$B<Rimblat coughs.>$B$BExcuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.

female_text: Hello, $c. Please excuse me as I am having a conversation with Rimblat. He believes that even this land is not beyond saving.

male_text: What is it that you want, lemming? Get out of my sight before you find out why I am known as the Wrathcaster.
You want a fight?  A fight you'll get!
I'm going to kick yer ugly head in!
I crush weaklings like you every day!  Bring it on!
Your insolence is appalling, fool!  I shall feast on your soul!
Who dares to disturb my eternal rest?  Your deaths will be slow and painful!
You're but worms beneath my feet.  You dare challenge me?
First Kormok crush your bones!  Then Kormok burn your soul!
You so little and puny... you no make good servants for Kormok!
What is Dreadnaught armor?
female_text: What is Dreadnaught armor?

male_text: The first suit of Dreadnaught armor was made exclusively for the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.  Whilst donning the full suit, the Highlord looked himself to be a demon from the depths of the Nether.$B$BAye, 'twas quite a sight to behold as Mograine would wade into a hundred Scourge, Ashbringer held high, and come out on the other side in a cloud of dust and flames - enemies left in ashes beneath his feet.
Continue please.
female_text: Continue please.

male_text: It was not until after his controversial death that the knights and warriors of Lordaeron would wear similarly fashioned suits in honor of their fallen hero. While the death of Mograine was a great victory for Kel'Thuzad, the resulting martyrdom would be felt until the end of the war.$B$BWhere one did fall, many would rise...
Anything else?
female_text: Anything else?

male_text: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of this armor worn by heroes.
All of Nature's might is at my disposal, puny mortals. Let us see which of my many forms it will be that ends your suffering!
Muahahahaha! What is this pathetic spectacle I see before me? Well, what are you waiting for? I hunger, and you look as if you may make for a passable appetizer!
You think you can summon us? We are the ones that summon, not you! We bash you good for this and suck the marrow from your bones!
I'm what you call a capitalist, $r.

female_text: In life, I focused my energies on healing others. Let us see in death how much pain I can cause!
Hello, brother.

male_text: Hello, sister. What have we here?

female_text: Would-be interlopers, I'm afraid.

male_text: Shall we slay them for the impertinence of disturbing our sleep?

female_text: Yes, we shall!

male_text: What is Redemption armor?
female_text: What is Redemption armor?

male_text: The armor of Redemption was worn by our most pious knights - armor worthy of the Lightbringer himself!$B$BThousands fell in the last war; their vestments stripped from their corpses and taken to the dread citadel of Naxxramas.$B$BIt is said that the death knights of Naxxramas corrupt the Redemption plate mail for their own use.$B$BSuch tragedy...
What is Cryptstalker armor?
female_text: What is Cryptstalker armor?

male_text: The preternatural ability of the crypt fiend to hunt and kill its foe is one studied and vaunted by men in my profession. I, myself, have slain thousands of the beasts in my crusade to rid this world of Scourge.$B$BWhile I loathe the crypt fiend for its merciless nature, its abilities must be admired. It has a job and it does it - very well.
Continue please.
female_text: Continue please.

male_text: I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend and its various body parts. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.
I am unable to teach a Tauren to ride a Skeletal Mount.  I am sorry but there is nothing I can do for you.
female_text: I am unable to teach a Tauren to ride a Skeletal Mount.  I am sorry but there is nothing I can do for you.

male_text: What brings a tauren to the Plaguelands?
female_text: What brings a tauren to the Plaguelands?

male_text: In the last war, tauren fought. Shaman were sent in defense of this world against the Scourge invasion. Most lost their lives. Many were otherwise ripped asunder, their body parts used for foul experiments in that cursed citadel. I mourn their passing but my heart swells with pride at their courage.
Continue please.
female_text: Continue please.

male_text: I was a young tauren, barely having reached adolescence at the time, but I knew that those that would brave the battles for our freedom were well protected in my namesake's vestments.
The name of Earthshatter has been one held by my family for hundreds of years. And like my father and his father before him, I too have inherited the right to create the vestments of my namesake.
What is it that you do exactly, Rohan?
female_text: What is it that you do exactly, Rohan?

male_text: Ah, as the title states I am an assassin for the Scarlet Crusade. I spend my days exterminating high priority targets and nights at the Gadgetzan discotheque. Dancing is my true calling. Assassination just pays the bills.
So what brings you to Light's Hope?
female_text: So what brings you to Light's Hope?

male_text: Good question, $r. In my younger days I was footloose and fancy free without a care in the world. In those days I would sing in a barber shop quartet out of Stormwind known as the Four Dons. That's where I learned how to craft the Bonescythe digs.
What? Bonescythe?
female_text: What? Bonescythe?

male_text: Yes, Bonescythe. You see, it was our tenor, an ornery fellow known as Don Julio, who got me started on the whole thing. In his travels throughout Lordaeron, Don Julio picked up many interesting skills, one of them being the ability to take the bones of fallen Scourge and fashion them into a lethal set of leather armor - perfectly suited for an assassin.
Wow, you're insane, aren't you?
female_text: Wow, you're insane, aren't you?

male_text: I'm as sane as the next guy, $g fella:lady;. Believe what you will, but I AM capable of fashioning this armor. If you're interested, maybe we can make a deal. The sooner I can get out of the assassination business, the better.
Hey wait, Gadgetzan has a disco?
female_text: Hey wait, Gadgetzan has a disco?

male_text: Members only, scrub!
Hello, Rayne. What brings the Cenarion Circle to the Plaguelands?
female_text: Hello, Rayne. What brings the Cenarion Circle to the Plaguelands?
We are all drawn here for different reasons, $c.$B$B<Rayne smiles.>$B$BI am here to meet with Rimblat of the Earthen Ring. He has some interesting theories on cleansing these lands.

male_text: Are these lands not beyond healing? They look pretty beat up.
female_text: Are these lands not beyond healing? They look pretty beat up.

I think not. Rimblat has already proven that new life can grow from the sundered earth. Now we must find a way to reproduce and, more importantly, sustain the growth.$B$BWhile I am here, I am also offering my services to adventurers entering Naxxramas.

male_text: What kind of services?
female_text: What kind of services?

I am a crafter of some renown, $c. With the proper materials, I am able to craft an armor known as Dreamwalker. Druids - and even some shaman - are drawn to this armor due to its magical properties. Are you interested?

male_text: What is Atiesh?
female_text: What is Atiesh?
Like Kel'Thuzad, I too was once a mage of the Kirin Tor. And like Kel'Thuzad, I seek the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian. Our fates are intertwined as such, $c.

male_text: What Guardian? I don't understand any of this.
female_text: What Guardian? I don't understand any of this.
Progeny of Aegwynn, he that would be the last Guardian of Tirisfal... Medivh.

male_text: Please continue.
female_text: Please continue.

It is a story of legend and one that I do not have the time nor the inclination to retell. Just know that Medivh was the last of the Guardians. The greatstaff of Atiesh was a focal point of his power and a focal point of corruption.

male_text: What corruption?
female_text: What corruption?
The corruption of a fallen titan. The corruption of the Destroyer. After all, the staff was forged from the seed of hate. That is, of course, what has brought me here...

male_text: Please continue.
female_text: Please continue.

After the fall of Karazhan, the Kirin Tor dispatched an assembly of mages to search the tower and seize all items of import... for the purposes of "research." It was then that the fabled staff was discovered and brought back to Dalaran.

male_text: Please continue.
female_text: Please continue.

What followed were a series of tragic events, leading to the death of every Kirin Tor mage that came into contact with Atiesh.$B$BYou see, it was an artifact with sentience. A sentience granted to it by Sargeras...

male_text: What?
female_text: What?

<Angela nods.>$B$BAfter the deaths, the Six decided that the best course of action was to seal the staff behind impenetrable barriers of magic and appoint a watcher: A guardian of the staff... I would be that watcher.

male_text: This is disturbing. Please continue.
female_text: This is disturbing. Please continue.

There is not much more to tell. Dalaran was nearly wholly destroyed by Archimonde, the staff lost, presumably shattered by the barrier's fail-safe mechanisms.$B$BThere are those that believe the staff to be the cause of Archimonde's reprisal.

male_text: Please, tell me more.
female_text: Please, tell me more.

After the fall of Dalaran, I took my leave from the Kirin Tor. I spent years watching over Atiesh, only to have my purpose amongst the Kirin Tor taken from me in one fell swoop. I would find the staff, though it might take a lifetime. That is how I came to join the Argent Dawn and why I am here now.

male_text: Is there anything else?
female_text: Is there anything else?

I have tracked the various fragments of the staff across this world and in doing so, discovered Kel'Thuzad's plans to reform the staff. He has already collected several of the staff's fragments - which are being held by his most trusted lieutenants.$B$BI cannot emphasize enough the importance of keeping the greatstaff of the Guardian out of Kel'Thuzad's grasp. Frankly, I do not know what the result would be, other than a catastrophe of epic proportion.

male_text: What is Plagueheart armor?
female_text: What is Plagueheart armor?

male_text: It is power, imbecile.$B$B<Mataus's eyes darken.>$B$BThese fools send idiots like you into Naxxramas to retrieve desecrated armor so that they may purify it and restore the pieces to their former glory.$B$B<Mataus spits.>$B$BJust the thought of such utter stupidity brings the bile up to my throat.$B$BI too seek that armor, but in its most foul and desecrated form.
I also seek such power.
female_text: I also seek such power.

male_text: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness such items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.$B$BAnd I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die, but I've already explained this...
Tell me about faith, Father.
female_text: Tell me about faith, Father.

male_text: Faith... Some have lost it, others have found it. It cannot be destroyed and it cannot be created.$B$BOr perhaps you speak of the vestments of Faith? Armor worn by our priests and most devout warriors into battle against the Scourge during the last war.$B$BAye, much of it is lost... Stolen by the fiends of Naxxramas.

female_text: Your message did reach us, Commander, but by no means is our involvement here sanctioned by the Grand Crusader.

male_text: Your leader takes residence at the doorstep to Naxxramas. Do you think he does not feel the pressure?
%s lowers the sound of his voice to a whisper.
Even demons are capable of fear...

Scourge activity in the Plaguelands has increased ten-fold. We are receiving reports of Scourge attacks from as far away as Kalimdor! Now how do you suppose this has happened? How have the wretched undead done that which was previously thought impossible? Is nowhere safe?

female_text: The heathens will be forced to react. Orcs, bull-men...

male_text: Tauren.

female_text: Whatever. The revolting, unkempt Horde filth...

male_text: You lack tact, Commander. This is not surprising. However, you are right in that the Horde will be forced to act. But not just the Horde. They already come - heroes from across the world.

female_text: Too little, too late. The dam has broken. We are a bump in the road at best.

male_text: So why are you here? What are we to do if there is no hope?
There is always... Ashbringer.
female_text: There is always... Ashbringer.

male_text: So this is what you have come for? To try and claim that which is the reason for the Dawn's existence and the Crusade's downfall? You open old wounds with your words, Commander!

The Ashbringer is dead and there will never be another like him. The lesser Mograine is a far cry from the man his father was. You know this, Commander! It was, after all, your own leadership that was responsible for the death of the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.

It was your leadership that manipulated a grieving child to try and recover the sword. A child that has grown into a man with nothing but vengeance and hatred in his heart! And for what? You are no closer to the sword now than you were five years ago.

Yet you think that recovering Ashbringer will somehow turn the tide of battle? Let me let you in on a little secret, Commander: The power of the Ashbringer came from the man who would wield it... I was there, Commander. I watched him burn legions of undead in righteous fire before he would even unsheathe the blade. Alas, your grasp on history is ... lacking.

Now be silent and note where you are, lest I inform Lord Fordring and his knights that you are no longer here on amicable terms. I am certain he would take great pleasure in seeing to your 'atonement.'
I cannot be teachin' a Tauren to ride a Raptor.
female_text: I cannot be teachin' a Tauren to ride a Raptor.

male_text: Where can I find crypt fiend parts, Leopold?
female_text: Where can I find crypt fiend parts, Leopold?

male_text: Those filthy beasts are all over the place.$B$BIf you prefer hunting outdoors, you'll find most of them around Plaguewood and Terrordale, with a good concentration of them in the Terrorweb tunnel. They are also likely to appear at almost any Scourge encampment in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BIf you're a hearty dungeon crawler, you'll find a good lot of them in Stratholme and a few of the necrofiend variety in Scholomance.
Where can I find bone fragments?
female_text: Where can I find bone fragments?

male_text: Are you daft? Did you miss the BONY SKELETAL CREATURES littering the landscape on your way over here?$B$B<Rohan sighs.>$B$BIf you're the outdoor type, you'll find skeletal creatures all over both the Western and Eastern Plaguelands. Trust me, you can't miss 'em - they certainly won't miss you if they get the chance.$B$BIf you're a dungeon type, Stratholme and Scholomance are definitely the place to be for bone fragments.
Where can I find core of elements?
female_text: Where can I find core of elements?

Ah, a good question.$B$BIf you prefer hunting in the great outdoors, there are elementals here in the Plaguelands, Azshara, Burning Steppes, Felwood, Silithus, Winterspring, and even Un'Goro Crater.$B$BIf you are the type that laughs in the face of danger, then perhaps you should visit Dire Maul. I have heard that a great many elemental abberations exist within its walls. You would also do well in seeking out the elementals employed by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.

male_text: Korfax, where can I find Dark Iron scraps?
female_text: Korfax, where can I find Dark Iron scraps?

male_text: Is this a serious question? female_text: What do you mean?

male_text: It was High General Abbendis, High Inquisitor Isillien, and Highlord Mograine that formed the Crusade. In its infancy, the Crusade was a noble order. The madness and insane zealotry that you see now did not exist. It was not until the one known as the Grand Crusader appeared that the wheels of corruption were set in motion.
I still do not fully understand.
female_text: I still do not fully understand.

male_text: The Highlord was the lynchpin of the Crusade. Aye, Mograine was called the Ashbringer because of his exploits versus the armies of the Lich King. With only blade and faith, Mograine would walk into whole battalions of undead and emerge unscathed - the ashes of his foes being the only indication that he had been there at all. Do you not understand? The very face of death feared him! It trembled in his presence!
Incredible story. So how did he die?
female_text: Incredible story. So how did he die?

male_text: The only way a hero can die, $r: Through tragedy. The Grand Crusader struck a deal with Kel'Thuzad himself! An ambush would be staged that would result in the death of Mograine. The type of betrayal that could only be a result of the actions of one's most trusted and loved companions.
You mean...
female_text: You mean...

male_text: <High Inquisitor Fairbanks nods.>$B$BAye, the lesser Mograine, the one known as the Scarlet Commander, through - what I suspect - the dealings of the Grand Crusader. He led his father to the ambush like a lamb to the slaughter.
How do you know all of this?
female_text: How do you know all of this?

male_text: <High Inquisitor Fairbanks lifts up his tabard revealing several gruesome scars.>$B$BBecause I was there... I was the Highlord's most trusted advisor. I should have known... I felt that something was amiss yet I allowed it to happen. Would you believe that there were a thousand or more Scourge?
A thousand? For one man?
female_text: A thousand? For one man?

male_text: This was the Ashbringer, fool! As the Scourge began to materialize around us, Mograine's blade began to glow... to hum... the younger Mograine would take that as a sign to make his escape. They descended upon us with a hunger the likes of which I had never seen. Yet...
Yet? Yet what??
female_text: Yet? Yet what??

male_text: It was not enough.$B$B<Fairbanks smirks briefly, lost in a memory.>$B$BA thousand came and a thousand died. By the Light! By the might of Mograine! He would smite them down as fast as they could come. Through the chaos, I noticed that the lesser Mograine was still there, off in the distance. I called to him, "Help us, Renault! Help your father, boy!"
And did he?
female_text: And did he?

male_text: <High Inquisitor Fairbanks shakes his head.>$B$BNo... He stood in the background, watching as the legion of undead descended upon us. Soon after, my powers were exhausted. I was the first to fall... Surely they would tear me limb from limb as I lay there unconscious; but they ignored me completely, focusing all of their attention on the Highlord.
Continue please, Fairbanks.
female_text: Continue please, Fairbanks.

male_text: It was all I could do to feign death as the corpses of the Scourge piled upon me. There was darkness and only the muffled sounds of the battle above me. The clashing of iron, the gnashing and grinding... gruesome, terrible sounds. And then there was silence. He called to me! "Fairbanks! Fairbanks where are you? Talk to me Fairbanks!" And then came the sound of incredulousness. The bite of betrayal, $r...
You mean...
female_text: You mean...

male_text: The boy had picked up the Ashbringer and driven it through his father's heart as his back was turned. His last words will haunt me forever: "What have you done, Renault? Why would you do this?"
You were right, Fairbanks. That is tragic.
female_text: You were right, Fairbanks. That is tragic.

male_text: The blade and Mograine were a singular entity. Do you understand? This act corrupted the blade and lead to Mograine's own corruption as a death knight of Kel'Thuzad. I swore that if I lived, I would expose the perpetrators of this heinous crime. For two days I remained under the rot and contagion of Scourge - gathering as much strength as possible to escape the razed city.
And you did...
female_text: And you did...

male_text: Aye, I did. Much to the dismay of the lesser Mograine, I made my way back to the Scarlet Monastery. I shouted and screamed. I told the tale to any that would listen. And I would be murdered in cold blood for my actions, dragged to this chamber - the dark secret of the order. But some did listen... some heard my words. Thus was born the Argent Dawn...
You tell an incredible tale, Fairbanks. What of the blade? Is it beyond redemption?
female_text: You tell an incredible tale, Fairbanks. What of the blade? Is it beyond redemption?

male_text: I'm afraid that the blade which you hold in your hands is beyond saving. The hatred runs too deep. But do not lose hope, $c. Where one chapter has ended, a new one begins.$B$BFind his son - a more devout and pious man you may never meet. It is rumored that he is able to build the Ashbringer anew, without requiring the old, tainted blade.
But his son is dead.
female_text: But his son is dead.

male_text: <High Inquisitor Fairbanks shakes his head.>$B$BNo, $r; only one of his sons is dead. The other lives...$B$B<High Inquisitor Fairbanks points to the sky.>$B$BThe Outland... Find him there...

I grow tired of these games. Proceed, and I will banish your souls to oblivion!
You have no idea what horrors lie ahead. You have seen nothing! The frozen heart of Naxxramas awaits you!
It is good that you serve me so faithfully. Soon all will serve the Lich King... and in the end, you shall be rewarded - so long as you do not falter.
Your security measures have failed. See to this interruption immediately!
Our preparations continue as planned, master.
I foresee no complications at this-- Wait! What is this?
Yes, master!
Come, heroes... By the will of the Lich King, you shall be destroyed.
Very well. Warriors of the frozen wastes, rise up! I command you to fight, kill and die for your master! Let none survive!
Pray for mercy!
Scream your dying breath!
The end is upon you!
Master, I require aid!
Minions, servants, soldiers of the cold dark! Obey the call of Kel'Thuzad!
Just a little taste...

There is no way out.
Yes, run! It makes the blood pump faster!
Ahh... welcome to my parlor.
Shhh... it will all be over soon.
I hear little hearts beating. Yes... beating faster now... soon the beating will stop.
Where to go? What to do? So many choices that all end in pain, end in death.
Which one shall I eat first? So difficult to choose. They all smell so delicious...
Closer now. Tasty morsels. I've been too long without food, without blood to drink.

female_text: Defend yourself!

Who's next?
Your life is mine!

I do hope they stay alive long enough for me to... introduce myself.

I will freeze the blood in your veins!
The dark void awaits you!
%s cackles maniacally.
Feed you to master!
No... more... Feugen.
Feugen make master happy.
I... am... undone.
Death is the only escape!
I have waited long enough. Now you face the harvester of souls.

I see you...

Close your eyes. Sleep.

Be still!

You will find no peace in death.
The master's will is done.
Bow to the might of the Highlord!
Enough prattling. Let them come. We shall grind their bones to dust.
Conserve your anger. Harness your rage. You will all have outlets for your frustrations soon enough.
Life is meaningless. It is in death that we are truly tested.
Glory to the master!
Your life is forfeit!
Die, trespasser!
I will serve the master... in death!
My task is done!
Breathe no more!
Rise, my soldiers! Rise and fight once more!
Patchwerk want to play!
Kel'thuzad make Patchwerk his avatar of war!
What... happen to-
No more play?
I'm just getting warmed up!
Stand and fight!
Show me what you've got!
Do as I taught you!
Show them no mercy!
You disappoint me, students!
The time for practice is over! Show me what you have learned!
An honorable... death.
Sweep the leg... Do you have a problem with that?
You should have stayed home.
%s lets loose a triumphant shout.
Stalagg crush you!
Master, save me!!
Stalagg kill!
Kill...
Eat... your... bones...
Break... you!!
Thank... you...
Now you feel pain...
You are too late!! I... must... obey!!
Hurry! Ple-e-ase hurry!!
Sto-o-op! Make it stop!!
Help me! Save me!
No-o-o-o!!
You... die now!!
Flee, before it's too late!
It is... as it should be.
Forgive me.
I have no choice but to obey!
Invaders, cease this foolish venture at once! Turn away while you still can!
Perhaps they will come to their senses... and run away as fast as they can.
Do not continue! Turn back, turn back while there's still time!

male_text: Can you feel it, pathetic creatures? The pall over this land is but a precursor. Soon your precious holdings will be in our grasp! You will fall before the might of the Scourge!
Despair, mortals! Your doom has come!
Let this gloom serve to remind you: the shadow of the Scourge is all-encompassing! There is no escape!
As you fall in battle, we continue to grow in strength. There is only one inevitable outcome. Prepare for your end!
Forward, my minions! Forward! Let none stand in our way!
Cower before our might! Flee! There will be no victory for the living!
Show me what you've got, rookie!
Is that the best you can do?
You're not only wasting the time of your fellow students, you're wasting my time too.
Pathetic...
My granny, livin' down in Redridge, hits dummies harder than you, rookie!
I think you signed up for the wrong job, initiate. Kel'Thuzad don't need any flower girls...
Is this some kind of joke?
Start doing something before I replace that target dummy with you and begin a warm up session of my own!
Student is worthless, master! Student apologizes for his deficiency!
I am unworthy, master!
Student will work harder, master!
Sir, student requests that you beat him for his lack of understanding!
No!!! A curse upon you, interlopers! The armies of the Lich King will hunt you down. You will not escape your fate...

So you've conquered a small spot of land. A minor setback! The Scourge still reign here!
Enjoy your small victory while you can, mortals. It will not stop our eventual triumph over this land!
There is no victory for you here! What little ground you've gained will be swallowed by the Scourge army in due course!
The shadow of the Scourge yet remains on this land, fools! You will never prevail!
So, the frail members of the living have some teeth after all. Take this place, then, for the time being. We will return, twice as strong, and your paltry forces will fall!
You dare disrupt our works here?! The master will not be pleased. Take this time to prepare yourselves... when we return, there will be nothing but death and destruction in our wake!
You may think you have won, worms, but against the might of the Scourge there is no victory for the living! You have not seen the last of us!
Do you truly believe you are doing well? Hah! Our numbers are limitless!
You may succeed on the field of battle briefly... but you cannot hope to win against the Scourge!
You've reclaimed a few paltry territories. Pathetic. In short order they will again be ours!
Do you truly believe you're making progress? You can never defeat the Scourge! These small victories are nothing more than a ploy to make you overconfident!
Think you the master is daunted by your games? We will never fall to you!
You fools! Keep fighting, if that is your wish! With every battle, more of you fall, and the ranks of the undead swell!
The toils of the living never cease to amaze. Your numbers are limited, and with every battle they dwindle further. You will not live to see the end!
Do you truly believe you can win against the armies of Kel'Thuzad? No army of the living, no power you could possibly bring to bear can destroy our ranks!
This constant, annoying resistance is futile, you maggots! There will be nothing in the end but death!
